highlights.summary:
IIT Madras has been ranked 180 by the QS World University Rankings 2026. IIT Madras has been ranked 1st under the Overall category, 2nd under the Research Institutions category, 13th under the Management category, 1st under the Innovation category, 1st under the SDG Institutions category, and 1st under the Engineering category by NIRF 2025.

IIT Madras has opened admissions for various Olympiad achievers. For this, IIT Madras has reserved 34 Supernumerary Seats under the 'Science Olympiad Excellence' Category from 2025-26.

The GATE 2026 exam for admission to ME/MTech and PhD courses has concluded. Results are scheduled for release on Mar 19, 2026.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to IIT Madras for BTech?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech courses offered by IIT Madras are entrance-based and done on the basis of scores obtained in JEE Mains and JEE Advanced. Seats are allocated through JoSAA counselling after the results of the entrance exams are out. Students who clear the IIT Madras BTech cutoff are then required to go through document verification and pay the required fees to complete the process.

faqs.answer:
The IIT Madras average package has not been released. However, the median salary is out. Comparing the last two-year median package details, an improving trend was recorded in IIT Madras MBA and M.Tech courses. For UG (BTech, DD, IDDD), MS (Science streams), and PhD courses, the median package dropped from 2022 to 2023. Alongside this, the median package for MS (Engineering streams) and MA (Humanities and Social Sciences) has been stagnant over the past two years. reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Review of facilities and life at IIT Madras.

review_content.Placements: My batch has 154 students, which makes it the second-largest branch on the campus. The highest package offered is 1.31 crores per annum. The top recruiting companies for our course are Google, Microsoft, etc. A lot of other renowned companies around the world also visit the college. The top roles offered are software development engineer, validation engineer, IC design, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The department building is very spacious with a lot of classrooms and labs. The building is a bit old, so the renovation is being made now. The hostel infrastructure is nice, but there is a bit of a problem with monkeys in one or two of them. The mess food is of nice quality. Food courts are available throughout the day.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good campus, good placement, good faculty, but hostel alone needs improvement.

review_content.Placements: Placements are good and decent, we will receive top recruits. Core options are more. Package offered is decent with respect to our CGP it lies. Getting an internship is a difficult part but getting placed is easy. Nearly 80% of students get placed in a year. But you should maintain decent grades and skills.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel infrastructure needs to be improved. We will receive free Wi-Fi throughout. Library and many places are provided for students to study. We have wide options for mess and menu. Canteens are available at low cost without compromising the food quality. Labs are awesome.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering + M.Tech. in Applied Mechanics - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Great campus life with good placements and strong academic support.

review_content.Placements: Around 70% of students got placed. The highest package was 18 LPA, the lowest 5 LPA, average salary was 9 LPA. Top companies like L&T, ISRO, and DRDO. 60% of students got internships in same companies. Roles offered were design engineer, research associate, and tech consultant. It's quite good here.
review_content.Infrastructure: Department had good labs, classrooms with AC and projector, and Wi-Fi all around. Library was big with many books. Hostel rooms were fine, and shared type. Mess food was okay, sometimes good, sometimes not. Medical help was available 24X7. Many sports ground and gym were also there. It's quite good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The best campus in India, and very good.

review_content.Placements: Around 80% of people go for higher studies in India and abroad. The highest package offer is 42LPA, and the lowest is around 6 to 7LPA. Top recruiters included TCS, Wipro, L&T, and Accenture. 60% of people got internships in many companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities in the department and library include Wi-Fi. Everything is good and well. The hostel is maintained well and nicely, with a mess, food, good infrastructure, AC classrooms, and facilitated labs. Medical facilities and sports facilities are also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Overall best college for M.A. In Economics Course.

review_content.Placements: Placements are excellent for our department. Students of finance are assigned to companies related to finance. The typical salary varies between approximately 15-25 LPA. PSUs visit our college for hiring purposes as well. The top packages reach as much as 3 LPA. Approximately 71-76% of students secure placements annually. 59% of learners obtained internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college is located in the northeast, and connectivity to the rest of India is limited. Thus, there were few female students on campus. Hotels were good. Each student is given an individual furnished room. Each hotel has a mess area, restaurant, and TV room. The food is awesome. It will take some time to adjust the menu for other public school students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely beautiful campus with wildlife.

review_content.Placements: Internship is mostly based on software companies; not many core companies come even for core courses. Applying for out-of-campus placements is recommended. Better to have other options in hand. Roles in software companies would generally be developers. And engineering roles are fewer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Courses in my branch are difficult; others are pretty okay. Infrastructure depends on the branch you are in. Aerospace has a very mediocre infrastructure. Coming to the hostel, it is okay. I can't describe it as good exactly. Food is edible, extra in the mess would be good, food courts have good food. Medical facilities are good, and they have good sports facilities.

overview_faqs.question: Which is the biggest festival of IIT Madras?
overview_faqs.answer: IIT Madras conducts an annual fest called Shaastra. It is an annual technical festival organised to celebrate unconstrained thinking and love for the spirit of engineering. Another cultural festival organised by IIT Madras is Saarang, It is the largest cultural fest in India held every year in the month of January.

paragraphs: Indian Institute of Technology Madrasalso known asIITMoffers the programmes through regular and full-time modes. Students are offered over ten programmes spanning multiple specialisations.IIT Madras admission processincludes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list and counselling. Students must meet the eligibility and selection criteria prior to applying for the desired course. The process mainly commences online. The step-wise admission process forIIT Madras UG & PG coursesis given below:
IIT Madras Application 2026

Candidates seeking admission must complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application.

Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed. However, for MTech admission, candidates have to register for GATE first. The qualifying candidates have further applied for COAP and then applied on the official website of IIT Madras to proceed to confirm their admission.
Selection Rounds 2026

For BTech courses, students are selected based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced entrance scores. However, for MTech course, students must have GATE entrance exam scores followed by COAP Counselling. The institute considers IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling for MSc courses. Candidates can check with the admission office for the selection rounds of the rest of the courses.
Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. For merit-based courses, the institute will release a course-wise merit list on the official website. Shortlisted candidates and then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

IIT Madras fee structureincludes tuition fees, library fees, laboratory fees, caution deposit, and more. Some of these charged only once during the admission. The rest are to be paid either semester-wise or yearly as per the institute's guidelines. MTech placement 2025 was also better with average and median package recorded for CS department being 29 LPA and 24.6 LPA. Other than this, the average and median package during MS placement 2025 for CS department was 21.9 LPA and 22.2 LPA.
The median package recorded during the placement drive 2025 for MSc Chemistry and Physics courses was 7.2 LPA and 12 LPA. For MA Humanities course, the average and median package was 17.2 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: Review of facilities and life at IIT Madras.
reviews.review_text: The department building is very spacious with a lot of classrooms and labs. The building is a bit old, so the renovation is being made now. The hostel infrastructure is nice, but there is a bit of a problem with monkeys in one or two of them. The mess food is of nice quality. Food courts are available throughout the day.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus, good placement, good faculty, but hostel alone needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure needs to be improved. We will receive free Wi-Fi throughout. Library and many places are provided for students to study. We have wide options for mess and menu. Canteens are available at low cost without compromising the food quality. Labs are awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life with good placements and strong academic support.
reviews.review_text: Department had good labs, classrooms with AC and projector, and Wi-Fi all around. Library was big with many books. Hostel rooms were fine, and shared type. Mess food was okay, sometimes good, sometimes not. Medical help was available 24X7. Many sports ground and gym were also there. It's quite good.

reviews.review_heading: The best campus in India, and very good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the department and library include Wi-Fi. Everything is good and well. The hostel is maintained well and nicely, with a mess, food, good infrastructure, AC classrooms, and facilitated labs. Medical facilities and sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best college for M.A. In Economics Course.
reviews.review_text: The college is located in the northeast, and connectivity to the rest of India is limited. Thus, there were few female students on campus. Hotels were good. Each student is given an individual furnished room. Each hotel has a mess area, restaurant, and TV room. The food is awesome. It will take some time to adjust the menu for other public school students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely beautiful campus with wildlife.
reviews.review_text: Courses in my branch are difficult; others are pretty okay. Infrastructure depends on the branch you are in. Aerospace has a very mediocre infrastructure. Coming to the hostel, it is okay. I can't describe it as good exactly. Food is edible, extra in the mess would be good, food courts have good food. Medical facilities are good, and they have good sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Life at IITM is like your dream college life.
reviews.review_text: Institute Wi-Fi is present in all public places. Labs and classrooms are very well maintained and mostly air-conditioned. Library is open from 8:00 AM to 11:30 PM, and it is air-conditioned too. Hostel facilities are moderate, and we come to the hostel mostly for sleeping. We stay in the library most of the time. The quality of food available is also moderate. The institute hospital is very good, like a multi-specialty hospital. All types of sports are played here like cricket, football, badmint...

reviews.review_heading: A must experience campus life.
reviews.review_text: All the infrastructure in our department is top-notch, with table Wi-Fi connections, AC classrooms, and lab facilities for various subjects. All the students will be provided with hostels at the time of admission. There are single, double, triple, and quadruple sharing rooms. In each room, a cot, a cupboard, a study table with a chair, a socket, and LAN facilities will be provided. Hostels also have a basketball court, lawns, and various games, including board games. Mess can be selected by the ...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure of hostel is too good and neat and clean. There will be a single room also available in the hostel. Classroom is near and good. 
Labs with all facilities. Library has been quiet and peaceful. Canteen facilities are super on campus and worth money.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, but you need to read and enjoy as well.
reviews.review_text: IIT Madras has good classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, nice labs, and a big library. Hostels are clean with 24-hour water, power, and internet. Mess food is clean and okay, with different food choices. Canteens have many tasty options. There is a free campus hospital and ambulance. Sports grounds, gym, and games are also available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Best college with best placement rates.
reviews.review_text: Best infrastructure I have ever seen in my whole life. Every type of facility is available to students. IITM will give you everything, you just have to study and enjoy on campus. First time you enter the campus, you will find yourself in jungle.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, best college for MS in electrical engineering course.
reviews.review_text: In our college, classrooms were very primitive but labs had all the latest equipment for students from IIT to do their research. The quality of mess food varies greatly depending on where you come from. North Indians find it difficult to change their diet. Hostel furniture was quite outdated. Washing machines were exceptional, and western toilets were never expected.

reviews.review_heading: Life at IITM was lit from 2022 - 2026.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in every hostel. Labs are up to date in equipments and technology. Classrooms are okay, some are without ACs so it gets hot. Mess food is okay in quality. Sports facilities are abundant, and you can play your favourite sport. There is a hospital on campus which is sufficient for mild diseases.

reviews.review_heading: Read this before enrolling in IIT Madras BS degree in data science and application.
reviews.review_text: IIT Madras BS degree in data science and application is an online program that you can study from any location (also from abroad). All course is published prerecorded on the website of IIT Madras. There is a live doubt-solving lecture on Google Meet or Zoom. It is an online program so there is no need to go, it has campus in Madras but the exams are conducted offline. There are various centers for the exam also in other countries. Its fees are affiliated, also there is a scholarship upto 75%. Th...

reviews.review_heading: Very beautiful and calm, has very good faculty, and has all you need,
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch. The hostels could be improved but value for money, the facilities of all the grounds are good and well maintained, has a lot apart from academics, the library is big and has a lot of things, Wi-Fi has some problems now and then but in general it is good enough, quality of food depends on the mess we choose.

paragraphs: IIT Delhi admission 2026is entrance-based for all the courses. The application forms are available on the institute's official website. The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) offers a list of courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral levels. The flagship programme of IIT Delhi is BTech which is offered in 14 different specialisations. Admission to Bachelor of Technology (BTech) is granted based on JEE Advanced followed by JoSAA counselling. Furthermore, MTech, MSc and MDes programmes are offered byIIT Delhithrough the GATE, IIT JAM, and CEED scores.
The seat allotment for BTech, MTech, and MSc courses is carried out through respective counselling bodies. Before applying to a course, the aspirant must carefully check the eligibility requirements.

Candidates applying for IIT Delhi courses must ensure that they are meeting the above-mentioned eligibility criteria. The institute has a multi-step admission process that students must follow to get into the institute. The admission procedure involves registration, entrance exam, shortlisting, release of merit list, counselling, and admission confirmation. Mentioned below in detail is how to get admission to Indian Institute of Technology Delhi:
Step 1: IIT Delhi Application Process 2026

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Delhi are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main, followed byJEE Advancedapplication.

Similarly, forIIT Delhi PG admissions, the IIT-JAM (Joint Admission Test for Masters) application form is required to be completed for the MSc course and likewise other accepted exam applications. Furthermore, apart from exam applications, candidates applying for PhD/PG courses need to apply separately on the IIT-D official website.
Step 2: IIT Delhi Selection Criteria

After the conclusion of the application process, students are required to take the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After which, counselling rounds are carried out for some of the programmes for the seat allotment process.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Candidates selected after all the selection rounds can confirm their admission/seat by paying the required amount ofIIT Delhi fee.

The various components included in theIIT Delhi feesare tuition fees, hostel fees, admission fees, caution deposits, etc. Some of the components are chargeable one-time in the total course fee. placement_data.title: IIT Delhi Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: According to the press report released by IIT Delhi, UG students of the Institute have secured 850 unique offers during the placement drive 2025. The number of unique offer this year has increased as compared with previous three years. Earlier, the number of unique offers made in 2024, 2023 and 2022 was 781, 768 and 712, respectively. The number of unique offers is expected to increase further as the IIT Delhi placement season 2025 is ongoing. Core (Technical) emerged as the top recruiting sector with placement distribution of 34% during IIT Delhi placement 2025. 61% of the students have been placed till date during the 2024-25 placement season. Earlier, IIT Delhi placement rate recorded during placements 2023 was 84.94%. As per NIRF report 2025, IIT Delhi BTech placement rate in 2024 was around 83.5%. Further, IIT Delhi MBA placement rate recorded in 2024 was 100%.

At end of Phase 1 placements 2024-25, a total of 1,200 offers were made and 1,150 students were placed during the Phase 1 of IIT Delhi placements 2025. Further, more than 50 international offers were made during IIT Delhi Phase 1 placements 2024-25. Top recruiters such as BCG, Barclays, American Express, Oracle and PayU offered double-digit offers to UG students.

The median package offered during BTech placements in 2024, 2023, and 2022 were INR 19.08 LPA, INR 20 LPA, and INR 20.5 LPA , respectively. The highest and average package offered to MBA students in 2024 was INR 40.5 LPA and INR 23.4 LPA .

Core (Technical) sector emerged as the top recruiting sector that placed 34% of the total students during IIT Delhi placement 2025. It was followed by IT, Consulting and Management sectors with placement distribution of 20%, 14% and 13%, respectively.

Meanwhile, IIT Delhi alumni network is one of the most active alumni associations of the country that operates through a network of international and national chapters. The alumni association of IIT Delhi has a member strength of 6000 Graduates and is growing at about 2,000 students every year .

reviews.review_heading: Amazing sports and cultural facilities, good placement, and the best place to do startups.
reviews.review_text: The internet is fine, some places have low connectivity, otherwise the internet is good on campus and provides good speed. Hostels are old and worn out, renovation is much needed. The library is amazing, 2 floor library, mess food is good and hygienic. Sports facilities are amazing.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities, and a lot more to explore.
reviews.review_text: Classes in LHC have a beautiful infrastructure well-equipped with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and silent proof. In the central library, you can find almost every book you want to read from your curriculum, as well as books that match your interests. The hostel is decent, we have a basketball court, cricket nets, a badminton court, and a TV room for cultural activities. Apart from that, I would say the mess food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities and quite good alumni connections.
reviews.review_text: We have classrooms that have a digital board and all the basic things. Hostels are also quite good for that price. The mess food is also good, but we get bored due to the repetitive menu. Medical and spirit facilities are also better than any other government college.

reviews.review_heading: Poor hostel conditions, but great library and teaching facilities.
reviews.review_text: The study infrastructure is magnificent. The lecture halls are huge, there is 24/7 Wi-Fi availability and library facilities. Whereas the quality of hostels is not good. It is really crowded as 3-4 students have to live in one room originally made for 2-3. Moreover, the building is old, so it is hard to fit in.

reviews.review_heading: If you are passionate about this course, then join this by clearing the GATE.
reviews.review_text: The gym facility is available inside the campus for hostelers, the cafeteria is also there, and library facilities are also available. They are open till 6 pm every day. The hostel facility is quite affordable, but the buildings are old and in need of significant repair. The mess serves decent food. Wi-Fi all over the campus with cctv security. Classrooms are world-class, all-digital facilities available. The campus is big.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with this college. You have to secure an AIR of 1200 or below to get admission.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure in our course/department include fully air-conditioned rooms, 24-hour Wi-Fi with 250 Mbps speed. The library contains all national and international books. Labs are fully equipped with all required items. The mess and canteen food quality and quantity are very good and affordable.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty in the Civil Engineering is excellent.
reviews.review_text: The department has good labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and access to a well-equipped central library. Hostels have decent rooms, regular cleaning, and basic amenities. Mess food is average, but canteens are better. Medical facilities, sports grounds, and gyms are all reliable.

reviews.review_heading: You should choose this branch if you want to learn other subjects and aim for an IIT college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the campus. Labs and classrooms are dedicated to core textile learning and other open courses for different disciplines. The library runs throughout the year. Hostels are not well-facilitated as they were built in the 1970s. Average food, medical, sports, and games facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: The intern season is good, and the crowd is also good.
reviews.review_text: The college lecture hall complex infrastructure is good. But the hostel conditions are poor, with mediocre food in the mess and poor maintenance. Sports facilities are good throughout the campus. There are some great food outlets.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty, though placements are good.
reviews.review_text: There are enough resources available, such as high-tech labs, good lab staff, large and spacious classrooms, proper ventilation, and good maintenance. The quality of food is very poor. Nobody keeps a check on it. No proper hygiene, sanitation, or food quality checks are done.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Shiksha college submit.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in this course were so good. Wi-Fi, classroom, and labs were provided to all students for learning with practicals. The canteen food was so tasty and healthy. Medical facility was available. Sports and games were so good.

reviews.review_heading: I would say getting admitted to this college is one of the best experiences in your whole life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is always available at 10 Mb/s and it is available 24 hours. Classrooms are fully AC-furnished. Boards and projectors are available in all classrooms. Library facilities are awesome and open atleast 14 hours in normal day, and during exam time for 24 hours. All are very good.

reviews.review_heading: I am decently satisfied with the campus life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available on the campus are quite good. We have Wi-Fi all over the buildings. Almost every classroom and lab has A.C. The facilities provided to us in the hostels are also good. The mess food is decent, and we also have pretty good sports equipment.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of the quality of food and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good. It has full Wi-Fi and various labs. The quality of food is just good. The environmental engineering lab is equipped for analyzing chemical and microbiological contaminants in various media like air, water, wastewater, and soil. It houses advanced instruments such as high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), liquid chromatography time-of-flight mass spectrometry (LC-MS), and gas chromatography-mass spectrometry.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides good placements and internships.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is always on and offers high-speed data nonstop. New labs are well-maintained. Classrooms are also clean, and every room has AC, light, a projector, etc. Medical facilities are free of cost. Mess food is average. Many hostels have night canteens, and they offer tasty food. Sports complexes are well-maintained and spacious for students to play in.

overview_faqs.question: Is there a separate application fee for B.Tech at IIT Bombay apart from JEE Mains fee?

placement_data.title: IIT Bombay Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: According to media reports, the highest package offered during IIT Bombay placements 2025 was INR 2.2 Crore per annum. Further, more than 50 companies participated, and 258 PPOs were offered on Day 1 of IIT Bombay placements 2025.

As of 2024 placement drive, the average salary package offered was INR 23.5 LPA . The median salary package offered was INR 17.92 LPA . IIT Bombay placement percentage recorded was 74.53% , wherein a total of 1,475 candidates participated in the placement process. The number of students registered was 1,979 . 930 students registered, 819 students participated and 683 students were placed during BTech Placements 2024

MBA placement rate recorded in 2024 was 100% . IIT Bombay MBA highest package offered was INR 72 LPA whereas the average package stood at INR 28.01 LPA . During IITB MTech placement drive 2024, 564 students registered, 497 students participated and 415 students were placed.

A total of 1,650 offers were made out of which 78 were international offers during the placement drive 2024. 364 companies visited the campus in 2024 as well. Engineering and Technology sector was the top sector wherein 430 students were placed and 106 companies visited the campus. Download: IIT Bombay Placement Report 2024

reviews.review_heading: IIT Bombay—it's a dream college.
reviews.review_text: There are gyms in every hostel and a central library that is very accessible. They generally close at 11 pm. The cafeteria and canteens are open till 4 am. The classrooms have smart screens, which aid in understanding. IIT Bombay's gymkhana is one of the best and provides room for almost all sports. There are student-run social groups.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied due to the many opportunities present in this college.
reviews.review_text: Every facility, like labs, classrooms, library, hostels, and hostel room are top Notch. Wi-Fi is everywhere. Classrooms are very Big. The hostel quality is very good and a recent hostel with very high quality infrastructure comparable to 3 star Hotel. Food quality is very good but sometimes be dependent on mess to mess of every Hostel. As sometimes the Mess Quality is degraded for Profit. The canteen provides decent quality all year round. Medical services are free for every student and there is...

reviews.review_heading: Excellent placements, world-class faculty, tough but fair academics, & campus life are hard to beat.
reviews.review_text: The academic side is honestly pretty solid. Labs are well-equipped, especially for core branches like CSE, EE, mechanical, and chemistry. We get access to good machinery software and research facilities. Classrooms are great. Library is huge 24/7, and has almost every book we need. Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus but speed drops during peak hours and can be frustrating in hostels. There is new hostel and much better than the old ones. There are big rooms, maintained mess, and games are e...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Bombay dual degree review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi facility is available. Modern classroom and world-class infrastructure. Library with an automated entry and exit system. The hostel quality was like a premium hotel. Mess and canteen food are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Four years  heavenly life.
reviews.review_text: Classroom is fully equipped with Wi-Fi and AC. The college has a central library where all kinds of books are available. The food and other facilities like gym culture room TV room everything is good. Time to time a special dinner is provided in the mess. All states' major festivals are celebrated in college.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life, and you get to work with top professors in varied domains.
reviews.review_text: While new residential buildings are coming up, the existing hostel infrastructure is a bit old, so there are some issues in that regard, and students should be mentally prepared for that. Academic infrastructure, including classrooms, labs, and a library, is at par with what students should expect from a good college.

reviews.review_heading: M.Tech experience at IIT Bombay - Placements, faculty members, and campus life.
reviews.review_text: CSE department boasted world-class facilities with 24X7 Wi-Fi, world-class labs, smart classrooms, and access to a world-class library. Hostels are hygienic with 24X7 internet, clean rooms, and housekeeping. Mess food is hygienic and good with two canteen options. Medical facilities are easily accessible. The campus boasted world-class sports grounds, gym, and recreational facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is good because of the faculty. There are good placements every year.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are very clean. We feel good to spend time there and they are very good. The quality of facilities in our hostel is good. The quality of food in the mess is delicious.

reviews.review_heading: About the dream college, IIT Bombay.
reviews.review_text: The only problem with being at IITB is that hostels were built way back in the 1960s and 1970s. Rooms were originally designed for a single student, but as time passed and the number of students increased, rooms became shared, which is somewhat comfortable. The food is adjustable. The academic infrastructure is excellent. We have Wi-Fi throughout most of the campus. Classrooms are well maintained. The library is big and has many resources. Canteens are affordable, and tasty food is served there.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it offers a fantastic package and there are no problems.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. The hostel has 24x7 electricity with a water supply. A good speed Wi-Fi is provided. The food of the canteen is very good. There are many choices for food. The food is prepared with hygiene and cleanliness.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with every corner.
reviews.review_text: IIT Bombay campus is very big. I got a hostel room for just only Rs. 15 per year and that is pretty good. Rooms in the hostel have almost 150 Mbps Wi-Fi. The food of the canteen is fantastic. There are no charges for the canteen food and sometimes there is no good food in the canteen so we can go to any other canteen on the campus. Free medical facilities and sports are provided to students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management, IIT BombayReviewed on 2 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college has provided decent placements in 2025 despite the bad market.
reviews.review_text: You get to experience campus life at the IIT hostel with excellent sports amenities, and medical facilities. SJMSOM has a separate building with state-of-the-art classrooms and seating facilities. Hostel food is decent enough, and you also have outlets like Chaayos and CCD giving food at subsidized prices for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in India in every field like facilities, placements, research, etc.
reviews.review_text: Top-class facilities are there at IIT Bombay in every field. Our college provides Wi-Fi in hostels, AC classrooms, AC library, many canteens, good quality food and free medical facilities, a top class sports facilities with so many grounds and courts. It even has 3 indoor volleyball courts which is very rare in India.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely the best experience of life with a green campus and the best placements.
reviews.review_text: The overall facilities in classrooms and the library are really good. All classrooms, library, and study rooms are complete equipped with AC, Wi-Fi, and LAN. Overall, hygiene is also maintained everywhere. The hostel facilities vary depending on the year we belong to. The hostel for 1st-year students is really good, with enough space in all rooms and clean. But in our 2nd and 3rd-year hostels, the infrastructure is not good, and the buildings are also old, but hygiene is still maintained. The me...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Bombay review of campus, course curriculum, and placements.
reviews.review_text: IIT Bombay has a central library and a reading hall for 24x7 studying. It has full AC rooms. Wi-Fi is around the whole campus. The department labs are all high-end technical and clean. Faculty members provide full interest to help us learn devices. In hostels, food varieties are immense and there is a 4 meals per day system. The quality of food is good enough and it may seem different in different hostels. Each hostel has its own canteens, with a few of them only open after night.

Apart from its flagship BTech program, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur also offers BSc, MTech, MSc, MDes, MBA, along with a few Dual Degree programmes. faqs.answer: {Source: M.Sc. students & alumni}Based on the feedback from students and alumni, here's what you need to know:Placement and Career Opportunities: * Placement rates are low for M.Sc. students, especially those in Mathematics, with most opting for PhD programs instead. * Fewer companies visit the campus for recruitment, and the ones that do offer lower salaries (around 6-7 LPA). * Coaching institutes are a major employer for M.Sc. students, with packages ranging from 6-10 LPA. * Most students prefer pursuing PhD programs over industry jobs.Infrastructure and Facilities: * Excellent infrastructure, with well-maintained hostels, libraries, and laboratories. * 24/7 high-speed internet connectivity, modern equipment, and air-conditioned classrooms. * Good mess facilities and recreational spaces.Faculty and Curriculum: * Highly qualified and experienced professors with a strong research background. * Relevant and advanced curriculum that prepares students for PhD programs and research careers. * Strong emphasis on practical skills and theoretical foundations.Student Life and Extracurricular Activities: * Campus life is vibrant, with frequent events and festivities. * Freedom to move around the campus and interact with peers from different departments. * Plenty of opportunities for extracurricular activities, sports, and cultural events.In conclusion, pursuing an M.Sc. at IIT Kanpur may not be ideal for students seeking immediate career prospects or high-paying jobs. However, for those interested in academia, research, or pursuing a PhD program, IIT Kanpur offers excellent infrastructure, faculty, and curriculum. Ultimately, the decision depends on your academic goals and priorities.

overview_faqs.question: How much is the IIT Kanpur MBA fee?
overview_faqs.answer: IIT Kanpur MBA total tuition fee ranges between INR 2.8 Lacs and INR 13.1 Lacs as per an unofficial source. The fee excludes admission fee, security deposits, semester fee and hostel charges. There is relaxation in fee for reserved category students. Candidates need to pay fee after completion of the selection rounds, to confirm their seat. Apart from the tuition fee, aspirants need to register with an application fee in the start of the admission process. The application fee is INR 1,600 for General/ OBC (NCL) candidates. The fee is low (INR 800) for SC/ ST/ DAP candidates.

review_summary.college_name: IIT Kanpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: First, clear the CAT, then think about this college.

content.Placements: Placements commence for us in the 3rd semester, and there is a 100% placement rate. Companies like Wells Fargo, McKinsey, Axtria, etc., visit and give about 50+ offers. The highest package is around 24 lac/annum, and the average is about 16 lac/annum. For internships, companies like ICICI Bank and Emphasis visit. The roles offered are diverse, from Data Analyst to Product Management, and the total stipend ranges from 1-200,000 for most internships. It gives the students very good industry exposure.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good. The hostel fee is about 10-15000 for a semester. The library offers a wide range of books from academic to non-academic. We can also make their virtual copy available via the library app and website. The classrooms have AC, a blackboard, & a projector. The IITK offers a wide range of sports, from football, cricket, skating, and boxing etc. Anyone who is interested in any of these activities can come and play.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Mathematics - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: IIT Kanpur College review.

content.Placements: Every single student who went for placement ended up getting a spot in coaching institutes like Physics Wallah and Prutor, with packages typically ranging from about 6 to 7 LPA. When it comes to math, it seems like a lot of folks are looking to pursue their Ph.D., whether in India or overseas, if we are talking placements, Statistics is actually doing better than Mathematics in our department.
content.Infrastructure: Talking about the colleges infrastructure, it includes all the basics, clean water supply, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports, there is also a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students can take advantage of transportation and on-campus housing if they do not have their own rides, the mess is kept clean, and while the food is pretty good, I think adding more choices that students like would be a bonus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied because of faculty members.

content.Placements: The highest package is 9 LPA, and the average package is 7 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. About 60% of the students got placed in our batch. Many reputed companies reached our college campus for recruitment, and several students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms and labs are average and not cleaned on a daily basis. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is not acceptable. Wi-Fi facilities are only for faculty members. The hostel rooms are not so comfortable and very small. Sports and medical facilities are available.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: IIIT Kanpur College review.

content.Placements: Honestly, when it comes to placements for this course, it’s pretty much non-existent. Hardly any companies show up for recruitment. Now, if you look at other courses, though, the situation is much brighter. They actually have solid placement opportunities. And here’s a little silver lining: students from this course can still throw their hats in the ring for placements in those other programs. On average, the packages can reach anywhere from 10 to 15 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The college has pretty solid infrastructure and decent amenities, You know, the on-campus housing is actually quite comfy and well-managed. A lot of students choose to live there. As for the food service, it’s okay, meets the basic standards, nothing fancy.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: IIT Kanpur College review.

content.Placements: In our senior batch, 55 out of 70 students have secured placements so far, with an average package of 15 LPA as a base. The big names hiring include Microsoft, Intel, Flipkart, and Saplabs, among others. As for the roles, we are talking about SDE, data scientists, and cybersecurity engineers. The highest package is 60 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The campus comprises all the required academic and research buildings, a central library, well-equipped labs, and classrooms that have Wi-Fi accessibility. In addition to this, students may use the residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation is generally considered satisfactory. The food in the mess is middling, and the health center is staffed with medical professionals who are there to help if someone falls sick.

faqs.question: How much is the IIT Kanpur MBA fee?
faqs.answer: IIT Kanpur MBA total tuition fee ranges between INR 2.8 Lacs and INR 13.1 Lacs as per an unofficial source. The fee excludes admission fee, security deposits, semester fee and hostel charges. There is relaxation in fee for reserved category students. Candidates need to pay fee after completion of the selection rounds, to confirm their seat. Apart from the tuition fee, aspirants need to register with an application fee in the start of the admission process. The application fee is INR 1,600 for General/ OBC (NCL) candidates. The fee is low (INR 800) for SC/ ST/ DAP candidates.

nirf.description:
Over the years, IIT Kanpur has earned commendable rankings across different domains in the NIRF 2025. This signifies the institution's esteemed reputation and proficiency in various aspects, assigning it an overall good score. It can be seen that the IIT Kanpur's rankings in 'Overall' category have displayed stability in trend as per the ranks of the previous years. In 2025, IIT Kanpur's rank is #5, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
The rankings of the institute in the 'Engineering' category have demonstrated a stable trend when compared to last year's rankings. In 2025, IIT Kanpur's rank is #4, the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
Rankings achieved by the institute under the 'Management' category have exibited a fluctuating trend when compared to last year's rankings. In 2025, IIT Kanpur climbed 2 ranks to #27 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Research Institutions' category, the institute's ranks have exhibited an increasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, IIT Kanpur climbed 1 rank to #6 rank in the 'Research Institutions' category by the NIRF ranking.

qs_world.description:
As per the overall score, IIT Kanpur has been placed at a good position by the QS World University Rankings under the 'Top Global Universities' category, reflecting its exceptional performance in areas like Teaching, Research, Graduation Outcomes, and creating an inclusive, quality learning environment. When compared to the ranking from the previous years, it has been seen that in the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have shown an increasing trend. In 2026, IIT Kanpur climbed 41 ranks to #222 rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
One can observe that within the category of 'Asia', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Kanpur fell 10 ranks to #77 rank in the 'Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
The institute has displayed stability in trend in the 'Southern Asia' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2026, IIT Kanpur's rank is #6, the same as last year's rank in the 'Southern Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.

reviews.review_heading: First, clear the CAT, then think about this college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good. The hostel fee is about 10-15000 for a semester. The library offers a wide range of books from academic to non-academic. We can also make their virtual copy available via the library app and website. The classrooms have AC, a blackboard, & a projector. The IITK offers a wide range of sports, from football, cricket, skating, and boxing etc. Anyone who is interested in any of these activities can come and play.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Kanpur College review.
reviews.review_text: Talking about the colleges infrastructure, it includes all the basics, clean water supply, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports, there is also a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students can take advantage of transportation and on-campus housing if they do not have their own rides, the mess is kept clean, and while the food is pretty good, I think adding more choices that students like would be a bonus.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs are average and not cleaned on a daily basis. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is not acceptable. Wi-Fi facilities are only for faculty members. The hostel rooms are not so comfortable and very small. Sports and medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Kanpur College review.
reviews.review_text: The college has pretty solid infrastructure and decent amenities, You know, the on-campus housing is actually quite comfy and well-managed. A lot of students choose to live there. As for the food service, it’s okay, meets the basic standards, nothing fancy.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Kanpur College review.
reviews.review_text: The campus comprises all the required academic and research buildings, a central library, well-equipped labs, and classrooms that have Wi-Fi accessibility. In addition to this, students may use the residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation is generally considered satisfactory. The food in the mess is middling, and the health center is staffed with medical professionals who are there to help if someone falls sick.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library, and all things are present. The food is very good. Medical facilities are available. Sports and games are also present in the college.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Kanpur for Ph.D. CE and other stream course admission information.
reviews.review_text: In this college, infrastructure is also good because it is a top college for this course. In this college, facilities are provided like classrooms, labs, a hostel, a bathroom, a library, a canteen, an auditorium, a lift, CCTV, etc. Facilities are available. Sports and games facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Kanpur is about admission, campus, faculty, students, and exams.
reviews.review_text: This college provides good facilities such as fast Wi-Fi, Ethernet connections, labs, computers, CCTV, lifts, a campus canteen, and water purifier machines. Sports committees organize many sports and game tournaments, and gym facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: The best four years that I will spend.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is great, and labs are a bit hectic, but the infrastructure is top-class. The library has an occupancy of around 500 students and is a three-storey building. The infrastructure of hostels is quite old, so in the beginning, it might be difficult to live as there is no AC. The food quality in the mess is better than that of any other engineering college. The health centre at IIT Kanpur provides medicine and treatment completely free of cost. The campus provides facilities for all so...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vishnu Shiksha.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are very good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library ,all these things are available in my course. The quality and facilities present in my hostel, including food, are very good. Medical help is also present in this course. Sports and games are available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Shaswat's review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course were super. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and the library were all available. The quality of food in the college canteen was very good. Medical facilities were available. Sports and games were also provided for students at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college, good facilities, enjoyable fests, but hard academics.
reviews.review_text: The lecture halls are excellent, fully furnished, and equipped with AC. There are different labs for various purposes, equipped with computers for student use. A vast library is also available for the use of students and faculty, with a large number of books. The hostel has all the facilities for mess and sports. The quality of food being served in the mess is above average. Medical facilities are also provided on campus, with an ambulance available whenever needed

reviews.review_heading: The culture here is nice, but academics are a bit hectic.
reviews.review_text: We have high-speed Wi-Fi in our hostels, classrooms, and labs. The infrastructure for EE is a bit old, as it is one of the oldest branches, but it's fine. Labs are working well. The quality of food in hostels is fine. Sports here are top tier. Medical facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with services and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very clean and surrounded by plants and trees everywhere. Classrooms and labs are well-maintained and modified with all requirements. A well-stocked library is also available. Multiple sports and medical facilities, along with coaches, are present.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel, library, and classrooms, Wi-Fi is always available. They are very clean and hygienic. Even food tastes like home-made food. Sports and game facilities are available to interested students. We can also develop games by joining clubs which teach these things.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology and Biochemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A land of opportunities where legacy meets innovation.

content.Placements: In Biotechnology almost 70 percent of students got placed. The average package is 6 LPA, the highest is near 12 LPA, the lowest normally differs. Serum Institute of India and Cipla do hire at IITKGP. More than 12 percent of students got an internships. Roles offered are Junior Researcher, Research Associate, and Bioprocess Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The department being one of the most heavily funded and having state-of-the-art technology in the labs students get to work with reliable and modern instruments and labs. The infrastructure offered for the students in the course of biotechnology is very good and one of the best in the country. The quality of food in hostels is fine not too good not dreadful either. The medical facilities are free for students. There are a lot of grounds for each sport and all the sports and games are taught as part of the course that comes under extra academic activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology and Biochemical Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: If you want to go ahead with your dream, then it's your best college.

There were top-level recruiting companies like Bajaj, ISRO, Tata, Apple, and many more. 100 percent of students got internships here. The top roles offered from here were assistant manager, product manager, and CEO.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi was present everywhere. Fully furnished labs, digital classrooms, and a central library were present on the college campus itself. Hostels were of top quality with AC rooms, speed Wi-Fi, clean and green campus, fully styled rooms, and a digital movie theatre.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. (Hons.) + M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Its the top college in India, you have to qualify for this.

content.Placements: The placements in IITKP are very good, as a lot of companies visit due to the placements. The B.Tech students are available to sit for placements in their 4th year, while the dual degree students are available to sit for placements in their 5th year. In my course, the highest package in general lies around 1.5 crores per annum, and the lowest package lies around 10 to 20 LPA. There are five profiles that students choose during placements. The software development is the one I am choosing, and the companies offer, on average, around 20LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities in IITKGP are not up to the mark. The hostels are mostly run based on Hall tempo and bonding. The library here is also one of the biggest libraries of all the IITs, and it has a lot of rooms where you can sit and study. It stays open till 12 o'clock. Almost all of the books are available in the library that you want to read, or it has access to the national digital library, and you can read anything that you want. The facilities of technological aspects are also really good.

eligibility_selection.description: IIT Kharagpur admission is completely entrance-based. Students are selected based on various national-level entrance exams, such as JEE Main, JEE Advanced, and GATE, among others. Indian Institute of Technology (IIT Kharagpur) offers a range of UG, PG, and doctoral courses in Engineering, Management and Science, among others, admission to which is completely an online process conducted via the relevant exam and their conducting bodies. The institute shortlists candidates for admission based on their entrance exam scores. IIT Kharagpur accepts JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced for its flagship BTech course. The institute accepts CAT for MBA and GATE for MTech programmes. Candidates must check and fulfill the course-specific selection requirements for admission. Aspirants must also score equal or aboveIIT Kharagpur cutofffor a seat in the preferred course.

faqs.question: Can I get admission to IIT Kharagpur for BTech in Mechanical Engineering if my rank is under 5000?
faqs.answer: The cut off rank in Round 6 for BTech (Hons) in Mechanical Engineering is 3294 which is very close to this range. This was for general category under All India quota. Unless the candidate belongs to some other category or domicile, one can not afford to score less than this. With this rank, there is a probability of getting admission however since, the cut offs keep changing from round to round, better ranks definitely increases your chances of getting admission in IIT Kharagpur.

faqs.answer: Yes, IIT Kharagpur does accept GATE scores for admission to its M.Tech programme. Applicants must have a valid GATE score relevant to the discipline of their qualifying degree. faqs.question: Is JEE Advanced required for BArch admission at IIT Kharagpur?

faqs.question: Which branch should I choose at IIT Kharagpur? Are the placements better than other similarly ranked IITs?
faqs.answer: IIT Kharagpur, IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati are three similarly-ranked Engineering institutes in India that are closely ranked by the NIRF Ranking Institution. Needless to say, these institutes have outstanding academic and placement achievements. Students look for informed decisions while choosing between the three. In NIRF Engineering ranking 2025 , IIT Kharagpur stands at 5th position, whereas, IIT Guwahati and IIT Hyderabad are ranked at 8th and 7th position, respectively . Thus, indicating a close competition between the three. IIT Kharagpur outshines IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati for having the largest campus area and being the oldest IIT. IIT Kharagpur came into existence in 1951, whereas, IIT Guwahati and IIT Hyderabad were established in 1994 and 2008, respectively. Comparing the institutes on academic grounds, IIT Kharagpur (108) offers a larger number of full-time courses than IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati. In terms of placements, IIT Guwahati has released the overall statistics for BTech. IIT Kharagpur wins the race with the highest package of INR 2.40 crore per annum. The second slot is taken by IIT Guwahati with the highest package of INR 1.20 crore per annum. Then comes, IIT Hyderabad highest package of INR 90 LPA. The table below represents the IIT Kharagpur highest package comparison with other closely ranked IITs for the BTech placements: IIT Name BTech (Highest Package) IIT Kharagpur INR 2.40 crore per annum IIT Guwahati - INR 1.20 crore per annum (domestic) - INR 72 LPA (international) IIT Hyderabad INR 90 LPA Students looking for more elaborated branch-wise placement information can read the below section comparing IIT Kharagpur and IIT Hyderabad. The highest package grabbed by the CE batch 2022 during the IIT Kharagpur phase-I placements was INR 55 LPA. The IIT Hyderabad CE highest package was very close and stood at INR 52 LPA. For other branches, such as CH, CS, EE, and ME, IIT Kharagpur beats IIT Hyderabad in terms of the highest package

nirf.description:
IIT Kharagpur has been ranked well by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for IIT Kharagpur indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. It has been seen that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuating trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, IIT Kharagpur's rank is #6, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Kharagpur's rank is #5, the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Management' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, IIT Kharagpur climbed 7 ranks to #12 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Law' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Kharagpur climbed 1 rank to #6 rank in the 'Law' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.

In the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have improved in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Kharagpur climbed 7 ranks to #215 rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.

reviews.review_heading: A land of opportunities where legacy meets innovation.
reviews.review_text: The department being one of the most heavily funded and having state-of-the-art technology in the labs students get to work with reliable and modern instruments and labs. The infrastructure offered for the students in the course of biotechnology is very good and one of the best in the country. The quality of food in hostels is fine not too good not dreadful either. The medical facilities are free for students. There are a lot of grounds for each sport and all the sports and games are taught as p...

reviews.review_heading: If you want to go ahead with your dream, then it's your best college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was present everywhere. Fully furnished labs, digital classrooms, and a central library were present on the college campus itself. Hostels were of top quality with AC rooms, speed Wi-Fi, clean and green campus, fully styled rooms, and a digital movie theatre.

reviews.review_heading: The best part of my life is spent here at IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: This college's infrastructure and quality of things are very high and provide many facilities to the students. In this course, facilities are available like fast Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, fans, bathrooms, branches, hostels, canteens, etc. In this college, the canteen food is very tasty; it is like homemade food.

reviews.review_heading: Mother of all IITs - IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: State-of-the-art infrastructure is present for all the students. Labs, classes and libraries are best. The hostels can be a little disappointing, the food there is not that good, and it will take time to adjust to the taste of the mess food. But you can always find night canteens and restaurants inside the campus if you want to treat yourself to good food.

reviews.review_heading: Its the top college in India, you have to qualify for this.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities in IITKGP are not up to the mark. The hostels are mostly run based on Hall tempo and bonding. The library here is also one of the biggest libraries of all the IITs, and it has a lot of rooms where you can sit and study. It stays open till 12 o'clock. Almost all of the books are available in the library that you want to read, or it has access to the national digital library, and you can read anything that you want. The facilities of technological aspects are also really good...

reviews.review_heading: An engineering life at IIT Kharagpur is very joyful and good.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are available in our college. Wi-Fi is very good and useful for our academic career. High-speed Wi-Fi is also available at our central library. Hostel facilities are available and comfortable. Hostel food is satisfactory, but it is not good. There are good games to play, like cricket, carrom, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of IIT Kharagpur is very good, as it has high-speed Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi), and it also has many labs that are very good and well-maintained by the college. The mess food is also very good and hygienic, and the hostels are also well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: The IIT Kharagpur infrastructure is old, but it's clean and filled with greenery. All facilities are available in our college, with full speed of Wi-Fi, all resources are available in our college, with full security, and the hostel rooms are clean, and the hostel food is tasty and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Top student in India to get into this college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was world class. This was the best campus in all of India. Classrooms were made fully furnished by the British Empire. All facilities were available in the classrooms. Library is like a university campus, with all types of books in the world available. There are gardens, a swimming pool, different grounds for different sports and many extracurricular activities present. Hostels are very good. Mess food is very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a big place where you can definitely find someone with the same vibe as you.
reviews.review_text:
The Wi-Fi connection is smooth and good, and is available through the hostel's classroom library and even the auditoriums. 
It has one of the biggest libraries, but some books are not so well-maintained. 
The quality of food is enough to survive in terms of taste, but it is also nutritious for the body.
There is a hospital on the campus, which is open 24/7
We have a court for basketball, volleyball and badminton in every respective hall, with the seniors allowing anyone interested to play to go ...

reviews.review_heading: Everything is excellent, only sometimes the infrastructure may seem to be old.
reviews.review_text: The academic section is excellent. Wi-Fi (avg speed 200mbps) is available throughout the whole campus. Hostels are not up to date. In the first year, you will get a triple-sharing room. From the second year, you may get a triple sharing or a single room, depending on the hostel you are allotted. From the third year onwards, you are allotted single rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements but bad gender ratio.
reviews.review_text: There are around 21 hostels in the institute, approximately 16 hostels for boys and 5 for girls. I live in Nehru Hall. This is one of the oldest hostels in IIT Kharagpur. Sundar Pichai also stayed here. There are facilities like Wi-Fi, cooler, geyser, LAN connection, etc. The mess food quality is average, as in most of the hostels. They serve food 4 times a day, 2 heavy meals and 2 light meals. Hostel and mess fees are usually around Rs. 40,000 per semester. There are also gyms, basketball court...

reviews.review_heading: We have the best campus and the largest of all the IITs. Teachers and placements are good.
reviews.review_text: 24/7 Wi-Fi is available with good speed. The Department building is huge, and advanced machinery and devices are present in the lab. There is a Nescafe just outside the department for refreshment, and there is a personal departmental library for the Biotech students.

reviews.review_heading: Great place with decent perks.
reviews.review_text: There is a decent infrastructure and a great place to learn. The library is one of the best of its kind. Hostels are the things that could be better in some way or another. Hostel life is, in another way, mostly beautiful with our people around, and food quality is also good. Need to adjust sometimes.

reviews.review_heading: Perfect regarding semester exams and good regarding infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. But it works slowly in certain places. Labs are good for understanding your interest in the subject. All the equipment present in the lab is also working in good condition. Our classroom complex is named Nalanda, which is very good-looking, and the classrooms are also very good with an AC supply. Medical facilities are free on our campus. Doctors are also good. But it will not be open all the time. If you want to meet the doctor for an emergency situatio...

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Geological Technology - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: Vibrant college life that you'll remember for a lifetime.

content.Placements: Out of 30, 15 got placed, 10 go for off-campus, 5 go for higher studies 30 LPA being the highest, the lowest goes to 10 LPA, and the average is 16 LPA. Companies like Schlumberger, British Petroleum, and mainly recruit for core jobs. Internships are very few, like fewer than 5 students get core internships, and for this also CG should be above 9. Geotechnical roles or office roles also are also offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available throughout campus (except in bathrooms), and every department has well-equipped labs (note that lab supervisors may occasionally give you bad advice, so be cautious). Classrooms also have good infrastructure, including teaching boards and projectors. The library is accessible except at night (it is also open at night during exams). Additionally, there is a 24/7 reading room. New hostels are very luxurious, old ones are decent. The mess food is very good, as there are various options available. The canteen provides a 24/7 menu at a good rate. Medical facilities are provided well, MBBS doctors are available, and with insurance, free medicine and consultation. Every sport has enough sports grounds or courts, and fun games.

placement_data.title: IIT Roorkee Placement Overview 2026
paragraphs: IIT Roorkee placement process 2026 is ongoing and will conclude between April and May , 2026 . During the first two days of Phase 1 placements 2026 , more than 500 offers were made out of which 8 were international offers . Top recruiting sector included Core Engineering, Sustainability , Semiconductor Tech, AI and Data Analytics. Leading recruiters were Amazon, Google, Microsoft , Texas Instruments, DE Shaw, Flipkart.

The average and median package received by CSE students in 2025 was INR 34.05 LPA and I NR 30.5 LPA . The average package received by ECE , Electrical and Civil students during Phase 1 placements 2025 was INR 30.81, INR 28.36 LPA and INR 16.62 LPA . 60 companies visited for SDE roles whereas 32 companies offered PM and Consulting roles during placements 2025 (Phase 1). Further, a total of 201 offers were made to SDE profile whereas 113 offers were made for the PM and Consulting profile . A total of 742 offers were made out of which 222 were PPOs during IIT Roorkee placements 2025 (Phase 1). 163 recruiters participated in the placement season.
During the MBA placement drive 2025 , highest and average package recorded was INR 24 LPA and 17.91 LPA . Median package recorded was 17.64 LPA .

As per the media reports, the highest domestic and international package offered during IIT Roorkee placements 2024 was INR 150 LPA and INR 205 LPA . The average package offered during IIT Roorkee placements 2024 was around INR 20 LPA .

reviews.review_heading: Vibrant college life that you'll remember for a lifetime.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout campus (except in bathrooms), and every department has well-equipped labs (note that lab supervisors may occasionally give you bad advice, so be cautious). Classrooms also have good infrastructure, including teaching boards and projectors. The library is accessible except at night (it is also open at night during exams). Additionally, there is a 24/7 reading room. New hostels are very luxurious, old ones are decent. The mess food is very good, as there are various o...

reviews.review_heading: A beautiful campus that anyone would love.
reviews.review_text: Hostels for first year are decent but those of second, third, and fourth years are not good. The rooms are very small, and the washrooms are not very clean and are sinking too. The classrooms could have been a little better, as even some of their two and three-year ITs have better classrooms, and we do not have any synthetic race track so that's also a loophole. One more thing is that though healthy, the taste of the mess food is not good.

reviews.review_heading: My college campus is very nice.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Our college has the famous James Thomson building, which is famous across the country. The Wi-Fi is very good. Wi-Fi is available in hostels and classrooms. Hostels are better, but three students live in a single room.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best institute.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this course is good for students. Many facilities are provided by this college. It includes all-time Wi-Fi for the university students and faculty. There are many classrooms in this university for students, which are fully furnished and air-conditioned. Many hostels are available for students where students live together. In this university, the medical facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied. Placements are very good, which makes this a perfect Tier 1 college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are excellent, with single rooms available. Classrooms are five-star and fully air-conditioned. The library is impressive, with all types of books available. The food in the mess is very good, fresh, and hygienic. All types of sports are also available.

reviews.review_heading: My journey and experience at IITR.
reviews.review_text: For our department/course, we have fast Wi-Fi, modern labs, smart classrooms, and rich central libraries. Hostel facilities are decent enough with 24/7 internet. Even the mess food is good and decent. Medical centres are always available. Coming to the sports section, it is excellent and well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Overall really good absolutely dissatisfied from mess and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The course structure is very good but it still needs improvement as most of the courses are either related to out of industry knowledge or are completely backward structured. More courses like data structures or a course providing interview knowledge regarding data structures questions being asked in the interview. Classrooms have highly functional Wi-Fi AC and heaters. The library is excellent. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is the worst with a rating of 1 out of 5 stars. The medic...

reviews.review_heading: Excellent but dissatisfied with faculty and course structure.
reviews.review_text: Our department has many facilities including smart classrooms and laboratories. Classrooms are good they have all the facilities but laboratories are still developing. There are some outdated methods that are still being used considering them to be basic experiments. Some of them are really outdated. There is a central library which is very good well maintained. Hostels are good they have many facilities including Wi-Fi gyms canteens and sports rooms. The main problem is the mess it offers reall...

reviews.review_heading: Excellent infrastructure, but dissatisfied with placements and internships.
reviews.review_text: The course is a complete 4 out of 5. Classrooms are amazing with excellent seating, AC, and heaters in winters. The practical labs cater to job-ready skills that mechanical engineers require, such as CAD modeling and sessions on 3D printing. Hostels are 3.5 out of 5 because the management is good, but the rooms could be more modern. The Wi-Fi system and balconies score 5 out of 5. The canteen and mess food are good, both 3.5 out of 5. Medical facilities and sports are excellent, 5 out of 5.

reviews.review_heading: Sometimes, prioritize college over the desire.
reviews.review_text: Departmental infrastructure is average, not like the whole campus, with a limited lab for the core branches. Wi-Fi enabled departments and classrooms are, on average, not equipped with many facilities, like comfortable seating. Libraries are there, which are accessible all the time. Hostel facilities are just okay, it depends on which hostel you are living in. Canteen and mess food have average taste. Sports facilities are there where you can explore all games.

reviews.review_heading: A short review of IIT Roorkee and its earth science department.
reviews.review_text: Department facilities are decent with well-equipped labs, and all the instruments work properly. Classrooms are also mostly tidy. Regarding the hostel, for me it's been 3 years now on the campus so I have experience living in 3 hostels. I think the best one is Jawahar by far in terms of mess, canteen, and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Roorkee - The IIT of your dreams.
reviews.review_text: The whole campus is Wi-Fi equipped. The library and other academic facilities are state-of-the-art. Some hostels are better than others and are good, others are okayish. Mess food is so bad, but breakfast is awesome and nutritional. Sports facilities and gym are top-notch.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the campus and faculty. The core placements are not satisfactory.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. Labs are well-maintained with all the modern equipment. The condition of classrooms of our department is a little bit deteriorated. The mess food is good, and the canteen food is reliable. There are good facilities for sports. Medical facilities are the best, and we can consult a doctor at any time.

reviews.review_heading: World-class infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were of a premium class. Wi-Fi-enabled campus. Modern design library with huge books. The laboratory was also equipped with all the updated instruments and machines. The hostel was also very nice. Multiple sports complexes are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Roorkee IIT for the Post Graduate Diploma in Hydrology course.
reviews.review_text: Our college's infrastructure quality is very good. The college canteen food is also good, very tasty, and hygienic.

likes.text: Labs and lecture halls are equipped with the best facilities for students at IIT Roorkee.
