paragraphs: IIT Hyderabad has a multi-step admission process which students need to follow to get into the institute. The process includes appearing for the relevant entrance exam, application process, counselling and subsequent admission.The JEE Advanced 2025 official website has launched with the new eligibility criteria. As per the official website, candidates can now attempt theJEE Advanced 2025 exama maximum of three times in three consecutive years.A step-by-stepadmission process of IIT Hyderabadis as mentioned below:
Step 1: IIT Hyderabad Application Process

Students interested in getting into IIT Hyderabad can submit the online application form for course-specific entrance exams or college, depending on the course they wish to get into. Students can register to the below-mentioned list to learn about the entrance tests required for some of thepopular IIT Hyderabad courses:
Step 2: IIT Hyderabad University Selection Criteria & Release of Merit List

After completion of the registration process, applicants need to go through the course-based entrance exam, followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are completed, they need to go through the course-wise counselling process for final seat allocation. For aPhD, merit lists are released on the official website (with the names of the shortlisted students).
Step 3: Admission Confirmation at IIT Hyderabad
After completion of the selection rounds, applicants who are shortlisted can submit the admission charges and confirm their admission to the relevant course at IIT Hyderabad.

The IIT Hyderabad's fee varies with the course selected by the candidate. However, the tuition fee for IIT Hyderabad ranges between INR 17,000 to INR 8 lakh. However, the one-time fee of MTech for the year 2022 was INR 19,500 and INR 36,000, respectively. The table below mentions a list of IIT Hyderabad courses along with their seats and fees:

faqs.question: What is the admission process for the B.Tech course at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: The BTech programme at IIT Hyderabad is offered to the students on the basis of their performance in the JEE Advanced examination.Aspirants need to clear JEE Main to be taken into consideration to appear in JEE advanced.JoSAA counselling involves allotment of final seats.The whole procedure is competitive on an entrance basis.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Admission to BTech at IIT Hyderabad requires passing Class 12 in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.Candidateshave to clear JEE Main then perform well at JEE Advanced.Finally setas are alloted throughJoSAA counselling.Other requirements that are necessary include age limit, limit of attempts which is in JEE norms.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for M.Tech at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Students requiring M.Tech in IIT Hyderabad will be required to have an existing degree in BE/BTech or its equivalent as well as a valid and current GATE score.It is also applicable by final-year students.Additional requirements may exist at particular departments.Minimum qualifying marks are based upon specialisation and Category.

faqs.question: How can I apply for M.Tech admission at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: The candidates are required to apply through the portal-CCMT and register through the GOAPS portal to GATE.There might be some departments of IIT Hyderabad also, which might consider direct applications of sponsored, part-time or non-GATE candidates.The process of the application is online.

faqs.question: Is a GATE score mandatory for M.Tech at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Yes, the entry in most M.Tech programs at the IIT Hyderabad requires a valid score in GATE.But the institute can give exceptions of candidates not selected in GATE but can be eligible based on special categories such as sponsored seats or working professionals in the internal evaluation process.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BDes at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: To apply to BDes in IIT Hyderabad the students must have cleared Class 12 in any discipline with qualified marks and must appear in UCEED.The admission is made based on the UCEED rank.There are also an attempt and age restriction according to UCEED instructions.

faqs.question: What entrance exam is required for BDes at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: BDes is offered by IIT Hyderabad which is now conducted using the Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design (UCEED).The test focuses on the aspects of design aptitude, creativity, logical thinking ability, and visual perception ability.The obtained rank is used in counselling and seat allocation.

faqs.question: Is there an interview for B.Des admission at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: No, IIT Hyderabad does not have a dedicated interview round in case of BDes admission.The process of selection is exclusively made on the UCEED rank and centralized seat allocation.To confirm the admission then candidates are supposed to meet eligibility criteria and pass through the processes of counselling.

placement_data.title: IIT Hyderabad Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: A total of 389 students registered and 374 students were placed during IIT Hyderabad placement 2025. 353 companies registered out of which 17 were international companies . More than 710 offers were made out of which 53 were international offers . A total of 130 PPOs were made during IITH placement 2025. The highest and the average package stood at INR 128 LPA and INR 33.96 LPA, respectively.

For the IIT Hyderabad placements 2024, the highest package given was INR 90 LPA and the average package received was INR 22.5 LPA. For the MSc and MTech program, the highest package stood at INR 58 LPA. A total of 521 offers were made by 320 companies. BTech, MTech and PhD program placement rate was 86.67%, 76.47% and 100% , respectively. At the end of season 2024, a total of 493 students were placed, and 43 international offers were seen.

Moreover, the highest stipend offered during summer internships for the batch 2023-2024 was INR 2 lakh per month and the average stipend stood at INR 79,000 per month . The total count of summer internships was 159 and semester internships was 73 .

In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Hyderabad's rank is #12, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, IIT Hyderabad climbed 1 rank to #7 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
It can be seen that; in the 'Research Institutions' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Hyderabad's rank is #15, the same as last year's rank in the 'Research Institutions' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Innovation' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Hyderabad fell 3 ranks to #6 rank in the 'Innovation' category by the NIRF ranking.
Discover the latest rankings and categories provided by other ranking bodies listed below.
Read less

qs_world.description:
IIT Hyderabad has been ranked well by the QS World University Rankings under the 'Top Global Universities' category. Through the years, the QS World University Rankings for IIT Hyderabad indicate the institute's strong performance in important areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's good reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the QS World University Rankings. It has been seen that in the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have shown an increasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2026, IIT Hyderabad climbed 17 ranks to #664 rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Asia', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Hyderabad climbed 50 ranks to #270 rank in the 'Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Southern Asia' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2026, IIT Hyderabad climbed 21 ranks to #60 rank in the 'Southern Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.

Track for running, basketball court, tennis co...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Hyderabad is a good college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the most beautiful and best thing I liked. All buildings have a form of Japanese infrastructure. The maintenance of the hostels is so poor. The food in the mess is not very good. It is not so spicy, and mainly, South Indians don't like the food. The library is very good and very accessible. reviews.review_heading: It has good placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, and we cannot complain. Labs are very nice and have all the equipment. There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. The hostel is also very nice and clean. There are nice rooms in the hostel and hot water facilities. It is good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Hyderabad College.
reviews.review_text: In spite of the college's overall infrastructure being just alright, the campus-wide Wi-Fi, well-used labs, comfortable classrooms, and extensive library become a great source of satisfaction. The vast array of textbooks and other materials available on campus removes the necessity for students to buy many of the resources from outside. Students can also avail themselves of transportation and on-campus housing facilities in case they do not have their own vehicles. The mess is clean, and if we t...

reviews.review_heading: Campus Life at IIT Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our course is also very nice. Our department consists of a building in which most of the rooms belong to labs. In every room, you will get free Wi-Fi. The canteen will serve at least five items per day, and the taste is also very nice.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities were world-class, and every student would love to get such world-class facilities. Buildings were seven-storeyed hostels. All kinds of sports grounds and well-furnished. A multipurpose gym was well-built. Music and recreation rooms were well built. Huge stages and open stands were ultimate open places. Course curriculum was very simple in our college. Our college followed fractal academics which help students to easily cope up with their studies while doing other activities. So...

reviews.review_heading: Awesome infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is excellent, spacious, and has charming architecture. There are single rooms for 2nd years and above. The food in the mess is good too with lots of variety even if it tends to get boring after a while. The library is also known as the Knowledge Research Center. It is very big with lots of books and e-resources. Labs are equipped with the best possible and updated equipment. The Wi-Fi is super fast here, in the full campus.

reviews.review_heading: Indian Institute of Technology has the best architecture.
reviews.review_text: IIT Hyderabad's 576-acre campus features sustainable architecture, single-occupancy hostels with radiant cooling, diverse dining options, and modern sports facilities. The college has a well-equipped gym, 24/7 medical services, banking, and a supermarket. It ensures a holistic student experience.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Hyderabad: The Dream College.
reviews.review_text: Since the hostels for the UG students were recently constructed they are neat clean and spacious. There is also the facility of radiant cooling which is a game change in the scorching heat of Hyderabad. The sports complex offers a wide range of sports facilities which are world-class. Though the mess food is hygienic and nutritional but the taste is not so good.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Hyderabad and its beauty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and the infrastructure is inspired by Japanese architecture. There is unlimited Wi-Fi on the campus, and classrooms are well-air-conditioned. The hostel rooms use radiant cooling techniques. The mess food is good in the canteen, and get everything we need.

reviews.review_heading: IITH - The next best IIT in India.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in IITH is just amazing. Many buildings here are inspired by Japanese architecture. Classrooms are vast, modern, and equipped with ACs. Hostels are new and clean. All the facilities provided are worth every penny paid. Mess food is also great but everyone may not like it. There are canteens and cafeterias with many eateries.

reviews.review_heading: The highest-growing IIT is IIT Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: All types of facilities are provided in IITs. IITH also has all types of facilities. IITH have one of the best architecture in India inspired by Japanese architecture. It has all types of labs, research facilities, and full Wi-Fi all over the campus. The mess, canteen, medical facilities, and sports are the best in India.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied & amazed by the awesome infrastructure, but would have loved some more greenery on campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-class. We have 10-floor hostel buildings with single-sharing rooms equipped with a radiant cooling system. The rooms are of single occupancy. The campus has multiple department buildings, and every building is unique and magnificent. The library is also very huge, with a lot of study rooms, discussion rooms, study tables, etc. The food in the mess is also quite satisfactory. The quality is good, and they have a fixed weekly menu. Each room in the hostel has a LAN port, ...

reviews.review_heading: IITH is one of the best campuses for research and it is the fastest-growing IIT.
reviews.review_text: Here we will get all the facilities in a good manner like Wi-Fi, classrooms and library. The library is one of the best places to enjoy on campus. Mess food is not up to the mark. We have good sports facilities. The canteen is also good. There are around 20 hostels.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Hyderabad boasts excellent placements and a fantastic infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are first-rate, including first-rate labs and amenities like Wi-Fi. The library is excellent, and the classrooms are spacious. Additionally, the college offers hostel accommodation where we may eat well. Compared to the canteen, the mess is clean and has a wider selection of food. Sports and games materials and activities are offered, as are medical amenities.

college_info.intro:
IIT Guwahati flagship courses are BTech and MTech. The institute offers 4-year BTech and BDes across various specialisations. Both BTech and BDes courses are for 8 semesters. At the PG level, IIT Guwahati courses include a 2-year MTech across 9 departments, a 2-year MDes, a 2-year MS (by Research), and a 2-year MA course. All the PG courses are for 4 semesters. IIT Guwahati Assam, offers PhD courses across 11 departments, 6 centres, and two joint PhD courses. Also, the institute offers dual degrees such as MTech+ PhD in Computer Science & Engineering and MS (Engineering) + PhD in Electronics and Electrical Engineering. placements.overview:
IIT Guwahati offers a wide range of programmes to students at the UG, PG and PhD levels. The college has Engineering, Science, Management, Design, Business Administration, etc. branches. The Guwahati IIT Campus courses are offered to students under 11 constituent departments, 4 interdisciplinary schools, and 5 centres.

The institute offers several UG courses such as BTech, BSc, BDes, etc. Moroever, PG courses include MSc, MTech, MBA, MA, MS and MDes. These courses are offered to students in full-time mode and across several branches such as Civil Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electronic Product Design, Computer Science and Engineering, and many more. review_summary.college_name: IIT Guwahati Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biosciences and Bioengineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is fun. Whatever you want, you will get in college. Just enjoy.

content.Placements: 70 percent of students from our college are placed. Many went for an MBA, research, Ph.D., and some went for government exam preparation. The average package is 18 LPA. For my branch average package is 16 LPA, and the placement percentage is about 66 percent. All the top companies that you think will be present.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities available here are quite good. You will get Wi-Fi in class room, lecture hall, labs, and library. You will have a reading room in your respective hostel, also with full AC and Wi-Fi. Hostel food is okay, not that great, and the washrooms for a few hostels are neat and clean, while for some are dirty.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Science and Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has an amazing infrastructure infused with greenery.

content.Placements: Top recruiting companies for our course, like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, JP Morgan Chase, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, Schlumberger, HPCL, and Piramal, frequently hire students from this branch. Approximately 60-85 percent of students secure internships, primarily starting in their third year. Companies offering internships are Google, Microsoft, Uber, Amazon, and core firms like Hilabs. Monthly stipend offered to top roles can exceed up to 1 lakh per month, and internship up to 85 percent. In the B.Tech. in Chemical Science and Technology course 2025, the lowest salary package offered is 8 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 18-22 LPA. The highest salary package offered is 54 LPA. The placement percentage is 70 percent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good campus life and infrastructure, no city life, good mess and food counter.

content.Placements: Very nice placement. A different body is framed every year to organise the placement and accommodation related to all the companies and organisations. Good overall placement and packages. A lot of companies come to recruit for different roles, and the lowest package is above 12 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Good sports facility. Average facility for accommodation and training. Nice infrastructure for classrooms. Good libraries. Low-speed Wi-Fi services in the classroom and hostel. All types of sports equipment are available in or out of the hostel. Nice and clean mess service.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Science and Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Outstanding campus life with satisfactory placements and nice infrastructure.

content.Placements: In 2025, the placement percentage of my branch (Chemical Science and Technology) is about 81 percent. The highest package is 85 LPA, the lowest is 8 LPA, and the average is 21 LPA. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Infosys, Tata, etc., offer jobs to us. Around 50 percent of students of each batch get an internship, but it primarily depends on an individual's skills.
content.Infrastructure: There is an academic complex consisting of 5 different scores numbered from 1 to 5. The campus is 700 acres with a central library, 5 lakes, 2 guest houses, 13 active hostels, and 1 closed hostel. The classrooms have proper sitting arrangements, AC, Wi-Fi, plug-in boards, and lots of other facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Highly satisfied with the teaching and environment of the campus.

content.Placements: 92 percent are placed. The highest is 90 LPA and the lowest is 6 LPA and the average is around 30 LPA. Large tech and Ai based companies. Around 60% got internships in tech and ai based companies like Google, Microsoft and Amazon. A data scientist is a top role in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Free Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the campus. Labs were maintained properly with the required equipment. Classrooms were clean and well maintained with advanced facilities like projector screens. Libraries are available any time with all availability of sufficient books. Good quality food in the hostel. Excellent sports and medical facilities.

The admission process at
IIT Guwahati Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Guwahati are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed.
Selection Rounds

IIT Guwahati selects students based onJEE MainandJEE Advanced scores for the BTech course. Admission to MTech is through GATE followed by COAP Counselling. The institute considers IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling for MSc courses. Candidates can check with the admission office for the selection rounds of the rest of the courses.
Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

IIT Guwahati cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. For merit-based courses, IIT Guwahati will release the course-wise merit list on its official website. As per the merit list, candidates are called for counselling for seat allotment. Shortlisted candidates and then required to payIIT Guwahati feeto confirm their seats.

placement_data.title: IIT Guwahati Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The IIT Guwahati placement report for 2025 has been out on Official website. According to the report, IIT Guwahati recorded a placement rate of 62%. The highest package reached INR 1.25 crore per annum during IIT Guwahati placements. A total of 1,606 students registered out of which 1,001 were placed during IIT Guwahati placement season. The total number of male students registered was 1,270 while the number of female students registered was 336 . Out of the total 1001 students placed, 791 were male and 210 were female.

IIT Guwahati has Centre for Career Development. The department has all the placement facilities to support students in each stage of the recruitment process. The placement process at IIT Guwahati includes pre-placement talks, Skill assessment, Group Discussions, technical interviews, face-to-face interviews, etc.

reviews.review_heading: College is fun. Whatever you want, you will get in college. Just enjoy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities available here are quite good. You will get Wi-Fi in class room, lecture hall, labs, and library. You will have a reading room in your respective hostel, also with full AC and Wi-Fi. Hostel food is okay, not that great, and the washrooms for a few hostels are neat and clean, while for some are dirty.

reviews.review_heading: It has an amazing infrastructure infused with greenery.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are superb. Wi-Fi problem persists. The library is peaceful, and books are available. Facilities are excellent. The mess provides quality food. Lohit hostel has the best canteen on the whole campus. Free medical facilities are available on campus till 8 PM. Sports facilities are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life and infrastructure, no city life, good mess and food counter.
reviews.review_text: Good sports facility. Average facility for accommodation and training. Nice infrastructure for classrooms. Good libraries. Low-speed Wi-Fi services in the classroom and hostel. All types of sports equipment are available in or out of the hostel. Nice and clean mess service.

reviews.review_heading: Outstanding campus life with satisfactory placements and nice infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: There is an academic complex consisting of 5 different scores numbered from 1 to 5. The campus is 700 acres with a central library, 5 lakes, 2 guest houses, 13 active hostels, and 1 closed hostel. The classrooms have proper sitting arrangements, AC, Wi-Fi, plug-in boards, and lots of other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Highly satisfied with the teaching and environment of the campus.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the campus. Labs were maintained properly with the required equipment. Classrooms were clean and well maintained with advanced facilities like projector screens. Libraries are available any time with all availability of sufficient books. Good quality food in the hostel. Excellent sports and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College of dreams  IIT Guwahati.
reviews.review_text: Everything is great when it come to the infrastructure of ocre building and hostel, AC ducted classes, library can be accessed till 2pm, LAN in rooms and Internet Wi-Fi throughout. On the campus most of the places, there are large grounds for sports and a new, big building for tech related things.

reviews.review_heading: It is far better than your thoughts.
reviews.review_text: Labs, library, Wi-Fi facility are available, food quality is good in the mess and canteen. The medical facilities and hospital are also available in the college, which also has a sports facility that is very good, as almost all sports grounds are available like cricket, football, squash etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is IIT and one of the top 7 in them, and it will not disappoint our expectations.
reviews.review_text: Almost all facilities are good. Wi-Fi is currently not available in every room, but there are Ethernet connections. Soon, it will implement Wi-Fi in every room. The food served is reasonably fine, and it provides a healthy option. For facilities like medical, sports, and games, there is no compromise here.

reviews.review_heading: It is the most prestigious campus in India.
reviews.review_text: The civil engineering department at IIT Guwahati is well-equipped with modern infrastructure that supports both academic learning and research activities. The entire campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled, providing high-speed internet access in classrooms, laboratories, hostels, and common areas, which is extremely helpful for research work and software-based learning. Our department consists of various labs like the structural engineering lab, geotechnical engineering lab, transportation engineering la...

reviews.review_heading: This college gives an enormous amount of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the lecture hall, lab, and hostel rooms is quite good. Hostels have double occupancy for first and second-year students and single occupancy for third and fourth-year students. The lecture hall and lab are fully Wi-Fi connected. We have two types of library: one in central and the other one in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Gems of knowledge reside in the beauty of nature.
reviews.review_text: All the classes and labs have Wi-Fi facilities. There are also AC facilities, and the cleanliness in classes and labs was very good. In the hostel, food was not that good, but average. Academic and sports facilities at the hostel were good. Medical facilities were also good, in case of emergency, an ambulance is always ready to move in.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is aesthetic with quite interesting personalities around us.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good. IIT Guwahati is known for its lush green campus and lakes. The campus is aesthetic, and it feels like we are on a trip. Classrooms are nice and clean and well-equipped with Wi-Fi. Moreover, the library is also good with a good AC.

reviews.review_heading: It offers good placements. It has the most beautiful campus among all 23 IITs.
reviews.review_text: All things are so good. The infrastructure of the Indian Institute of Technology, Guwahati, is very nice. In our classrooms, Wi-Fi does not work properly. Classrooms are very good with proper working AC. The quality of food is very good. Medical facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Guwahati is a diamond that needs a jeweler.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good, but one problem is that in single occupancy, we have two students, which is not as bad as other IITs out there, so I am not disappointed. Wi-Fi connection is working nicely, and many students complain about the Wi-Fi. I don't know about them, as in my hostel, it is working properly. Labs are nice, and classrooms are fantastic. The library needs a bit of modification. We have 14 hostels. Some mess facilities are good. Medical facilities need improvement, but the rest of the thin...

reviews.review_heading: The most beautiful campus.
reviews.review_text: The classroom complex is great, but the quality of food in the mess is not good; there is more masala in the buttermilk than in the food. There is a hospital inside the campus, and another one is being built. There are 2 big sports complexes on the campus and many sports clubs.

college_info.intro:
NIT Trichy popular programmes are BTech and MTech. BTech is given in nine specialisations for a four-year duration spread over eight semesters. NIT Trichy BTech in Computer Science and Engineering students can look for career opportunities and can become Computer Engineers, Testing Engineers, Multimedia programmers, Full Stack Developers, and others. After doing a BTech in Civil Engineering, students will gain the ability to implement infrastructure development by using various sustainable technologies and materials.
NIT Trichy's MTech programme is a two-year postgraduate programme given in 23 specialisations. Some of the specialisations in which MTech is taught are Geotechnical Engineering, Thermal Power Engineering, VLSI Systems, and others. NIT Trichy is ranked 9th under the Engineering category. Also, NIT Trichy students are placed in top companies such as Google, Infosys, Facebook, Oracle, ITC, Intel, and others. Overall, the National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli is one of the best colleges offering one of the best Engineering programmes to students. fees_and_eligibility.overview:
Candidates must apply online on the official website of NIT Tiruchirappalli for admission. NIT Trichy gives four-year BTech and five-year B.Arch courses at the UG level. The university provides two-year MTech, NIT Trichy MBA , MCA at the PG level. The university also provides 17 PhD courses to students.

NIT Trichy offers BTech in specialisations such as Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, , etc. NIT Trichy offers PhD in Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Production Engineering, etc.

faqs.answer: A:     To get admission to M.Tech at NIT Trichy, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria. Aspirants need to be graduated with minimum 60% aggregate with BE/BTech from a recognised University. Admission is conducted based a valid GATE score. The applicant further must submit the documents at the time of form filling and admission procedure as a proof of eligibility.
faqs.question: Who is eligible for M.Tech at NIT Trichy?

faqs.answer: A:    No, there is not provision of direct admission to M.Tech at NIT Trichy. Aspirants must appear and qualify for GATE exam with a valid score. Other than this, candidates must pass graduation with minimum 60% aggregate in order to apply for this course. The final seat allocation is done through CCMT Counselling process. All these steps are mandatory to get admission to NIT Trichy M.Tech course.
faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to M.Tech at NIT Trichy without GATE?

faqs.answer: A:    As per the NIT Trichy MBA brochure, the institute and hostel fees for the Open and other category students is INR 4.35 Lacs approximately. The institute and hostel charges for SC/ST category are INR 3 Lacs approximately. The tuition fee for a two-year MBA course as per unofficial sources is INR 1.4 lakh. Students should visit the official website to find out more about the fee structure.
faqs.question: What is the fee structure of MBA in NIT, Trichy?

The total fee for MBA at NIT Trichy is INR 1.4 lakh. So prepare well in advance for a successful admission to MBA course at NIT Trichy.

reviews_list.review_title: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of placements in our course is really nice, it is more than (94)%. Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Micron, Synapse, Google, Amazon, Oracle, TCS, Wipro, Bajaj, etc. (These are mixed companies for electronics, software, and electrical). Chip designer, electro manager, developed (to be honest, I don't know much about the role they offer). The highest and lowest salary is average.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quality is good). But North-Indians may not like the taste initially.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.

review_content.Placements: Now I am a fresher here. If we look at the placements at NIT Trichy, they are amazing. To be honest, I am from the Civil Engineering branch, so we cannot expect high packages, but our seniors get into many PSUs. The alumni here help the most with placements. Last year, nearly 78% of students were placed in my course. The highest package is 34 LPA and 20 LPA for core jobs.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

course_faqs.question: Is MBA available in NIT Trichy?
course_faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Trichy offers a two-year MBA course via the Department of Management Studies. The DoMS-NIT Trichy is funded by the Ministry of HRD. Eligible candidates can visit the official website of NIT Trichy (nitt.edu) and fill an online application form along with submitting the relevant documents to apply. The Management degree course is available in seven specialisations, including Marketing, Finance, Human Resource Management, etc. Click here to find the details around NIT Trichy MBA course.

course_faqs.question: How is DoMS-NIT Trichy for MBA?
course_faqs.answer: NIT Trichy offers a full-time two-year MBA course via its Department of Management Studies. NIT Trichy is the only institute among other NITs, which is funded by the Ministry of HRD. As per observing the ranking trends for the Management category course offered at NIT Trichy, it was 39 in the year 2022, whereas it improved in the year 2023 and ranked 35 by NIRF. Further, the placement rate for MBA went up to 96.8% in the year 2022. Overall, DoMS NIT Trichy is a decent choice for pursuing MBA.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Trichy Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure, but a bad climate in the summer. There are exceptional peers.

content.Placements: I'm not sure about the percentage of students who got internships or placements. I suggest that students just check it out on the college website. It is legitimate. But to be frank, the packages offered in core, as I know, in production are very few. But this branch is special in offering the connection between management and technical fields. Excellent packages and placements are available in non-core fields, especially consulting and management. The branch is a chill one, which offers ample time for studying anything or extracurricular activities.
content.Infrastructure: The library facility, octagon, or if I say anything in the college, is just on a different level, except for hostels. Being a college affiliated with NIRF 9, we expect much better from their side in hostel management. There is no responsibility on their part if a theft happens. Actually, two laptops were stolen. The library must have a proper internet connection, which is bad. The hostel is improving right now with proper renovation after our complaints. It serves very good mess food. I'll say much better than any college. Since I've been in some.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has one of the best placement records. Classes are a bit hectic, but overall, it's good.

content.Placements: There is an 80 percent placement rate in B.Tech civil engineering. The lowest package offered is 3 LPA, and the highest package offered is 33 LPA. For tech fields, companies like Microsoft and Google, and for core companies like Dalmia, ACC Cement, L&T, etc., hire students. Internships are not very common in this branch, so we have to fight a bit more compared to other branches.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and mess facilities are among the best across all NITs and IITs. We have high-speed Wi-Fi in each room. The mess food is great compared to other top colleges. There is a curfew for first-year boys. For girls, it is for all four years. We have an NIT Hospital for medical issues or emergencies. NIT Trichy has one of the top sports infrastructures.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.

content.Placements: The percentage of placements in our course is really nice, it is more than (94)%. Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Micron, Synapse, Google, Amazon, Oracle, TCS, Wipro, Bajaj, etc. (These are mixed companies for electronics, software, and electrical). Chip designer, electro manager, developed (to be honest, I don't know much about the role they offer). The highest and lowest salary is average.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quality is good). But North-Indians may not like the taste initially.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.

content.Placements: Now I am a fresher here. If we look at the placements at NIT Trichy, they are amazing. To be honest, I am from the Civil Engineering branch, so we cannot expect high packages, but our seniors get into many PSUs. The alumni here help the most with placements. Last year, nearly 78% of students were placed in my course. The highest package is 34 LPA and 20 LPA for core jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The institute offers strong academics and campus life, with scope for better industry exposure.

content.Placements: CSE / IT placements are around 95–100%, while the overall placement percentage at NIT Trichy is above 90%. The highest package offered is 45–55 LPA from international and top product companies, the average package is 25–30 LPA, and the lowest package is 6–8 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, and the major roles offered are Software Development Engineer (SDE), Backend / Full-Stack Developer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, and AI Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The campus provides 24×7 high-speed Wi-Fi across academic blocks and hostels. Laboratories consist of computer labs with high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. They are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and audio systems.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Trichy for BTech?
faqs.answer: For admission in a BTech course at NITT, candidates shall have a valid score of JEE Main. Candidates with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks further becomes eligible for participation in the JoSAA counselling round. If the seats are left vacant after this round, then those are filled through the CSAB counselling. Candidates who pass Class 12 in Science stream wtih PCM/ PBM subjects are eligible to apply for this course.

faqs.question: Is JEE Main required for NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: Admissions to NIT (National Institute of Technology), Trichy is Entrance Based for almost all of the courses. The college accepts different exam scores for different levels of courses. Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Mains is necessary for admissions to the undergraduate engineering programs, B.Tech which offers 8 courses and B.Arch which offers 1 course. Admissions are based on the marks scored in class 12thor equivalent as well as the JEE (Main) examination. Seats are allocated to students through Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA), Central Seat Allocation Board (CSAB) and the Direct Admission of Students Abroad (DASA).

faqs.question: Who is eligible for MCA at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: To get admission to MCA course at NIT Trichy, students must be graduated with minimum 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA in BSc/ BSc (Hons)/ BCA/ BIT with Mathematics/Statistics/Equivalent subject as one of the subjects. Students who are graduated with BE/B Tech or equivalent from a recognised University can also apply for this course. However, a five percent of relaxation is give to candidates who belong from SC/ ST categories. These candidates are required to obtain minimum of 55% or 6.0 CGPA in their respective graduation. Based on the eligibility requirements, candidates will be shortlisted for other selection rounds.Click hereto know about the detailed NIT Trichy MCA admission process.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, but a bad climate in the summer. There are exceptional peers.
reviews.review_text: The library facility, octagon, or if I say anything in the college, is just on a different level, except for hostels. Being a college affiliated with NIRF 9, we expect much better from their side in hostel management. There is no responsibility on their part if a theft happens. Actually, two laptops were stolen. The library must have a proper internet connection, which is bad. The hostel is improving right now with proper renovation after our complaints. It serves very good mess food. I'll say m...

reviews.review_heading: It has one of the best placement records. Classes are a bit hectic, but overall, it's good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and mess facilities are among the best across all NITs and IITs. We have high-speed Wi-Fi in each room. The mess food is great compared to other top colleges. There is a curfew for first-year boys. For girls, it is for all four years. We have an NIT Hospital for medical issues or emergencies. NIT Trichy has one of the top sports infrastructures.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quali...

reviews.review_heading: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

reviews.review_heading: The institute offers strong academics and campus life, with scope for better industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides 24×7 high-speed Wi-Fi across academic blocks and hostels. Laboratories consist of computer labs with high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. They are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and audio systems.

reviews.review_heading: It is a fine college if you take higher branches like ECE, CS, EEE, mechanical, and chemical.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are above average. Wi-Fi is installed in every room, now no problem with Wi-Fi. Quality of the hostel is good. Mess food is also good. Here they emphasize sports and extracurricular activities also. They also organise events, guest lectures, and workshops.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life and experience in NIT Trichy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Classes for all department students occur in academic blocks like Orion and Logos, but we suffer in summer due to the high temperature of Trichy. The hostel facilities are also quite good. Every room has Wi-Fi. This year, they also introduced washing machines, which are on a pay-and-use system. I give 3/5 for the food because the taste does not seem good, and the varieties are also repeated. You can find many canteens, and you can also find Domino’s and CCD. The ...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure but disappointing in some aspects.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice. Hostels are not that much good as their NIRF is 9 but not too bad, it's okay to have such a hostel. College infrastructure is very nice. Library is also good. Food is not good in the first year but for North and South people they have different messes in college.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the course.
reviews.review_text: Almost everything is right in its place. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel rooms with routers in each room. paragraphs: IIT BHU, Varanasi admission process is a multiple-step process. Students can check the points below to know more:
1. IIT BHU Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission at IIT BHU are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main, followed by the JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, the IIT JAM application form is required to be completed.
2. IIT BHU Selection Criteria 2025

After the conclusion of the application process, students are required to take the course-specific entrance exam, followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After which, counselling rounds are carried out for some of the programmes for the seat allotment process.
3. Admission Confirmation
Candidates selected after all the selection rounds can confirm their admission/seat by paying theIIT BHU fee.

IIT BHU Varanasi feeis a cumulative of various components such as tuition fee, hostel fee, library deposit, training and placement fee, etc. The following sections mention theIIT BHU fee breakup and seat intakefor the offered courses.

faqs.question: What are the essential qualifications for admission to BTech course at IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: IIT Varanasi BTech admission is based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced. Students qualify Class 12 from the recognised board with 75% marks for general category and 65% marks for SC/ ST. PwD candidates.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BTech admission at IIT (BHU)?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission into BTech programme of IIT (BHU), a candidate should have passed Class12 with a minimum of 75 percent in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.They have to as well pass the JEE Main and JEE Advanced exams.Selection and JoSAA counselling is done by JEE Advanced rank.Counselling is only an option to those who meet all the criteria.

faqs.question: Does IIT BHU offer BTech integrated courses?
faqs.answer: IIT BHU does provide combined programmes of BTech and M.Tech in many specialisation.These programmes enable the students to pursue both their undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in a combined format.The admission requirements to such integrated courses frequently have a minimum of 75% board examination marks (or equivalent) in Class 12 (or equivalent) besides other conditions.

courses_data.description: Indian Institute of TechnologyBHU offers a two-year MTech programme, which is spread across four semesters. BTech graduates, fulfilling the eligibility criteria can apply for any of the seven MTech specialisations.IIT BHUMTech admission is through the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE). Candidates shortlisted based on exam scores have to further go through COAP counselling for final seat allotment. Read on to know more about IIT BHU MTech.

faqs.question: Can I do MTech at IIT BHU without GATE?
faqs.answer: As part of the admission procedure, the prospective candidates must also take a Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE).However, BTech qualified in IITs with an overall CGPA of 8.00 or above in 10 point scale are exempted with regard to the GATE and are directly eligible to the process.It is also worth mentioning that the minimum eligibility requirements are as well mandatory to the candidates who would like to join IIT BHU MTech programme in 2025.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to the M.Tech programme at IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for the M.Tech programme at IIT BHU the aspiring candidates need to have a minimum of 60% in BTech. Aspirants with a score equal to or more than the cutoff also have to go through a counselling round. Once selected, aspirants have to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for M.Tech course at IIT Varanasi?
faqs.answer: The application fee for the Master of Technology course at IIT Varanasi is similar to the application fee for GATE. This year, the application fee for the GATE goes slighltly higher. paragraphs: IIT BHU placement report 2026 is released. As per the latest data released, the overall highest and average package received during IIT Varanasi placements 2026 was INR 1.67 Crore per annum and 29 LPA . A total of 1,228 full-time offers and 292 PPOs were made. The top recruiters included Google, ZS Associates, ICICI Bank and Meesho .

A total of 17 students received salary package above INR 100 LPA during IIT BHU Varanasi placements 2026. Most number of offers were made for SDE roles followed by ML/Quant, Analytics, Product and Core Engineering roles during IIT BHU placements 2026.
Earlier, during the 2024-25 session , the highest and average stipend recorded was INR 5 lakh and 1.04 lakh per month .
Placement data 2026 mentioned above is updated till Feb, 2026.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is nice we love it.
reviews.review_text: We have good food, a mess, Wi-Fi, a ibrary and a lot of things. The structure of labs and classrooms is old, it is already a bit old, but new halls are being built which are very good. Initially there are good facilities in the hostel but later on it happens that there is no water and the geyser is facility.

reviews.review_heading: IIT BHU, The best of the most.
reviews.review_text: One thing in which my college lags is infrastructure. It is not as great as other IITs. They are working heavily on improving it. New hostels are being made. Canteen services are being improved. Wi-Fi is good. AC is also being installed.

reviews.review_heading: I have an amazing experience at IIT BHU Varanasi.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good, but not so cool compared to other IITs. Day by day, infrastructure is getting better. Hostels are also getting renovated, and the new ones are quite good (for 1st and 2nd year). Mess food is obviously very good. The canteen is open till 3 AM, so it's very helpful.

reviews.review_heading: College is the support for all the sports and infrastructure, and the food is good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the hostel are good, with table tennis, volleyball, and a badminton court. Food quality is very nice. Wi-Fi in the classroom is somewhat limited, but in the library it's excellent. An excellent thing about this college is the support for all the sports and infrastructure, and the food is also very good, with a protein-rich diet.

reviews.review_heading: Overview for freshers in 2026.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not very modern but its bearable. In recent months it has upgraded a lot by adding ACs and new buildings. Wi-Fi is great all over the campus from the start, hostel rooms and bathrooms are good as well for a government college. There is a variety of food in the mess at a time and the menu is not repeated all week.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college if you are going for placement.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is okay, the classrooms are old, basically, the whole infrastructure is old. Some buildings are good. First-year hostels are good. The food provided in the mess is good. Sports and games facilities are also good. The infrastructure is kind of old, and we do not have AC in the lecture theatre (now being installed).

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college in Uttar Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my department is good. The past is the nearest department. Hostels have CCTV cameras, a water cooler, vending machines, and a canteen. reviews.review_heading: Lifetime experience in IIT BHU.
reviews.review_text: The library has vast resources, and classrooms are a mix of modern smart rooms and older halls. Hostels are mandatory for B.Tech students & very affordable. reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Technology, BHU, Varanasi.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available are old, but everything needed is provided to us. Wi-Fi facilities are absolutely good. Classrooms are okay. The library is an absolute part of our college, and it has all types of book collections needed for a student. The hostel rooms are too cozy and small. The food is not that good in taste, but the quality is good enough.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not very modern. The Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. The classrooms, library, and labs are very calm without any disturbance. faqs.question: How many recruiters participated during the recent BITS Pilani placements?
faqs.answer: As per the media reports, BITS Pilani attracted 297 recruiters for its 2025 placement session who offered a variety of job roles to the students across sectors, such as BFSI, IT, Education, FMCG, Consulting, and E-Commerce, etc. The list of recruiters included KPMG, Accenture, Barclays, IBM, EY, Yes Bank, etc. The total number of recruiters participated during BITS Pilani placements between 2023 and 2025 are tabulated below: Particulars Statistics (2023) Statistics (2024) Statistics (2025) Total Companies 314 350 297

faqs.question: Why is the BTech fee so high at BITS Pilani?
faqs.answer: BITS Pilani is a private university in India and its fee is higher for following reasons: BITS Pilani has world-class infrastructure with high-tech labs, libraries, sports facilities, and accommodation facilities. BITS Pilani faculty is highly qualified and experienced faculty from across the world, and hiring them is costly. The university invests heavily in research facilities and equipment, which requires a significant amount of funding. The institute has a strong reputation for its graduates who are highly sought after by top companies in India and abroad.

hostel.description: The Institute is fully residential and hostel accommodation is provided to all students. There are eleven hostels for boys and one hostel complex for girls. The hostel rooms are fully furnished. Common room facilities with Cable TV and telephone are available in each hostel. Internet connectivity has been provided in all hostel rooms. Solar water heating systems are provided in all the hostels. There is a common kitchen cum mess unit for every set of two boys hostels. Girls hostel, however, has a separate mess of its own, situated within the boundary of the hostel. It is mandatory for the students staying in the hostel to have their food in the hostel messes. The messes attached to hostels are fully managed by the students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2030Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 28 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It provides freedom to explore personal interests.
reviews.review_text: Hostels at BITS are clean and spacious. Each hostel also includes common rooms with indoor games like air hockey and table tennis, and outside courts for badminton and volleyball. Mess food is a well-balanced meal and made in hygienic places. The medical centre is open 24/7, and also ambulances come to the hostel gate in case of emergency. Courts and other playing facilities are well-maintained for every sport.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 4 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Worth the high fees due to ROI, but after entering, hard work is expected to excel.
reviews.review_text: Entire campus is Wi-Fi covered, and classrooms are well maintained with blocks assigned to departments like mechanical, CS, and electrical. Library is also pretty big, with a capacity of 600+, and it has a great interior, and provides a peaceful vibe for studying. Quality of hostel and mess is also good, food taste is decent with a different menu.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 16 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, environment, facilities, and placement prospects.
reviews.review_text: Ethernet connectivity is available in hostel rooms and the library (1 Gbps speed), with Wi-Fi throughout the hostel and academic block, and in the library (100 Mbps). The food can be considered fair, with the menu undergoing slight changes every two months. For the mechanical department, we have dedicated labs, workshops, and sandbox areas.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa CampusReviewed on 12 Feb 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa Campus.
reviews.review_text: The facility is very good. The academic block is beautiful, consisting of 4 lecture theatres and a lot of classrooms. Some labs are also present. A big canteen includes a kitchen and a Nescafe shop. There is also a big auditorium in the basement. There is a football and cricket ground with floodlights. Other sports facilities are also available. Hostels of the new block are very good with fully furnished rooms and 2 common washrooms on each floor. The campus is beautiful and green.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 11 Feb 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The overall experience with college is really good and I will definitely recommend it to others.
reviews.review_text: BITS is a fully residential campus with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, various sports grounds, and campus-wide internet connectivity. The labs and classrooms are good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BITS Pilani, Hyderabad CampusReviewed on 24 Jan 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Ups and downs of BITS through some unknown insights.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility in our hostel is not good. The land cables work better than the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are neat and tidy. Hostels are clean, but there is a dumping ground near, which sometimes ends with a bad odour. The mess food is better than most of the colleges, and the canteen is affordable. Sports facilities are quite good and almost every sports facility is available. We all get medical insurance.

reviews.review_heading: Worth it to take admission here.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of this college are awesome. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college campus, classrooms, library, and labs. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is top-notch. Medical facilities are also available 24/7, and sports and games are also good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa CampusReviewed on 2 Nov 2024)
reviews.review_heading: One of the best engineering colleges in India.
reviews.review_text: The course and hostel are absolutely amazing, other than one big downside, which is the food. The food is horrendous, and you eat it just for the sake of staying alive. The paid canteens are good, but the mess is bad. All classrooms are air-conditioned, with Wi-Fi throughout the campus. The library has a wide range of books to cover every genre. Sports and games are widely encouraged, and there are multiple football grounds, as well as a gym and badminton/tennis courts.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa CampusReviewed on 28 Oct 2024)
reviews.review_heading: BITS Pilani - It's Magic.
reviews.review_text: We have great infrastructure at BITS Goa. The Goa campus is really beautiful, full of greenery, and Goa itself is also a very beautiful state. overview_faqs.answer: IIT Indore is a decade-old IIT that generally ranks among the top 16 Engineering institutes in NIRF. The university is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). overview_faqs.question: What is the overall campus atmosphere and social scene at IIT Indore?
overview_faqs.answer: The overall campus of IIT Indore is safe with strict security for both girls and boys. IITI is well-known for its annual student initiatives and events. Hostel life at IIT Indore is one of the best in all the ITIs. Newly constructed hostel building in the permanent campus has a great infrastructure. Currently, the institute has six hostels out of which one is for female students and the other for married students. The hostel life is vibrant with 574 rooms each in 6 hostels. IITI also provides extracurricular activities with various clubs, fests, events and competitions.

paragraphs: IIT Indore's admission processconsists of the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. Candidates who wish to receive admission to IIT Indore must meet the course-specific eligibility criteria and apply online before the last date of application. Students may look below for a breakdown on the IIT Indore application process:
1. IIT Indore Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Indore are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, forIIT Indore BTech, candidates are required toapply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advancedapplication. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application formis required to be completed.
2. Selection Rounds

IIT Indore admits students to BTech courses based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced scores. Candidates are allotted seats inJoSAA Counselling for BTech, BTech-MTech (Dual Degree), and BS courses.Admission to MTech is through GATE followed by COAP Counselling. The institute considersIIT JAMandCCMN CounsellingforMSc courses. Candidates can check with the admission office for the selection rounds of the rest of the courses.
3. Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

TheIIT Indore cutofffor BTech, MTech, and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. IIT Indore will release the course-wise merit list for merit-based courses on its official website. As per the merit list, candidates are called for counselling for seat allotment. Shortlisted candidates must then pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

IIT Indore course feesinclude multiple components, such as one-time payment, tuition fees, mess charges, and hostel fees. faqs.question: What is the median package offered during IIT Indore placements?
faqs.answer: According to IIT Indore NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during IIT Indore placements between 2021 and 2023 are presented below: Course Median Package (2021) Median Package (2022) Median Package (2023) BTech INR 14 LPA INR 18.5 LPA INR 21.20 LPA MTech INR 10 LPA INR 10 LPA INR 8 LPA Note : The above mentioned median packages are taken from IIT Indore NIRF report 2024.

faqs.question: How are the placements at IIT Indore?
faqs.answer: IIT Indore has a good record of placements for its BTech, MTech, MS and MSc courses. As per the latest report, the highest and average package offered to BTech students during IIT Indore placements in 2023 was INR 68 LPA and INR 25.45 LPA, respectively. The key highlights of IIT Indore placements for the Class of 2023 are presented below: Particulars Placement Statistics (2023) Highest package INR 68 LPA (BTech) INR 40 LPA (PG) Average package INR 25.45 LPA (BTech) INR 13.01 LPA (PG) Placement rate 89.76% (BTech) 65.38% (MTech) 65% (MSc) 63.16% (MS) Top recruiters Amazon, Microsoft, Flipkart, Samsung

faqs.question: Is there a placement cell at IIT Indore?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a Placement and Training Cell at IIT Indore to help students with enhancement of skills and preparation of job interviews. The institute invites top companies in campus to offer placement opportunities to students. IIT Indore recorded 89.76% placements for BTech and 65.38% placements for M.Tech batch passed out in 2023. The the highest and average package offered to BTech students during IIT Indore placements in 2023 was INR 68 LPA and INR 25.45 LPA.

faqs.question: What is the average package offered during IIT Indore placements?
faqs.answer: The IIT Indore average package offered to BTech students during the 2023 placement drive stood at INR 25.45 LPA. Further, the IIT Indore CSE average package offered in 2023 stood at INR 32.60 LPA. The course-wise average package offered during IIT Indore placements 2023 are presented below: Course Average Package (2023) BTech INR 25.45 LPA MTech INR 9.96 LPA MSc INR 10.8 LPA MS INR 19.4 LPA The branch-wise average package offered during IIT Indore BTech placements 2023 are presented below: BTech Branch Average Package (2023) Computer Science INR 32.60 LPA Electrical INR 25.70 LPA Mechanical INR 21.88 LPA Civil INR 17.37 LPA Metallurgical & Materials Science INR 18.95 LPA

qs_world.description:
IIT Indore has received strong ranks by the QS World University Rankings under the 'Top Global Universities' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the QS World University Rankings 2026. In the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Indore fell 79 ranks to #556 rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
One can observe that within the category of 'Asia', the institute's ranking has scaled up when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Indore climbed 25 ranks to #229 rank in the 'Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Southern Asia' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2026, IIT Indore climbed 7 ranks to #47 rank in the 'Southern Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Hostels of IIT Indore are the best among the IITs. It has a 5bhk type design of hostels, and each hostel has its own badminton ground accessible to students 24/7, and being the second generation IIT, it has really nice infrastructure. We have an iconic pod building designed in a very different manner, and administrative buildings, and there is a very good library.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied overall. Placements are improving every year.
reviews.review_text: Best infrastructure and best hostel life. The library here is much better and consists of thousands of books. IIT Indore's hostel is the best among all IITs (according to me) as it consists of a unit system (bhk system) with good Wi-Fi labs are good. IIT Indore has a very good campus with all facilities like medical care, sports, hygienic mess, and canteen.

reviews.review_heading: It has excellent infrastructure, fair placements, and fair faculty members.
reviews.review_text: It has the best infrastructure among all IITs. It has top-class Wi-Fi, AC labs, an AC classroom, and a fully AC library. The quality of facilities in our hostel is top-notch. The unit system that IIT Indore follows is top-class, like an apartment. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is decent. Medical facilities are also good. A 24x7 ambulance and doctors are available. Sports and games domain is expanding. In the last year, we got an Olympic-level track. It also has other sports grounds...

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Indore - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus, in hostels as well as classrooms. The library is fully equipped with a vast collection of books, and a system is also provided. Medical facilities are available here. A dietitian, physician, and gynaecologist are also present here.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities with the most professional lecturers.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are perfect. Food is the best here. Sports and games are amazing. Wi-Fi is not so good at our hostel. It is one of the drawbacks of my college. We have amazing labs at our college. We often visit KV to conduct our experiments.

reviews.review_heading: College has a good environment. Placements, infrastructure, and facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: There are separate labs and equipment established according to the course requirements with proper Wi-Fi availability. There are good classrooms in size and proper wooden benches. There are separate hostels for 1st year and 2nd year with double sharing rooms and 3rd, 4th year live in the same hostel. Good Wi-Fi is available in hostel room, and every day clean every unit properly. Hostels are best.

reviews.review_heading: This is the only IIT college where placement and infrastructure are both very good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of IIT Indore is one of the best in India. Hostel of this college looks like a hotel. There is a common room for every 5 students. Every student of this college gets single from the first year. Although from this year, first-year students have to share a single room with one partner due to an increase in branches in B.Tech. Everything is here when it comes to the facility.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with my college because of good education.
reviews.review_text: There are proper labs and smart boards which help in better education. Wi-Fi is available, classrooms are high-tech as an IIT. Slides are shared well enough. Hostel is double sharing and the quality is very good two proper beds. Sports facilities have improved.

reviews.review_heading: All about Masters at IIT Indore.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are all very good. Each classroom and lab is air-conditioned. The hostel facility is very nice. The washrooms and rooms are clean. Campus life is very good. The mess provides good quality food. The sports complex has a badminton court, swimming pool, and gym facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is a little bad. Other than that, all is good. There are double-sharing rooms; 3rd and 4th years get single-sharing rooms. The library is closed on holidays, but the self-study center is open 24/7. Food is not bad, but don't expect too much. You will live in a unit, 4 BHK. There are washrooms in each unit too.

reviews.review_heading: The campus of IIT Indore .
reviews.review_text: There are total five to six hostel at IIT INDORE campus which includes namely CVR, VSB DA, HJB etc. There are five practical building and Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. The quality of mess food is quite good and it has its own health center and sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: A students honest review of IIT Indore by Raja Reddy. Mentioning the advantage of IIT.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure is great and is considered the best of all IITs, with modern infrastructure combined. It has buildings like hostels, mess, lecture halls, and an auditorium, all within walking distance of one another. A beautiful sports complex is under construction, and an Inter IIT event is going to happen this year.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the overall quality of the college .
reviews.review_text:
Full marks on infrastructure and facilities with high-class labs and classrooms are there. All the extra facilities provided are up to par. Hostels are clean and the hostel staff is really helpful. We do have good-quality food in canteens and mess. Do get regular mess food checked.
.

reviews.review_heading: A well defined review of IIT Indore.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are in top condition at IIT Indore. Labs are well maintained and funded as well. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, provided by the institute. Classrooms are equipped with digital screens and AC's are seated, which is also very comfortable.

reviews.review_heading: IIT INDORE : Best Campus Life With Greater Opportunities.
reviews.review_text: There are well-equipped labs in buildings with free Wi-Fi access, big LED screens, and modern teaching classrooms with good-quality sound speakers. The infrastructure of every building is modern and beautiful. The Wi-Fi service is available in every hostel, lab, classroom, and auditorium. The hostel facilities are good too. We will find two student occupancy rooms, four rooms, two toilets, two washrooms, one kitchen, one living room, one balcony, and two sets of very high-quality chairs. The roo...

college_info.intro:
NIT Rourkela popular programmes are BTech and MBA. BTech students are placed in top companies such as Google, Microsoft, Apple, and others. BTech students, if willing can also join non-technical jobs and can enter into fields such as customer service, sales, marketing, and others. NIT Rourkela's BTech students are free to choose specialisations ranging from Biotechnology and Medical Engineering to Mining Engineering.
NIT Rourkela MBA is the most popular course offered in various specialisations. Overall, this university is one of the highest-ranked universities in India. The BTech and MBA faculty are PhD, degree, and diploma holders.

overview_faqs.question: What is the total fee of NIT Rourkela BSc?
overview_faqs.answer: The total tuition fee of NIT Rourkela BSc programme is INR 75,000 which is to be paid over 10 semesters. Each semester a student has to pay INR 7,500 as tuition fee. However, this is not the only fee one has to pay throughout a semester. Extra costs like medical fees, student activity fee, hall establishment fee, etc. are also added in each semester.Thus the total fees to be paid by a student is close to INR 5.93 lakh, if one adds all the costs in each semester, the average cost each semester for five years is INR 56,500 in which the first and last semester have admission fee and graduation fee, respectively.

paragraphs: NIT Rourkela admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list and counselling. Find below the complete process around NIT Rourkela admission 2026:
1: Registration for Admissions

The NIT Rourkela application process for the undergraduate course is done on the official NTA portals of the accepted entrance exams. However, candidates seeking admission to MBA, MA and PhD courses must are required to appl through the official website.
2: Selection Rounds

Candidates are shortlisted based on their scores in the JEE Mains entrance examination. After the JEE Mains exam, candidates are alloted their seats duringthe JOSAA counseling Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Rourkela MBA admissions are done through CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats at NIT Rourkela.
