reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is nice. Hostels are good, and the environment in hostels is also good. The canteen and medical facilities are also good. Sports and games are good. Students play in the NIT or many sports and fests every year. There is a gym in every hall for students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Technology, Rourkela.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. They provide the Wi-Fi, which is very useful for networking. In labs, provide the AC and projector. reviews.review_heading: It is a really good college, and academics are improving year by year.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in classrooms is very good with full AC, projectors, and speakers. Labs have the latest updated computers and screens. Hostels are 10 years old, but they are good. Wi-Fi available on the campus is good. There are both day and night canteens in every hostel.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Rourkela is an awesome college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our hostel include Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. Fully air-conditioned classrooms are available in our college. A central library is also available on our campus, and books can be issued by students. The quality of food in the mess is average. There are three canteens available on our campus, and the fast food is good. We have a small ground to play different sports like volleyball, football, and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college as it's one of the top most colleges in India. The college life is good.
reviews.review_text: Rooms are not so high-end, but it's okay for our branch. There is Wi-Fi in classrooms, and labs are also good with around 80 computers in each lab. The library is good. reviews.review_heading: Good college, the best NIT in India.
reviews.review_text: There is a good central library in our college. All the classrooms in the lecture halls have a blackboard and a smart board along with a projector. There are 2 stadiums inside the campus, a gymnasium in every hostel, a swimming pool, basketball and tennis courts, and indoor sports in every hostel. There are over 50 clubs on campus for different things like coding, poetry, dramatics, etc. The hostel facility is okay. The boys' hostel is bigger than the girls' hostel. The food served is manageable...

reviews.review_heading: Very unique course and this is the best place.
reviews.review_text: The campus is so elegant, so beautiful, just looking like a wow. Everything is there, for example, the gym, swimming pool, labs, Wi-Fi, hostel, and mess. Labs are well-equipped. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are many grounds for different sports. Hostels are very good. Food is outstanding.

reviews.review_heading: This is a very unique course; you will enjoy this college
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped with instruments. All sorts of competitions happen, and workshops on robotics, AutoCAD, etc., also take place. The hostel rooms are small, and we have double-sharing rooms, as well as triple and single-sharing rooms. Hostel is compulsory for everyone. The library is accessible throughout the day. Other facilities include a medical store, hospital, swimming pool, gym, student activity center, data center, etc. We have a lot of fests all throughout the year.

reviews.review_heading: Come join this amazing college.
reviews.review_text: Coming to classroom facilities, there are two lecture halls. Every classroom has 2 air conditioners. Room is allotted to two people. Coming to the mess, the food quality is good but bad in taste. Fee for room is 5000 per semester and 20000 for mess.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college, top NIT college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is good. There are many facilities like a gym, reading room, night and day canteen, book shop, badminton court, sports, everything. But the mess food is quite disappointing for me. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. There are many cafeterias, restaurants, and malls inside the campus. There are many grounds for different sports. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and it is open 24 hours.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Rourkela College Review.
reviews.review_text: Our course gets a lot of support from the available facilities. We have a central library, Wi-Fi, and digital classrooms, which really help. The hostels are quite good, and the food, whether from the mess or the canteen, tastes nice. Plus, there is a multi-sports complex too.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely best college in Odisha.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure are world class. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. This is the best engineering college in Odisha. Wi-Fi was not present in this college. The quality and facility in my hostel canteen were so superb. Sports and games were also good.

The applications can be submitted online by visiting the official website atsrmist.edu.in. Students are required to submit a separate application for separate courses. The application fee for each course isINR 1,200.

hostel_campus.college_name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: SRM University has 14 blocks for boys and 7 blocks for girls. All the hostels have hi speed Wi-Fi connectivity and are provided with solar water have heating systems, mineral water supply, water cooler in each floor, generator power supply.Students are offered with healthy and sumptuous food options at highly subsidized rates and can choose to have North Indian or South Indian menu in the dining halls that are co-located. the hostels also offer a multi-cuisine dining facility providing Thai, Chinese and continental food for the benefit of our international students,.Rooms with single cot ,study table & chair, cupboard & common mirror are available. Most hostels have common washrooms, a few blocks are available with attached bath and AC rooms too. Facilities such as gym, prayer halls, games, sports and cultural activities has been facilitated. 3 International hostels with modernized kitchen,library,drinking water, water heater, telephone,power supply, medical care, recreation,stationery shop, laundry point, gym, playground, indoor games, banking facility, a/c dining hall, a/c study hall and one off campus international hostel is also available.
facilities: College Infrastructure: SRM has a well-defined layout in terms of infrastructure. The campus is spread over a large area, with all the basic facilities provided. There are huge grounds and indoor courts for sports; the gymnasium is made for the students of the college. The library is technically advanced and has a good collection of books. The classrooms are well maintained with smart boards installed, and the washrooms are clean. The canteen has diverse varieties of food that are hygienic and affordable.

Academics: CSE has proven to be a good course for me as it aligns with my interests and liking for computers and programming. The course is well updated, and even the curricula followed in college fall in line with the skills required in the job sector. The course has a lot of research and practicality, which definitely makes one job-ready. The teachers are cooperative and experienced, and they mentor each student at every point.

Placements: Approximately 70% of the students get hired in the recruitment drive held by the college. The placement drive is held in the most efficient manner. The average package is around 5 LPA, which is a good kickstart for any student in their respective fields. The college has a placement cell that is responsible for inviting firms to the college and guiding fellow students in getting placed, hence making the college supportive. The placements must be inclusive of all the courses, which is a demerit.

Value-for-money: The annual tuition fee structure was a bit on the expensive side, as my yearly fee was around 3 lacs p/a, which might not be affordable for many students. But the quality of services and education, with all the basic amenities, make SRM worth the investment. Personally, SRM is making each penny count.

Campus Life: Though the college is isolated from the main part of the city, it is glorious from the inside. There are sports activities in the college and many cultural societies, like dance and music societies. Moreover, there are various clubs that keep on participating in educational competitions. Various seminars are held and several festivals are conducted throughout the year, making college life happen. There's a medical room to handle any emergency as and when it arises!

IIT Dhanbad Application Process 2026

The admission process of IIT Dhanbad starts with applying for the desired course. Since ISM Dhanbad accepts applicants based on valid scores in the national-level entrance exams, candidates need to apply for the course-specific entrance tests. ForBTech admission, candidates need to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed.TheJEE Advanced 2026official website has launched with the new eligibility criteria. Aspirants need to apply on the institute's website for MBA, MA, PhD and Executive courses.
Selection & Release of Merit List

Once the registration process is completed, applicants need to go through the course-based entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are completed, they need to go through the course-wise counselling process for final seat allocation. ForPhD, Executive,MAand MBA courses, merit lists are released on the official website with the names of the shortlisted students. Students must meet theIIT Dhanbad cutofffor the desired course.
Admission Confirmation at IIT Dhanbad
After completion of the selection rounds, shortlisted candidates need to submit the admission charges and confirm their admission to the relevant course at IIT Dhanbad.

placement_data.title: IIT Dhanbad Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: A total of 1,687 students registered and 1,335 students participated and 1072 students were placed during IIT Dhanbad placement 2025 . A total of 976 domestic offers and 27 international offers were made in the year 2025. The average and median packages offered were INR 17.53 LPA and INR 13.38 LPA , respectively.

242 PPOs were received and 216 PPOs were accepted during the placement drive 2025. A total of 279 job offers made were above INR 20 LPA . 400 offers were made with salary package between 10 LPA and 20 LPA. Job offers between 6 LPA and 10 LPA were 367. A total of 26 companies didn’t disclose the CTC offered to students in 2025.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for mining and petroleum engineering courses.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. The hostel is not that good in terms of food and other facilities. Hostels are not very flexible in entry and exit timings. Labs are good. The library is a very good place.

reviews.review_heading: Really enjoyable and a great place to study while exploring the campus and curriculum.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure might look old, but it is strong since it was built in 1926 during the British period. The auditorium has good capacity. Classrooms are equipped with central AC and smart boards. The library is much bigger than expected. They provide an excellent study environment.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for students' studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this course is very good for students. Many facilities are provided by this university, such as a 24-hour Wi-Fi facility for students and faculty members. Our university has many big libraries for students where they learn and study together. The university classrooms are very big and fully air-conditioned. This university also has many hostels for students. The food quality is also very good in the canteen and hostel.

reviews.review_heading: The campus has a classic environment, well-trained faculty, and good placements every year.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are good in terms of academics, like labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms, and branchwise departments. The campus environment is very nice, with lots of trees. It has a pollution-free campus, as most vehicles run on electricity. Hostels are also nice. We get both good non-vegetarian and vegetarian food. Sports and games are excellent here. All required courts are available here. We also have a student activity centre where we play indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
reviews.review_text: Campus Wi‑Fi is available free of cost and for unlimited use. Labs are equipped with computers, although some systems are old. Classrooms are air-conditioned and very spacious. The best thing about our college is its 7‑storey library containing thousands of books, with ample sitting areas and a cafeteria. Hostels are small. The mess/food is the greatest downside. Currently, our sports grounds are under renovation, so sports aren’t active lately.

reviews.review_heading: A brief overview of college life at IIT Dhanbad.
reviews.review_text: There are many hostels on campus for student accommodation. Each hostel provides all basic necessities like 24/7 cold/hot water, Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and a canteen. Hostel food is also nice and hygienic. Labs have advanced computer facilities with Wi-Fi. Classrooms are air-conditioned. We have one of the largest libraries in Asia.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with top faculty, strong labs, good facilities, and excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: As I was studying at IIT, the food quality was good, but as I was from the South, I did suffer; mostly people from the South will suffer. Wi-Fi is 24/7 available in the hostel, college, and library. Classrooms have digital boards and are provided with projectors, and everything is facilitated with air conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: Great opportunities, mixed hostel vibes, but worth it for the IIT tag.
reviews.review_text: I am part of the 2K21-25 batch, and overall, the infrastructure is decent. Classrooms are well-maintained, Wi-Fi is available but patchy at times, and labs have the necessary equipment, though some need upgrades. The library is huge. Hostel life was manageable. Rooms were okay, but not luxurious. Mess food is hit or miss. Some days are edible, some days are emotional damage. The canteen has better options, and the sports facilities are actually good. Medical facilities are available, but basic. ...

reviews.review_heading: Decent college, but with some fundamental problems.
reviews.review_text: Our mechanical department is the richest in the entire college. We have a lot of machines and lab equipment. We have the Institute Research Hub (iRh) and the innovation centre i2H and NVCTI. They have world-class infrastructure. However, I have only given three stars for the infrastructure, which is because of the hostel. The food is okay, we get paneer and non-veg 3 times a week, and the taste is okay. The internet speed is only 50 Mbps most of the time, and the rooms are small and don't even h...

reviews.review_heading: Extremely happy seeing my dream of becoming an IITan come true.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good. We are getting several facilities with computer labs, a Library, and Many lecture halls for studying. The full campus is Wi-Fi covered, and internet LAN cables are also available everywhere.  Inside the hostel, on every floor, a common room is also available for playing games, watching TV, and relaxing.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best university in Dhanbad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this course is very good for the students. There are many facilities available in this university, like all-time Wi-Fi. There is a big library present in this university where students learn together. There is a big hostel with a calm and clean environment for the students. The food quality is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best college in Jharkhand.
reviews.review_text: IIT Dhanbad has a large 444.98-acre campus with a fully automated, extensive library, spacious smart board-equipped classrooms, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Student amenities include 24/7 healthcare, sports facilities like a swimming pool and gymnasium, and the student canteen offers spacious twin-sharing rooms with high-speed internet. This university is very good in all its facilities. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Best IIT for opting for core fields.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my branch is average, not good like other IITs. Basic classrooms without a projector, Wi-Fi enabled campus, but with low speed. The library of this college is very big and has a large number of books. Hostel facilities are average, the canteen and mess food are not good in taste, but you can manage it. Medical and sports facilities are good, and students get opportunities to show their talent.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: There are 6 hostels for males and 2 for females. All the hostels are good, but I love Diamond Hostel because of the heritage it has. The rooms are spacious, and you need to share the room with one person. The hostel fees are included in your semester registration. The course curriculum is pretty good. It is well-structured and helps the students in getting a better understanding of the entire field.

review_summary.college_name: VIT Vellore Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of VIT Vellore.

content.Placements: The current IT Batch is good with comparatively less number of students than other branches. Around 80 percent of students get placed, while others choose to go for higher education. The highest package offered in the IT branch is 53 LPA, and the lowest package offered ranges from 3-4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, but it is capped at a particular speed and shuts down at 12:30 AM. Overall, the infrastructure is good. It is equipped with gyms, basketball courts, and other sports amenities. Students have to choose the hostel and a mess every new year themselves. Hostels are allotted based on our branch rank.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Best decision of my life.

content.Placements: Placements are more than 90 percent. The internship percentage is also more than 90 percent. Top recruiting companies offering are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Visa, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in the library and every hostel block, with a pretty good internet speed. Hostel blocks are not less than heaven. There are very clean washrooms and there is no crowd in the washrooms in the morning or during peak hours, too. Food is also great, and the mess serves a variety of options to eat for students. Cybersecurity courses are offered and labs are equipped with the latest technology.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied because of the good infrastructure and good placements.

content.Placements: So, coming to the placements in BCA, the eligible CGPA for placements is above 8. If 9, it is better as about 94 percent of students get placed, as the recruiter company conducts its own exam to get into their company. The package offered ranges from 3-7 LPA for the BCA course. The college will not provide internships. We have to search for internships. The top role offered is developer.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. In VIT, all students will have the same facilities that will not differ. Our college infrastructure is a very good place to study. It will provide Wi-Fi only in the library. Hostels have their specific range, like single person per room, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 sharing rooms. The hostel fee may vary, and for 7 days, they will provide different kinds of food in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Companies hire for R&D roles.

content.Placements: Major offers for exceptional roles like research and development are provided by companies like Schlumberger, 3M, and GE Appliances, considering the invite card of our college for recruitment drives. Two kinds of packages are offered by a few companies for the top and lower roles. Some other core companies like Hitachi Energy and Intel also participate in the drives.
content.Infrastructure: Leave intimation, on-duty, and other emergencies require the intimation of the parents. Otherwise, we are not allowed anywhere. Transportation modes like the college bus and public transport such as bus, auto, and cab are available frequently. Mini stationery is available for students to purchase randomly needed things to avoid frequent movement outside the institution.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and faculty, but getting a placement is as difficult as JEE.

content.Placements: Due to the number of students in this college are in large numbers, placement is very competitive and hard to get. Packages vary from 3.2 LPA to 1 crore per annum, but it all depends on your skills, and the average would be around 7 LPA. Almost all the companies visit our college, from mass recruiters to FAANG.
content.Infrastructure: As I am from the main campus, the infrastructure here is top-notch, and the facilities provided are enough for a 4-year comfortable stay. We have multiple messes here, so the taste may vary depending on the caterers, but overall it is fine. Our college has an outdoor stadium and an indoor complex, including 5 gymnasiums in total.

reviews.review_heading: Review of VIT Vellore.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but it is capped at a particular speed and shuts down at 12:30 AM. Overall, the infrastructure is good. It is equipped with gyms, basketball courts, and other sports amenities. Students have to choose the hostel and a mess every new year themselves. Hostels are allotted based on our branch rank.

reviews.review_heading: Best decision of my life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the library and every hostel block, with a pretty good internet speed. Hostel blocks are not less than heaven. There are very clean washrooms and there is no crowd in the washrooms in the morning or during peak hours, too. Food is also great, and the mess serves a variety of options to eat for students. Cybersecurity courses are offered and labs are equipped with the latest technology.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the good infrastructure and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. In VIT, all students will have the same facilities that will not differ. Our college infrastructure is a very good place to study. It will provide Wi-Fi only in the library. Hostels have their specific range, like single person per room, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 sharing rooms. The hostel fee may vary, and for 7 days, they will provide different kinds of food in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Companies hire for R&D roles.
reviews.review_text: Leave intimation, on-duty, and other emergencies require the intimation of the parents. Otherwise, we are not allowed anywhere. Transportation modes like the college bus and public transport such as bus, auto, and cab are available frequently. Mini stationery is available for students to purchase randomly needed things to avoid frequent movement outside the institution.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and faculty, but getting a placement is as difficult as JEE.
reviews.review_text: As I am from the main campus, the infrastructure here is top-notch, and the facilities provided are enough for a 4-year comfortable stay. We have multiple messes here, so the taste may vary depending on the caterers, but overall it is fine. Our college has an outdoor stadium and an indoor complex, including 5 gymnasiums in total.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very well-maintained by the VIT team. Classrooms are very well-maintained with projectors installed in every class. The labs are built with proper equipment and are loaded with ACs. Hostels are well-maintained and well-furnished. The mess food varies from hostel to hostel. VIT has excellent sports facilities, as it contains 3 gyms, 3 basketball courts, and many more facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Life at VIT Vellore is full of memories.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. Students need a good rank or a roommate with a good rank to choose better hostel blocks and rooms. Food in Vellore is not bad, and some caterers like SRRC and Darling are very good. For sports and games, there are both outdoor and indoor stadiums inside the hostel area.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with the facilities they provide, and the teachers are teaching very well.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi in the hostel, and the infrastructure is very good in VIT. The library is the best. Hostel facilities are so good, and the food is served very neatly. We have an ambulance for emergencies. We have badminton in our hostel. The hostel is very good, and the hygiene is very good. They have laundry also.

reviews.review_heading: VIT - Vellore, Tamil Nadu review.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are well furnished, and all necessary equipment like an almirah, wardrobe, table, bed, and chair are there. Classrooms are also loaded with the facilities that are required, and they keep us available as soon as possible. Food quality is impressive as they give both veg and non-veg options on the menu. Games and sports are there in bulk, most of the international player comes from this college only.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and campus life are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. I took the H Block hostel apartment type; it is costly but very spacious. Wi-Fi is good, and the food is also good. We have a health center within VIT with a medical shop, and we have a basketball court, badminton court, and all to play. The mess is also neat.

reviews.review_heading: Vellore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure was very beautiful. All blocks had good infrastructure. College only provides Wi-Fi. Labs were very helpful. In library there were all these types of books. Hostel rooms were good and also hygiene food. In total five canteens were there. Good medical and sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Vit Vellore course review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the lab and classes is good. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. In library it is available. The hostel facilities are good and the food is also good. If you're interested in sports, there is a chance you can play, and they give first preference to health in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, good ROI of CAT 1, 2, and strict rules.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good in my college. Library with many books. Wi-Fi is decent, but only in the library and hostels. There are AC and non AC rooms available, and the room you get depends on your CGPA or your roommate CGPA. Food is sometimes good, sometimes not, depending upon what mess you take. We have a volleyball, gym, a tennis table, table tennis, a basketball, a swimming pool, and a big ground for football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Well maintained campus and great environment to learn and grow.
reviews.review_text: The Computer Science department is one of the largest in VIT and hence has been provided with the best facilities, such as well equipped classrooms with smart boards and internet connection. The rooms are large and spacious. The library here is not only big but also has a wide range of books available on every topic necessary. They even have self serving kiosks, which can give us an idea of where the book is present. The hostel is well equipped, and they have good Wi-Fi, good food, AC, and non A...

reviews.review_heading: VIT University: A place that you cannot miss in your lifetime.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms are air-conditioned and smart classrooms, with projectors and speakers, and arch classrooms with rolling chairs. Every room is equipped with Wi-Fi facilities. All the hostel rooms are highly maintained, and AC and non-AC rooms are available. All the rooms in the hostel have Wi-Fi connectivity. You have different types of mess options like veg, non-veg, and special.

paragraphs: Each year, Vellore Institute of Technology offers scholarships in the form of tuition waivers and freeships. While merit scholarships are awarded to class toppers, economically challenged students are provided need-based financial assistance. Furthermore, NRI and foreign students are given scholarships upon presenting meritorious records. Students from rural backgrounds who secure top ranks in VITEEE at the district level (in Tamil Nadu only) are given free education.

Students who wish to pursue MTech are also given scholarships, given that they score well in the GATE exam. In addition, scholarships are given to students who excel in sports and games. Financial assistance is also provided to students who wish to do their project work in partner universities and institutions abroad, under the Semester Abroad Programme (SAP). In order to encourage the students to pursue active research, VIT also awards appropriate research associateships to meritorious and needy students.
DFP-Banner
Although scholarships at VIT Vellore are based on need and means, a majority of scholarship schemes offered at the institute level are mainly merit-based.

review_content.Placements: From the 2nd semester, we are eligible to get internships, so along with many students, we can get PPO. review_summary.college_name: NIT Surathkal Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Insights of NIT Karnataka.

content.Placements: Nitk mechanical is the best among all NITs in the QRF ranking. It has a placement rate of about 85 percent. Major core companies that came for placements this year were Apple for mechanical with a minor in ECE, L&T, Bajaj, Suzuki, ONGC, and HPCL. IN 2025 the average package for mechanical is 15 LPA. Internship opportunities are abundant across branches with a stipend of roughly 20k to 1 Lakh per month and many PPOs.
content.Infrastructure: Mechanical depth of Nitk has one of the best infrastructures among all departments. It has all the research related facilities, specialized labs like CAD/CAM, Internal combustion engines, and advanced research labs in areas such as strength of materials, robotics etc. Hostels have double and triple sharing rooms with 2 common washrooms on each floor. Ethernet facility for the internet.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The course is very unique and offers good placements.

content.Placements: Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, HSBC, Wells Fargo, Arcesium, L&T, Amazon, and ExxonMobil were among the firms that visited. IT/Software firms paid an average of 14 LPA, with the maximum compensation being about 50 LPA. Many PSUs paid approximately 16 LPA for core roles. The management was also very supportive in providing placement training.
content.Infrastructure: In the hostel, all facilities were provided in the rooms. The rooms were spacious. First- and second-year students shared rooms with 2 or 3 people, and later they got single rooms. All types of sports like basketball, volleyball, cricket, badminton, swimming, and powerlifting were available. There were also many cultural and technical clubs, which won cups and prizes in competitions. The classrooms were spacious, with charging points and Wi-Fi connections throughout the campus. Classrooms had proper smart boards, and some even had ACs.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Industrial Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good college, infrastructure, and placements.

content.Placements: From the 2nd semester, we are eligible to get internships, so along with many students, we can get PPO. The number of companies visited is all there on the NITK website, but placement is good. In my course, the highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA, and the average is 5 LPA-6 LPA. In my course, around 85-90 percent of students get placed. I wanted a job in a pharmaceutical company.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are top-notch, and all facilities, like projectors and smart boards, are available. The library is good, and all types of books and magazines are available. Hostels are good. There are 2-seated and 3-seated rooms. There are different grounds for different sports.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology.

content.Placements: For B.Tech and MCA placements are good. MCA students get an average package of 10-12 LPA. Big companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Microsoft, Infosys, Samsung, and many more visit the campus. Around 250 companies come for MCA placements alone. Overall good placement experience here.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels have facilities like Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. The classrooms are air-conditioned, and the central library is well-equipped for borrowing books. The mess food is average, but there are three canteens serving really tasty fast food. There is also a small sports field for volleyball, football, and cricket.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of NIT Surathkal College.

content.Placements: Roughly 85 percent of students got placed, with about 6% opted for masters programs. The highest salary package reached 64 LPA, while the lowest was 6 LPA. Big names like Amazon, AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Qualcomm, Nvidia, DE Shaw, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley were all on the list of recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: Now, our course definitely benefits from some great facilities and infrastructure. The campus had a central library, Wi-Fi access, and digital classrooms, which was nice. The hostel accommodation was quite good, and the meals were pretty tasty, whether you were eating at the mess or the canteen. Don't forget the multi-sports complex!

description: NIT Surathkal cutoff 2025 for BTech, MTech, and other courses are available on this page. Candidates preparing for the next academic session can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the NIT Surathkal JEE Main cutoff 2025 along with other exams for different courses, rounds, and categories. Further exam-related updates are below:

In this section, candidates can view the last nine years of NIT Surathkal JEE Main cutoff ranks for various courses and categories by clicking on the download now links provided below to understand the past years' trends.

NIT Surathkal JEE Main cutoff 2025 for the first and last rounds are tabulated below for the General AI category students. In the last round, the NIT Surathkal CSE cutoff 2025 was 2158 in the General category belonging to the AI quota. For other core branches, such as ECE and Mechanical, the JEE Main last round closing ranks for admission were 5316 and 14036, respectively for the General category. The cutoff ranks for core BTech branches are usually on the lower side, indicating competitive cuto

For the General AI category students, the NIT Surathkal B.E. / B.Tech cutoff 2025 ranged between 2158 and 31695 in the last round. Considering the lowest cutoff ranks of 2158 and 3264, B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence were the top two most competitive branches for admission among the students belonging to the General category.

JEE Main is the accepting exam for admission to the BTech and other UG courses. Qualified candidates are then eligible for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling process for final seat allocation. In this section, aspirants can find out all the important JEE Main 2026 dates to be eligible for admission.

JoSAA counselling 2025 is now over for admission to the Engineering courses offered at NIT Surathkal. In 2025, the JoSAA counselling was conducted for up to six rounds. Further counselling rounds were conducted by CSAB to fill the vacant seats. Students who appeared for the JoSAA and CSAB counselling rounds can refer to the table below to view or download the round- and year-wise JEE Main cutoff lists for BTech admission at NIT Surathkal to understand the cutoff trends.

Tabulated below are the BTech specialisations available for admission based on the last round closing ranks of JEE Main. This will help students to make an informed decision to get the right college and specialisation for admission. The options below are available for students belonging to the General AI quota and are in the range of the most competitive BTech specialisation of NIT Surathkal. To refine their searches, students can also use the provided filters.

NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology MBA cutoff 2024 has been released for admission to its MBA/PGDM course. The Institute does not release the final CAT cutoff publicly and is only accessible through account login to those candidates who appear in the CAT exam. Hence, the available cutoff table below is based on previous years’ trends and the actual cutoffs might vary.
CAT is the accepting exam to be eligible for admission to the MBA/PGDM course. Candidates seeking admission can refer to the table below to view the important CAT 2025 dates.
Candidates applying for admission to the MBA/PGDM course at NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology may refer to the table below to view or download the consolidated CAT cutoff lists.

As per the GATE cutoff 2025, the top two most challenging M.E./M.Tech specialisations were M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Information Security) with last round cutoff scores of 722 and 693, respectively, for the General AI quota. reviews.review_heading: Insights of NIT Karnataka.
reviews.review_text: Mechanical depth of Nitk has one of the best infrastructures among all departments. It has all the research related facilities, specialized labs like CAD/CAM, Internal combustion engines, and advanced research labs in areas such as strength of materials, robotics etc. Hostels have double and triple sharing rooms with 2 common washrooms on each floor. Ethernet facility for the internet.

reviews.review_heading: The course is very unique and offers good placements.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel, all facilities were provided in the rooms. The rooms were spacious. First- and second-year students shared rooms with 2 or 3 people, and later they got single rooms. All types of sports like basketball, volleyball, cricket, badminton, swimming, and powerlifting were available. There were also many cultural and technical clubs, which won cups and prizes in competitions. The classrooms were spacious, with charging points and Wi-Fi connections throughout the campus. Classrooms had pr...

reviews.review_heading: Good college, infrastructure, and placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are top-notch, and all facilities, like projectors and smart boards, are available. The library is good, and all types of books and magazines are available. Hostels are good. There are 2-seated and 3-seated rooms. There are different grounds for different sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The hostels have facilities like Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. The classrooms are air-conditioned, and the central library is well-equipped for borrowing books. The mess food is average, but there are three canteens serving really tasty fast food. There is also a small sports field for volleyball, football, and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Surathkal College.
reviews.review_text: Now, our course definitely benefits from some great facilities and infrastructure. The campus had a central library, Wi-Fi access, and digital classrooms, which was nice. The hostel accommodation was quite good, and the meals were pretty tasty, whether you were eating at the mess or the canteen. Don't forget the multi-sports complex!

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology, Suratkal
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Surathkal College Review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available all across campus, and the hostels have LAN, too. The labs were fully stocked and really good. The library had over 200,000 books on just about every topic you can think of. I would have to say, when it comes to food, I would give it a 2 out of 5. The medical and sports facilities were pretty solid overall. The second year student hostels arena. It was the best, but the others were just fine. The food was decent, too.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Surathkal College review.
reviews.review_text: The campus includes all the essential academic and research buildings, a central library, well equipped labs, and classrooms with Wi-Fi. Students could use residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation was generally seen as satisfactory. The food in the mess was just average. It was a health center with medical professionals available, in case someone got sick.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a good college in order to learn, with better infrastructure and good placements in 2026.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in our college has been developing over last 4 years. We got new hostels this year, and last year they inaugurated a new lecture hall. Wi-Fi is pretty good, and labs are maintained and equipped with the latest machines. Classroom has good ventilation and proper spacing, with a smart board also. We also have 2 libraries, one of which is 24hrs open. Food quality in mess is normal, and canteen has good food also. We have a medical centre, also with all types of doctors available. We ...

reviews.review_heading: NIT Surathkal College Review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, with good facilities for sports and academics. LAN ports are available for connection to the public Ethernet, which is unlimited. Various events are well-organized on our campus, and different clubs provide different opportunities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are pretty decent. The first-year boys' hostel is basic, but after that, the second-year Shivalik hostel is basically a hotel. The third and fourth-year single rooms are excellent. I think you won't be disappointed with them. They are better than most government colleges, though they have some issues too.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life with good placement and private rooms, a place like heaven for engineering.
reviews.review_text: There are enough buildings for classrooms. Wi-Fi is available throughout campus through captive portal login. Two libraries with air conditioners are available. There are 3 grounds. Two sports complexes are too good. 12 boys' hostels and 5 girls' hostels are available. Mess food is decent. We get both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess. 3-night canteens are available, which serve midnight. There is a food court too. We also get a private one. Campus has a good connection to road (NH66), which ru...

reviews.review_heading: It is a awesome college.
reviews.review_text: Scenic & well-equipped A 295-acre beachside campus featuring private access, lush green zones, and world-class sports facilities including swimming pool, tennis courts, gyms, and stadium. Everything is good, having this kind of college is okay. Mess food is decent.

reviews.review_heading: College has all the required things for students in all terms.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is a little issue sometimes we get some suffering, but mostly we don't face it. It is not a big thing to be concerned about everywhere it's common. Everything is fine but sometimes there is an issue of food poisoning and all. We have good medical facilities and have an HCC inside the college open 24 hours.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure with excellent sports facilities.
reviews.review_text: We cannot use Wi-Fi in our hostel but we have LAN facility in our rooms. Hostel facilities are good while mess food is not that good. Sports facilities are amazing, especially cricket. We have cricket kit, nets, etc. There is a health care center within the college.

paragraphs: NITK Surathkal provides scholarships under various schemes to the students of undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes. The institute provides the B R Samaga Scholarship and Veeramma Rajashekaraiah Scholarship to BTech second-year students. Further, NITK Surathkal provides Vijayakala T D scholarship to students of the E&E Department. Other than this, the institute provides Viklang Sahayata Sanstha Mathura Scholarship and also offers financial assistance to SC/ST students.

NITK Surathkal provides GATE scholarships to MTech students. Only Indian Nationals are eligible for this scholarship wherein INR 12,400 is provided to students on a monthly basis. In addition, full-time research scholars are eligible for a fellowship of INR 25,000 per month for the first two years and INR 28,000 per month for another two years. individual_reviews.title: Excellent academic and corporate grooming.

content.Placements: At JD Birla Institute, everyone is eligible for a placement, but most of the students pursue an MBA, or they join family businesses, bringing the percentage down around 15-60 percent. The highest package is 9 LPA and the average is 5 LPA-6 LPA. The top recruiting companies include EY, Deloitte, HSBC Bank, and Amazon. In my batch, 100 percent of students got internships at top companies, such as TCS and Exide Industries. Top roles offered are business analyst, financial manager, account manager, HR, marketing, and sales executive.

There are no official hostels, most students stay in nearby paying guests. The college has a very hygienic canteen. The college has an in-house infirmary. Sports facilities include a badminton court and a recreational area, including table tennis, football, and carrom board. While the college is very compact in terms of area.

PPTs are there, and the hostel is of good quality with low fees. The hostel's food quality is good, and there are six canteens. Medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Jadavpur University has a legacy of more than a century.
reviews.review_text: The department is well-equipped with all kinds of labs and necessary teaching resources. As I am not very familiar with the facilities offered by IITs and NITs, I would rate mine as 4/5. This department was the first in Asia and receives a lot of funds and grants from alumni and organizations. You will learn a lot if you join JU Chemical. About the hostels, UG1 hostels are well-maintained and good. Wi-Fi is available, and rooms are big enough for 2–3 people. As I am not a hosteller, this is all ...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by J.D Birla Institute (JDBI)
reviews.review_heading: Review of J.D Birla Institute (JDBI).
reviews.review_text: We have good classrooms, a canteen, labs, a library, and even the college is undergoing renovation, providing us with greater facilities and a more comfortable infrastructure. We have AC classrooms and comfortable seating arrangements. The canteen food is good, and the library has a vast range of books with borrowing facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College with the best return on investment.
reviews.review_text: Being a state university, the institute is heavily underfunded. As a result, the infrastructure is not upto the mark in comparison to IITs and NITs. Though a good amount of research does take place. Hostel specifically is not of great quality, but that is justified by its ultra-cheap rent of Rs 30 per month.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a great college with the best return on investment, one can get with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-maintained and have the necessary facilities for the course. From 2025 onwards, a new syllabus is being introduced which removes irrelevant courses in the first year that have been a part of the course for many years, replacing them with necessary subjects.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college. It is the best state university in India.
reviews.review_text: The department coordinated well with the students. There is Wi-Fi available. Library is one of the biggest in the whole West Bengal. The campus is very big, and has 6 canteens where food of every range is available.

reviews.review_heading: The college has very good infrastructure and resources.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of our department are very good. The whole department and campus have free Wi-Fi. Classrooms, library, and computer labs are also very modern. Hostel facilities are very good, with rooms for study, food services, and a canteen available. Every sports instrument is available, with a good playground.

reviews.review_heading: Jadavpur University food technology course summary and college life idea.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available on the whole campus. There are a total of 9 canteens, and each hostel has its own separate cooking area. Table tennis, cricket, and football are the most popular sports. The sports culture and fests are the most lovable part of Jadavpur University.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good faculty, placements, and affordable education.
reviews.review_text: The college is good. Hostels are clean. The menu is good and cheap. It has clean labs, and toilets are provided. Medical facilities are also provided. The library is very big and good. Many books are present in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome placements, top-notch faculty, and the college with the highest ROI.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are non-AC, and college infrastructure is decent. Labs are also decent; only the computer lab has AC. Wi-Fi is available throughout the whole campus. A large central library and a departmental library are available. Hostel is so-so, also about mess food. I live outside campus in a PG. I would say the hostel should not be preferred. There is a large playground on the campus, and also an ATMA SBI bank.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Department of Management, J.D Birla InstituteReviewed on 13 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: A college known for its flagship BBA course.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards. The library has a respectable selection of materials that can be accessed both online and offline. There is a canteen inside the building providing vegetarian food only. There are a few indoor games as well as a badminton court.

reviews.review_heading: Jadavpur University has got tier-1 rank by NAAC.
reviews.review_text: Every department has its own library and Wi-Fi. Each classroom is air-conditioned and contains a projector. Both boys' and girls' hostels (3 each) are available for students coming from far rural areas.

reviews.review_heading: An outstanding course for higher studies.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms and, most importantly, the labs are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. There is a huge collection of all types of books in both the central and departmental libraries. Hostels are also at their very best. The hostel charge is actually very nominal.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing return on investment and value for money. Amazing campus life and very good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good. Labs are maintained. Wi-Fi works quite well. Classrooms are quite clean. Library here is one of the best places. There are 4 canteens with reasonable rates for food present. Sports and games are quite encouraged too.

faqs.answer: A:    No, there is no provision of a student studying free at IIT Patna as per the official website. faqs.question: Can I get into IIT Patna for M.Tech without GATE?
faqs.answer: Candidates who wish to apply to the M.Tech programme must have a valid GATE score. Students are screened based on their CGPI in BE/BTech and GATE scores during COAP counselling. However, candidates who have completed their BTech from IITs with a CGPA of 8.0 and above can apply without GATE scores. These applications are reviewed by the respective department (s). Hence, the answer to this question is -yes, it is possible to get into IIT Patna without GATE for MTech.

faqs.question: How can I join IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: BTech and BS courses completely based on JoSAA following an appearance by a candidate for JEE Main and JEE Advanced examination, however for other courses MSc and M.Tech based on GATE, IIT JAM through COAP and CCMN counselling and the seats under PhD course on appearance basis on admission test organized by institute itself. faqs.question: What minimum marks are required in JEE Mains to be eligible for JEE Advanced?

faqs.question: Can I get IIT Patna without JEE Advanced?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is possible to join IIT Patna without JEE Advanced for courses other than BTech. For BTech programme, JEE Main, followed by JEE Advanced, is compulsory for admission. Other than BTech, the institute accepts exams like GATE for M.Tech, followed by COAP counselling. Candidates who are seeking admission to the MTech, BBA, BSc or EMBA need not take JEE Advanced.

faqs.question: What is the placement rate at IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: IIT Patna placement 2026 is ongoing and will continue till May 2026. At the end of Phase 1 placement 2025-26, BTech placement rate was 54.34%. Earlier, the placement rate at IIT Patna stood at 77.92% and 61.01% for BTech and MTech during placements 2024.

faqs.question: What is the salary package offered during IIT Patna placements?
faqs.answer: The highest package offered during IIT Patna placements 2026 was INR 117 LPA. During the placement drive 2024, it was INR 144 LPA. BTech and MTech average package at the end of Phase 1 placement 2025-26 was INR 25.82 LPA and 16.2 LPA. Earlier, as per the placement brochure 2024-25, the average package offered during IIT Patna placements 2024 for BTech, M.Tech and MSc programs stood at around INR 17 LPA, INR 15 LPA and INR 7 LPA, respectively. reviews.review_heading: IIT Patna college honest review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure were top-notch for the Metallurgical and Materials Engineering branch. Wi-Fi facility, modern labs, and central library were present in the college campus. Hostel facility was also good. Washrooms were clean, fresh water was available, and a sports complex was present.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college. IIT Patna is a rapidly growing 2nd generation IIT..
reviews.review_text: All hostels have Wi-Fi installed. Three students share one room in the 1st year boys’ hostel. The newly built library is now open and centrally located. Labs and workshops are well-equipped with all necessary equipment. CLH is amazing with big classrooms. Each department has its own building where research and practical work take place.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to explore and have fun than its better to choose any old IITs.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good but the instruments are old. Wi-Fi is available everywhere, including the hostel, academic building and lecture hall. The library is good and big but during exam time, it has a shortage of seats as all the students come and study overnight. There are not as many canteens and food stalls in comparison to old IITs that is a big problem and also Blinkit , Instamart, Zepto is not available only Jio smart is available but that not sufficient.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Patna M.Tech honest college review.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are good in all aspects. 24 hour electricity is provided, and an emergency generator facility is available. The hostel is neat and clean. Sweepers come regularly to clean the dirty areas, and rooms are properly cleaned every weekend. The mess maintains good quality food.

reviews.review_heading: It is a really good college with great campus life and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch for Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at IIT Patna. There are almost all labs for every subject. The infrastructure for lectures and tutorials are top-notch. Hostel infrastructure is very clean and top-notch, and the mess is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied (worth it).
reviews.review_text: There are separate buildings/floors for different departments, and they have Wi-Fi in all, afaik. Labs are well-equipped and maintained properly. IIT Patna has a central library, which is very beautiful and the heart of the campus; it is a round-shaped building with many floors and Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are well-furnished, and Wi-Fi is available. There are many hostels, but the hostel allotted to freshers is CV Raman. It is well-furnished, and Wi-Fi is available. Mess food is decent. There ...

reviews.review_heading: Strong academic program with knowledgeable faculty.
reviews.review_text: IIT Patna offers comprehensive facilities including modern academic blocks, extensive land with advanced equipment, a well -stocked digital /physical library, a dedicated hostel with Wi-Fi, a hospital/wellness centre, and robust sports amenities. Food safety involves mandatory hygiene rules, outsourced catering with quality check, menu adjustment feedback, and a Jain food option.

reviews.review_heading: Comparing IIT Patna with other IITs.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good if I compare it with other colleges, many IITs have average or just the worst hostel, but here the infrastructure is good, the buildings are new. Mess is also good, but not that good, you can't expect so much from them. Some lifts are not working all the time in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: A day as IIT Patna B.Sc. student.
reviews.review_text: As we have campus immersion every 6 months for 10-15 days, we have the best facilities, hostel, mess, complete access to library, classrooms, gymkhana, and everything. We have a daily workshop in our college in which a teacher comes to guide us for our future.

reviews.review_heading: My review of the IIT Patna.
reviews.review_text: In the friendships structure, it is good for other IITs. It has 516 students and a big campus, but BS students cannot get hostel facilities. If you want hostel facilities, you can contact the IIT administration, who can allot you a hostel with all facilities like a gym and a khana.

reviews.review_heading: My college looks like heaven.
reviews.review_text: IIT Patna College's infrastructure is amazing, it looks like heaven. They have a big library, a big auditorium, and a garden area of 250 acres. The college looks like an angel. I love it, I like it, everything is amazing. Hostel infrastructure is good, mind-blowing, they have girls' and boys' separate hostel rooms.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good with the IIT tag.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Hostels are also good and well-maintained. The mess food is above average and not so good. We would not feel bad on campus because there are so many sports to play, indoors or outdoors, and of course, I must say that it's not enough.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities available for our course are very good. The classrooms and labs are modified and well-maintained. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is average. The hostel rooms are comfortable and clean. Multiple sports and medical facilities are available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is clean and peaceful. Faculty members are helpful. Placement ratio is too good.
reviews.review_text: IIT Patna is located on its permanent campus in Bihta. It has a well-developed infrastructure for both academic pursuits and student residential life. The institute has a central lecture hall and a tutorial building. Each department has well-equipped and fully functioning research and teaching laboratories.

reviews.review_heading: I'm absolutely satisfied because of the faculty and good placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well-planned and developed. The whole campus is covered with Wi-Fi, and the classrooms have smart boards. The labs are updated with the latest technology, computers, and have an Apple lab. The food available in the mess and canteen is freshly prepared and delivered with proper packaging. The campus also has medical facilities and organizes an annual sports meet.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of good placements and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Anna University Chennai is good, and laboratories and libraries are available. They provide separate hostels for both boys and girls with free Wi-Fi. Hostel food is not bad. Average in taste. They give importance to sports as well as studies.

reviews.review_heading: I like hostel life more as college is strict.
reviews.review_text: Our campus was good enough to accommodate 2500 students including two colleges as we had two colleges under the same campus. Blocks were different but common facilities were shared be it library, canteens, sports ground, or the perpetual seminar halls. We had plenty at our campus.

reviews.review_heading: The pride in sharing the greatness of Asia's oldest college.
reviews.review_text: It is the best infrastructure available among the government colleges. The standards and the fees that we pay are very different. Though the fee is low. The infrastructure is very good. The greenery of the trees within the campus gives a good feeling to stay.

reviews.review_heading: My college is a 10 for those who prefer exposure rather than infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available, but the maintenance is poor. Wi-Fi is available, but it lags sometimes. Medical facilities are good enough, and the food is also good. But there is no proper maintenance of restrooms and infrastructure. The canteen still doesn't have Epay, but it is still in development. Cleanliness is at its worst on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with nice campus and social life.
reviews.review_text: The campus life is lot enjoyable. There are lot of space to spend time inside campus, like clubs. Architecture classes are quite good. You can have Wi-Fi access on laptops for free. A wide range of sports are available. Two canteens are available. Hostel and mess food is decent.

reviews.review_heading: I highly recommend, it is good.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available for laptops, and the library is really good with sufficient books and infrastructure. Hostel infrastructure is good, but the taste of mess food is a con, especially lunch. It is really a good college for sports, PPL in ball badminton, hockey, and throw ball. Health facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Anna University College, Chennai for M.E course.
reviews.review_text: The best quality of infrastructure and hostel facilities are also available. College department and hostel facilities include classrooms, lab, fast internet, garden, gym, lift elevator, etc. Canteen food is also good and many varieties of food are available.

reviews.review_heading: My experience of M.Sc. electronic media at Anna University.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of Anna University is good. University is well-managed for students. Labs are advanced. Library has more than 1 lakhs books and journals and full campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostel is clean and well-managed. Mess has separate vegetarian and nonvegetarian food. So this is a better option for students who are vegetarian.

reviews.review_heading: Quality education with strong placements and affordable fees.
reviews.review_text: For my course, they provide good infrastructure with high-speed network in Wi-Fi and data. It provides well-organized labs and wonderful Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan library which has more than 40,000 books. The canteen provides food 3 times a day with good quality and good taste.

reviews.review_heading: Anna University is well satisfied with placements and exploration.
reviews.review_text: All the students of the college are provided with Anna Wi-Fi. The speed of the Wi-Fi is quite enough for academics. There is a health centre inside the campus, which is open to all students, faculty members, etc. There is a huge library inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Anna University, Chennai in the year 2025 admission in M.Tech course information.
reviews.review_text: This college provides the best facilities. They use high-quality infrastructure, products, and materials. This college provides facilities like classrooms, labs, benches, a library, fans, bathrooms, computers, etc. Facilities are available. This college has a canteen. Its food is very tasty and clean.

reviews.review_heading: Good exposure and campus.
reviews.review_text: The department has working labs and classrooms. There is a common library for all students within and outside the nearby campus. You cannot connect to data on your mobile within the department, but they will provide students with Wi-Fi that can be registered with your laptop. The quality of food is subpar in the international hostel. It is very repetitive. Housekeeping is prompt. The medical center closes by 5 pm, so in case of emergency, you have to visit Malar hospital nearby. Sports culture i...

reviews.review_heading: Vibrant Campus Life at CEG.
reviews.review_text: Even though our college is 200 years old, all the infrastructure is present and is very much available for students. But, we may not have a mobile network on the college campus. But there is Wi-Fi present all around the campus so it is very much helpful. Labs have very high facilities like the computers software required are very much pre-installed and ready to use. Hostels are affordable and manageable but still a bit of improvement is required.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, nothing negative as such.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and the infrastructure that is provided to us in our course is that we have access to Wi-Fi 24/7, labs, and also audio-video classrooms. The quality of the facilities that are provided to us in our hostel is really good, and the medical facilities are also really great.

reviews.review_heading: The best university with many facilities.
reviews.review_text: College facilities were good at our university. The infrastructure is very attractive. Our course provides Wi-Fi and a library that has books on all fields. The food quality in the mess is good. The hostel facilities are also good. Many sports events were conducted.

overview_faqs.question: Is NIT Calicut worth all the hype?
overview_faqs.answer: National Institute of Technology, Calicut, also known as NIT Calicut, is one of the oldest NITs in India and has been ranked 2 under the 'Architecture and Planning' category and 21 under the 'Engineering' category by NIRF 2025. The college offers a wide range of programmes to students, mainly in the Engineering and Technology fields. Further, the college has a decent connection with top-notch companies such as Accenture, ADP, Amazon, Amdocs, Baja Auto, American Express, etc.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Calicut Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The highest package last year was 50.64 LPA.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed in our college is 80 percent. The highest package in our college is 50.64 LPA, and the average package in our college is 18.75 LPA. Many MNCs are coming to our college to hire students. The top role offered in our branch is a VLSI design engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Many facilities are also provided in our college, like a cricket ground, a football ground, and many others. Wi-Fi facility is also provided in our college. The mess food is also acceptable, and a health center is also available in our college, and many sports are also available in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The highest package in our college was 50.64 LPA in 2025.

content.Placements: Last year, our campus placement was 90 percent. The highest package was 50.64 LPA, and the average package was 12.17. Top roles offered in our branch were VLSI design engineer, and the internship percentage was 24.4 percent of students were interns, and PG students were 18.62 percent.
content.Infrastructure: We have separate buildings for class and labs. We also have a huge library where we can read many books, and a Wi-Fi facility is available in our hostels. Mess food is acceptable, a health center is also available in our college, and there are three canteens in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: An absolutely amazing college, and better than taking a drop.

content.Placements: In Mechanical engineering, 120 out of 200 students got placed. Top recruiting companies are Bajaj, Ford, L&T, Tata Motors, and Goldman Sachs. Top roles are software engineer, data analyst, finance, and general manager. The highest package is 34 LPA, the average is 9.2 LPA, and the lowest is 5 LPA. Internship rate is 20 percent.
content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi in all hostels, labs, classrooms, etc. More than sufficient non-veg food is available, but veg food quality is debatable. Top medical facilities are available. Multiple ambulances are present 24/7. The college provides free bus transport across campus. All sports are played here, mainly football, basketball, badminton, and handball. Two large plain sandy grounds pending infrastructure, an upcoming indoor sports complex, obviously all these things will also be available after we leave this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Strong curriculum and a good culture of extra activities.

content.Placements: About 85% of students who participated in the placement drive were placed in the 2024-25 placement, with the lowest package of 5 LPA and the highest of 43 LPA, with an average of 13.8 LPA. Core placement was less for B.Tech ECE students, and most of it was for software companies. For internships, 22.7% of students who registered secured one for the year 2025.
content.Infrastructure: NIT Calicut has one of the greatest infrastructures compared to many other colleges. Every classroom has Wi-Fi, projectors, etc. The technical team is quickly available whenever there are any issues regarding these while taking classes. Food is also of good quality, maintaining diversity by providing foods from different parts of India. Sports teams and cultural clubs are also very active in NIT Calicut. I think NIT Calicut is the NIT with the most number of clubs, which include both technical and cultural.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Last year many students got placed in our college.

content.Placements: 84.67 percent of our college students were placed last year. The highest package of our college is 50.64 LPA, and the average package is 13.28 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Samsung, Microsoft, and many more. 22 percent of students got internships in the summer, and the top role is a VLSI designer.
content.Infrastructure: Many facilities are available in our college for the ECE department. We have a library with many resources in it, and there is also a separate lab for the ECE department. The classrooms are also huge. There are Wi-Fi facilities in our hostels and a health center.

Admission to the National Institute of Technology, Calicut courses is done on an entrance basis. The admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. For admission to thefour-year Integrated Teacher Education (ITEP) programme, candidates can reach out to the admission office contact number. TheJEE Advanced 2025official website has launched with the new eligibility criteria. As per the official website, candidates can now attempt theJEE Advanced 2025 exama maximum of three times in three consecutive years.Below is the complete process forNIT Calicut admission:
NIT Calicut Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at NIT Calicut are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For admission to MBA, MA and PhD courses apply through NIT Clicut website.
Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Calicut admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats throughJoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Calicut MBA admissions are done through the CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Calicut cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.question: Is direct admission available for BTech at NIT Calicut?
faqs.answer: No, admission to NIT Calicut BTech course is entirely based on merit obtained in JEE Main entrance exam. The students who secure a score greater than or equal to the cutoff marks become eligible for participation in the JoSAA counselling, which is conducted for the final seat allotment. Futher, vacant seats are filled with CSAB Counselling process.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in NIT Calicut?
faqs.answer: No, NIT Calicut does not facilitate direct admission to any of the courses. Admission is entirely based on merit in the national-level exams, including JEE Main,  GATE,  IIT JAM,  CAT,  NIMCET,  UGC NET, etc. Candidates are further required to participate in other selection rounds, such as counselling, written exam, and interview as well, as per the applied course selection criteria.

faqs.question: What are the courses that NIT Calicut offers?
faqs.answer: The institute offers two undergraduate courses, five postgraduate courses, and one doctoral course. The offered courses by NIT Calicut are as namely BTech, BArch, MTech, MSc, MBA, MPlan, MCA, and PhD. These courses are available in multiple specialisations, including Chemistry,Computer Science and Engineering,Finance,Human Resources,Information Technology, etc.

reviews.review_text: Individual hostel facilities were available for first, second, third, and fourth-year students. Hostel security was very strict. reviews.review_heading: NIT Calicut is a heavenly college in god's own country.
reviews.review_text: The buildings and infrastructure are well maintained. It has regular maintenance and construction throughout the campus, making living here convenient and worth the money spent. Although the campus is very big. You might need a cycle for comfort.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Calicut College.
reviews.review_text:
When we talk about the college's infrastructure, it covers all the basics clean water supply, spacious science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports. There was a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students could also benefit from transportation and on-campus housing if they did not have their own rides. The mess was kept 
clean, and while the food was decent, I think adding a few more choices that students like would be a real bonus.

reviews.review_heading: About good campus life and hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good with changing room allotments by year. In the first year, rooms are shared by 3 students (earlier 4). Second and third years stay in the Mega hostel with 2 students per room. In the final year, students can choose the campus hostels or the Mega hostel, with a single room provided. Wi-Fi or LAN is provided to all the hostels. Mess food is better than that in many colleges, with multiple mess options available. There is a health center outside the main campus.

For triple-sharing rooms with Air conditioning, the fee is INR 90,000 per annum.
