overview_faqs.question: Is SOA University a good university?
overview_faqs.answer: SOA is one of the top private universities in Bhubaneswar, India. It is allotted a band rank of 1201-1400 by the QS World University Rankings 2025. The NIRF 2022 ranked SOA University in 16th position. SOA University has been continuously ranked among the top 20 Universities in India by NIRF. SOA is approved by the UGC and accredited by NAAC, ABET, and NBA. It is also recognised by the Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (SIRO). The SOA University's placement drive for the batch graduating in 2022 has been successfully completed. According to the most recent data, INR 42 LPA was the highest salary package provided during the 2022 placement drive. Students from SOA University's numerous programmes, including B.Tech, MBA, MCA and BDS among others, received favourable offers from reputable businesses during the placement drive for 2022.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee structure of SOA University?
overview_faqs.answer: The hostel fee structure for SOA University depends upon the number of accommodations, for double sharing with Air conditioning the fee is INR 1.20 Lacs per annum. For triple-sharing rooms with Air conditioning, the fee is INR 90,000 per annum. Siksha O Anusandhan University provides separate hostels for boys and girls with 24-hour security and Wi-Fi facilities. There are 13 boys and 11 girls hostel. The hostels also have mess facilities providing hygienic and nutritious food. The mess charges are not included in the hostel fee, candidates need to pay INR 36,000 per annum to avail of the campus mess.

review_summary.college_name: SOA University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, okay placement.

content.Placements: There are many students in our batch. In our institute, the highest package was about 12 LPA. Our top recruiting companies are Dell, Wipro, TCS, etc. In our institution, many of the students were hired by TCS and WIPRO. All types of roles are available.
content.Infrastructure: In our institute, we have smart classrooms with a good internet connection. Our labs and library are very good, and the classrooms are well air-conditioned. Our hostel food is very nice, and we have good sanitation in our hostel. Wi-Fi is available but not too fast.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good, but if you do not take the risk of money, then come to study here. Otherwise, very good.

content.Placements: In this college, the placement rate is above 85%. The top companies are TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Accenture, Cognizant, Dell, And Flipkart (which comes once this year), etc. The average package is 6 to 7 LPA. Recently, Accenture conducted mass recruitment, taking 300 candidates from ITER and providing packages of 12 LPA to around 77 students of the final year. Generally, companies come for placements around the 5th semester and continue to the last semester. Good, but not like KIIT, Odisha.
content.Infrastructure: In the case of the hostel, the fees are 1,10,000 for 1 year, and according to it, the food is good in quality and quantity. The hostel infrastructure is also good and study-friendly. The faculty are good. For machine learning, high-quality labs are provided. In the library, the behavior of teachers is good and very friendly. Free medicine and minor treatment are provided by SUM IMS, SOA. No functions are organized by the college except for the annual function, but many smaller events are organized, like robotics camps, the SOA Cup, and many more. It deserves a 5-star rating.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I chose the best inter for real.

content.Placements: If you study, then you will one hundred percent get a job in our college. 90 percent of students are placed. The average package is 5 LPA. Meanwhile, the highest package is 42 LPA according to current data from Amazon, Infosys, etc top companies visit here.
content.Infrastructure: The environment is so friendly. There are clean and neat classrooms. There is AC in every single class. The professors are friendly and understanding. The hostel is good, but the mess food is not that great. If you get into the habit, you will learn to adjust. The environment is so friendly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: One of the best things about the university is that ragging is strictly prohibited on campus.

content.Placements: 85 to 90 percent students are placed in my course. Out of these students, 35 to 40 percent students are in a specialisation course. The highest Package offered is 46 LPA, the average package 6 to 6.5 LPA, the lowest Package offered is 3.3 to 3.5 LPA. High paying recruiters are Microsoft, Amazon, Adobe, Deloitte, PwC, Informatica, ServiceNow, Zscaler, Yugabyte. Mass Recruiters are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant GenC/Next, Capgemini, Accenture, and DXC Technology. 60 to 70 percent of students secure internships. Top Roles offered are Software Development Engineer SDE, System Engineer or Analyst, Full Stack Developer, Cloud Support Engineer, Data Analyst or Consultant, and Quality Assurance QA Engineer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied because of job opportunities.

content.Placements: My college placements are average. Many companies come to our college, but pick very few students every year. Though the college claims 100% placements, that's not the case. Many of my seniors are struggling to get jobs. Academics are good but lack in extracurricular activities.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is great, but the non-AC hostels are not that good. If you want to stay in good condition, I recommend staying out of the college in a flat or PG. PGs are great there and very cheap. You can find lots of them. The library, Wi-Fi, and canteens are great, and there is no problem there.

reviews.review_heading: I chose the best inter for real.
reviews.review_text: The environment is so friendly. There are clean and neat classrooms. There is AC in every single class. The professors are friendly and understanding. At the end of the day, you will like the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Inter and Teach sounds weird.

Classrooms were smart rooms, and a big central library was also available on campus. In the hostel, they provided Wi-Fi, a gym, four times a day food, power backup, etc.

college_info.intro:
Amrita School of Engineering, Coimbatore, gives different courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels across Engineering and IT & Software streams. As the name suggests, the flagship course of this school is BTech and MTech. Admission is done on the basis of entrance exam scores. Therefore, candidates must secure valid scores in accepted exams such as JEE Main, GATE, etc.
The Institute offers BTech in around 9 specialisations such as Chemical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science and Communication Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and more. Similarly, Amrita School of Engineering offers MTech in around 11 specialisations. The tuition fees for both courses range between INR 3.5 Lakh to INR 24 Lakh. reviews.review_heading: This college is pretty good due to the faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are very strict and we do not have free time to enjoy.

Most offers range between 5-8 LPA, primarily for marketing, sales, and HR roles, along with positions in operations, project management, consultancy, and analysis. The lowest package is 5 LPA. It is advisable to seek internships independently, as those offered by the college are not very relevant.
content.Infrastructure: The basic facilities such as smart boards, microphones and speakers, drinking water, and a girls' common room are available. The departmental library is well-equipped with resources and study materials. There are numerous canteens on campus that offer good food at reasonable prices. The campus is green and beautiful. Talking about the hostel, it has 3-seater rooms, a common room, a reading hall, clean drinking water, and average mess food available.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and the faculty is very helpful in every advice or term.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good. The Wi-Fi and the canteen food are also decent. Sports happen every month, and a lot of students participate in them. Prizes are also decent, like vouchers and electronic gadgets, which are very helpful for students and increase their productivity.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable and superb infrastructure college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-class. Although the area is not that big because of the Delhi location, the overall infrastructure is the best. Jamia has its sports complex where Ranji matches are also held, and all facilities are available. Hostel charges are about Rs. 40,000 per year, including mess and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: It offers what a tier-3 college can provide and is good in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text: The basic facilities such as smart boards, microphones and speakers, drinking water, and a girls' common room are available. The departmental library is well-equipped with resources and study materials. There are numerous canteens on campus that offer good food at reasonable prices. The campus is green and beautiful. Talking about the hostel, it has 3-seater rooms, a common room, a reading hall, clean drinking water, and average mess food available.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Millia Islamia review
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central library was present. Classrooms were integrated with digital TV. The quality of the hostel was extremely good, but the hostel capacity was very less, so most students could not get hostel accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jamia Millia Islamia.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are good. A central library is present. The hostel quality and our faculty members are good. All essential facilities are available. Food and canteen food are good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the overall experience, good environment, and decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are well maintained and have all the basic necessities like Wi-Fi and air-conditioned libraries. The campus has decent infrastructure. The washrooms are not that great and need regular cleaning. Classrooms are well-ventilated. The food quality in the mess and the canteen is average but eatable. Medical facilities are barely provided. There is a huge sports complex at gate number 3.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by A.J.K. Mass Communication Research CentreReviewed on 24 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best college for mass communication.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central Library was present. The quality of the hostel was awesome, but it's rare to get a hostel. A medical facility was available in the college. A sports and games complex was available.

reviews.review_heading: It's a beautiful campus and a well-reputed university, and the teaching staff is great.
reviews.review_text: The hostel accommodation began by December, while I secured a seat in August itself. So it got a little difficult for me. The room is nice, spacious with a 3 seater, food was okay, we used to get veg and non-veg both. The quality was not great but decent. Seats are very much limited, this is one issue. The hostel is 1.5 km away from the college. Hostel fee is INR 48,000 per year. They need improvement in terms of class infrastructure, smart boards and projects are needed.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the quality of the course.
reviews.review_text: Our department is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, AC, a water purifier, and a projector. To conduct experiments, all necessary facilities are available in our lab, including RT-PCR, qPCR, BSL-2, a cell culture room, and a Virus culture lab. Our university has a central library near my department, where you can issue any two books for 14 days. The central canteen has good quality food at a cheap rate, and many other shops are also there. Cricket ground and other sports grounds are working, you ca...

reviews.review_heading: JMI: A central university in New Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms have AC for 2nd year students onwards, and the seats are good. Sometimes issues are faced that are resolved within a few days. Wi-Fi is available. FET library is working from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays. The central library in a block remains open from 9:00 AM-2:AM, except national holidays.

reviews.review_heading: Very good faculty and very nice experience.
reviews.review_text: There are six boys' hostels named F.R.K, A.P.J, B.R.A, A.M.K, Kelat, and S.R.K (Alma Iqbal is not available right now). The hostels and mess are very affordable, with hygienic and nutritious food. The engineering department has one big building with different sections for different departments. The library has AC and Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, but 2024 was not a good year for engineering.
reviews.review_text: All five departments, Computer, Electronic, Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil, have a common building. There is one separate building for the library and reading room, fully air-conditioned with centralized Wi-Fi. Electrical Engineering classes have no AC. In Jamia, there are 7 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic and very affordable. Hostel costs around Rs. 40,000 per year for mess and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, everything is okay.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Department is also good. Wi-Fi is good. Classrooms are not too much good. Library is excellent. The food quality is not too much good in mess. Canteen food is good. Medical facilities are free which is good. Sports and games are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with placement but very good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The quality of mess food is good, especially in A.P.J. hostel and F.R.K. hostel. There are 3 girls' hostels and 6 or 7 boys' hostels, and there are many canteens in Jamia with affordable prices. Sports facilities are available, as well as a clinic. The engineering department has one building, and there is another building for the reading room and library.

reviews.review_heading: 2022 is the best year for electrical engineering.
reviews.review_text: The overall campus is good. The buildings are good, and the dentistry building is very nice, well-maintained, and well-designed. The engineering department has a personal library and reading room, and all 5 departments of engineering have a common building. There are a total of 6 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic, and the food is decent at a reasonable price. Jamia has a sports complex and a free clinic for students.

data.description: Jamia Millia Islamia University has an experienced faculty with good knowledge backed by significant various research contributions. Jamia Millia Islamia has an experienced faculty who are degree, PhD, diploma, and various certificate holders. Jamia Millia Islamia University also invites faculty for various guest lectures and therefore tries to offer an opportunity for students to talk with some of the best and most experienced personalities and therefore learn from them.

college_info.intro:
IIT Gandhinagar popular courses are BTech and MTech. The course curriculum for both courses is flexible. There is a creative learning centre, curriculum-wide project-based learning, a writing studio, and various facilities available for Engineering students. IITGN chemical engineering is also widely pursued by the students. After graduating, BTech and MTech students can work as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Analysts, or take up various other job roles that are relevant to their profile. Overall, IIT Gujarat students are placed in top companies and grab one of the best opportunities available in the job market.
Apart from this, IITGN e-Masters degree programme is also offered for the duration of 2 years. The institute has started accepting applications for batch 2 e-Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation with No GATE score required for admission. The eligibility requirement for the candidates is to have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline such as Engineering, Economics, Law, Commerce, Management, or Finance. In addition to this, a minimum of 60% marks or a 6.0 CGPA is accepted for IIT Gandhinagar e-Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation. Candidates must visit the official website to apply for IIT Gandhinagar e-Masters programme. However, a fee of INR 1000 is mandatory to be made by the candidates. The course comprises six modules spread over 52 credits, with each module lasting 12 to 14 weeks.

With a multi-step admission process, IIT Gandhinagar offers admission to all courses via online mode. Admission to most of the courses is based on national-level entrance exams. However, for courses, such as PhD and MA, the institute conducts interviews and adds a college-level entrance exam (if required) along with performance at the last qualifying degree level. After the selection rounds are over, students are required to go through the exam-specific counselling process for final seat allotment.
A step-by-step process of Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar admission is as follows:
Step 1: IIT Gandhinagar Application
Students seeking admission to IIT Gandhinagar must submit the online application form for course-specific entrance exams or college depending on the course they wish to get into.
Step 2: IIT Gandhinagar University Selection round & Release of Merit List

After the applications are submitted, candidates are required to go through a course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are complete, they are required to go through the course-wise counselling process for final seat allotment. For PhD and E-MTech, online merit lists are released on the official website (with the names of the shortlisted candidates).
Step 3: Admission Confirmation at IIT Gandhinagar

The library is the core of our college with a vast number of academic-related books, along with a good collection of comics, journals, mythology, self-improvement, and biography books. reviews.review_text:
It has the best hostel facilities. If you opt for the newly built hostels, they will provide you with triple, double, and single(mostly in final and pre-final year). Each floor has a kitchen with an induction microwave and a fridge. Bathrooms are like for 5-7 people. Coming towards the labs for my course, they are als...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Gandhinagar: Pros and cons.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of IIT Gandhinagar is very good and world-class. The hostel and academic buildings have outstanding architecture. High-speed wifi is available all the time. The library is also there where students can go and study; almost all varieties of books are available there. Computer labs are also available for students to use every time.

reviews.review_heading: Best IIT campus in India.
reviews.review_text: In the room, there is one cupboard, one bed mattress and a set of tables and chairs. The process of hostel registration is the same as the admission process. In the morning, there is breakfast; in the afternoon, they provide lunch; in the evening, snacks with tea or coffee; and in the night, they serve dinner.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B.Tech in Electronics from the IIT, Gandhinagar.
reviews.review_text: This college had very good infrastructure for our course. The college had labs for our course with all the required equipment. Wi-Fi, library, sports, canteen, etc. facilities were also available on the college campus for the students. The hostel facility was also available for the students. The food in the hostel mess was good to eat. The quality of the rooms in the hostel was also good.

reviews.review_heading: Great exposure with next level learnings.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good with the Wi-Fi available across the campus. The laboratories are very advanced and the campus has different laboratories as per various discipline options available. The library is well stocked with the latest resources along with the classrooms being modern.

reviews.review_heading: A college with good qualities.
reviews.review_text: If I talk about the infrastructure of the institution, I can say that buildings were creatively made, they were restricted for outsiders to enter the institute, and there were playing areas, libraries, and cultural activities areas over there. The best part of the hostel is the cleanliness maintained by staff, and it serves good food.

reviews.review_heading: Perfect infrastructure and facilities .
reviews.review_text: The college's infrastructure is undoubtedly exceptional. Since it is a 2nd-generation IIT, it is well built with all the facilities provided. The hostels as well as the academic area have comprehensive infrastructure. The food and medical services are of high quality.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college facilities and decent placements great for research oriented students.
reviews.review_text: This is the best part of IIT GN. The hostel rooms are very well maintained, and we have AC's that work at night for a peaceful sleep. Good Wi-Fi and LAN facilities are available. Mess food is pretty decent. The sports complex is really the highlight of the campus. It's really well-equipped. There are two libraries: one in the academic area and one in the student hostel area.

college_info.intro:
The flagship programmes offered at IIT Mandi include BTech and MTech. Admissions to UG & PG courses is based on national-level entrance exams, candidates need to visit the official website of various conducting bodies to fill out the application form and pay the required application fee online. IIT Mandi offers a full-time BTech in nine specialisations. These specialisations include Engineering Physics, Microelectronics & VLSI, Computer Science and Engineering, etc. The duration of these courses is four years, further divided into eight semesters. reviews_list.review_title: Great package, but a small campus.

review_content.Placements: 100 percent of students have been placed in the computer science course. The highest package is 90 LPA, the lowest is 17 LPA, and the average is 30 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Adobe. Nearly 80 percent of the batch got an internship by 3rd year in companies like Microsoft and Samsung. Top roles offered are SWE and product manager.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure available is great, but less compared to the number of students. Hostel infrastructure and cleanliness are great, but rooms are a bit cramped, the mess food is sometimes good and sometimes very bad. Sports (especially badminton) facilities are great. Medical facilities are also up to date.

reviews_list.review_title: College is situated in the foothills of Himalayas and provides so much positivity.

content.Placements: The mathematics and computing course at IIT Mandi was started in 2023. The placement for the branch has not started yet but the internship of our seniors is very good with most of them securing internships. Some secured internships for the SDE role while others got trading or finance-related roles. Some interned in AI-ML, and some joined the research sector according to their interests. Some companies that have hired interns include Microsoft, Sprinkler, Adobe, Goldman Sachs, and Boconni University's Quant Finance, among others.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus provides good classroom, library and labs facility with very pretty scenic view of the mountains, Wi-Fi facility is very good in labs and library but not that good overall, sports facilities are good but mostly in the South campus so there is problem of up down from one campus to another but have many facilities in North campus also, mess food is decent and campus have decent amount of canteens not much, medical facilities provided is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: The highest package was 65 LPA last year, and the average is around 27 LPA for my branch. Nearly 90 percent+ got placed last year. Top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Nvidia, Flipkart, etc. The same percentage of students got internships, and those were in Google, LibreOffice, etc.
content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi, but it is not optimized to work for Windows, and we have a lot of problems connecting Windows to the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are well structured. The library is also well built and has great facilities. Food in the hostel is sometimes good and sometimes not. Medical facilities are provided for free, and we have a sports complex and a large ground on the campus for most sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Great package, but a small campus.

content.Placements: 100 percent of students have been placed in the computer science course. The highest package is 90 LPA, the lowest is 17 LPA, and the average is 30 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Adobe. Nearly 80 percent of the batch got an internship by 3rd year in companies like Microsoft and Samsung. Top roles offered are SWE and product manager.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure available is great, but less compared to the number of students. Hostel infrastructure and cleanliness are great, but rooms are a bit cramped, the mess food is sometimes good and sometimes very bad. Sports (especially badminton) facilities are great. Medical facilities are also up to date.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is situated in the foothills of Himalayas and provides so much positivity.

content.Placements: It has been 100 percent placement this year. CSE has an average package greater than 29 LPA. The highest package has been around 1 CPA, and the lowest is around 15 LPA. Companies like FAANG, MAANG, and top HFTs have come to our campus. Placement is so awesome, but apparently we have to work hard too.
content.Infrastructure: Department of each branch has huge infrastructure and labs worth 1.5 crores. Everywhere in the campus there is availability of Wi-Fi facilities. Hostels are good, but due to increasing seats, the space might become congested. Mess provides decent food, but it can be worse.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Very strong placements with a peaceful lifestyle in the mountains of the Himalayas.

content.Placements: Almost 95 percent of the total students participating in placements are placed, and it is 100 percent for CSE branch. In CSE, the highest package is 80 LPA, and average was 29 LPA, with the lowest being 6 LPA. Top recruiters were Amazon, Adobe, Infosys, HCL, Microsoft, Mahindra, JP Morgan, Samsung, Tata Motors and TCS. On-campus internship was done by 41% students
content.Infrastructure: There are every possible facilities available in our course, but only thing that may be troublesome for some students is the 4 sharing rooms for 1st year students. Mess food quality also decreased after a couple of months, but is restored upon complaint to the dean's office.

placement_data.title: IIT Mandi Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: A total of 215 recruiters visited IIT Mandi campus in 2025 for BTech placements and placed 95.04% of the BTech Class 2025 in new-age job roles. The average package offered to BTech CSE students during IIT Mandi placements in 2024 stood at INR 29.33 LPA . Further, the overall average and median package offered to BTech students during IIT Mandi placements in 2025 was INR 21.64 LPA and INR 17 LPA. The top recruiters of IIT Mandi in 2025 included Infosys, Microsoft, Amazon, HCL, IBM, TCS, ICICI Bank, etc. The highest and average package received during IIT Mandi placement 2025 for MBA program stood at INR 39 LPA and INR 16 LPA . Analytics was the top recruiting domain during the placement drive 2025.

IIT Mandi has a Career and Placement Cell (CnP cell) that helps in shaping the careers of students from their induction and orientation, summer internships, mid-term projects, right to their final placements, and even beyond. CRC also undertakes various academic and non-academic initiatives so that students are well-equipped to meet varied industry requirements.

As per the latest report, 192 recruiters visited IIT Mandi in 2024 and placed 84% of the BTech Class 2024 in new-age job roles. The average package offered to BTech CSE students during IIT Mandi placements in 2024 stood at INR 26.55 LPA . Further, the overall median package offered to BTech students during IIT Mandi placements in 2024 stood at INR 21 LPA.

Earlier, the Phase 1 of IIT Mandi placements 2023 concluded with 249 job offers . As per the media reports, 201 recruiters participated during IIT Mandi placements 2023 and presented 90 international offers and 75 PPOs to the batch 2023. The highest and average package offered during IIT Mandi placements in 2023 was INR 60 LPA and INR 25.23 LPA, respectively. The top recruiters of IIT Mandi in 2023 included Infosys, Microsoft, Amazon, HCL, IBM, TCS , ICICI Bank , etc.

reviews.review_heading: It's very good and satisfactory, the scenic beauty of the mountains and nature is fabulous.
reviews.review_text: Our campus provides good classroom, library and labs facility with very pretty scenic view of the mountains, Wi-Fi facility is very good in labs and library but not that good overall, sports facilities are good but mostly in the South campus so there is problem of up down from one campus to another but have many facilities in North campus also, mess food is decent and campus have decent amount of canteens not much, medical facilities provided is good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi, but it is not optimized to work for Windows, and we have a lot of problems connecting Windows to the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are well structured. The library is also well built and has great facilities. Food in the hostel is sometimes good and sometimes not. Medical facilities are provided for free, and we have a sports complex and a large ground on the campus for most sports.

reviews.review_heading: Great package, but a small campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available is great, but less compared to the number of students. Hostel infrastructure and cleanliness are great, but rooms are a bit cramped, the mess food is sometimes good and sometimes very bad. Sports (especially badminton) facilities are great. Medical facilities are also up to date.

reviews.review_heading: College is situated in the foothills of Himalayas and provides so much positivity.
reviews.review_text: Department of each branch has huge infrastructure and labs worth 1.5 crores. Everywhere in the campus there is availability of Wi-Fi facilities. Hostels are good, but due to increasing seats, the space might become congested. Mess provides decent food, but it can be worse.

reviews.review_heading: Very strong placements with a peaceful lifestyle in the mountains of the Himalayas.
reviews.review_text: There are every possible facilities available in our course, but only thing that may be troublesome for some students is the 4 sharing rooms for 1st year students. Mess food quality also decreased after a couple of months, but is restored upon complaint to the dean's office.

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics, great exposure and college provide everything you need except money for fests.
reviews.review_text: Bio engineering at IIT Mandi has smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, advanced labs and a well stocked central library. Hostels are clean with good amenities, the mess food is decent, medical facilities are available on campus and sports facilities are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities, but they can always be better.
reviews.review_text: It's a newer IIT that is second-generation III, so the hostels are good. One thing I don't like is that we are four people in a room, which I think is a room for 2 people. The Wi-Fi facility is good. The food can be better, and for sports and games, it's above satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi.
reviews.review_text: We all know that the infrastructure and facilities of any IIT college are top-class. IIT Mandi is no exception. The entire campus of IIT Mandi is divided into two parts - the North Campus and the South Campus. There are around 10 hostels in IIT Mandi. Each room has a bed, study desk, chair, wardrobe, and attached bathroom.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely loving it, it's a different place, good interactions, lovely nature, and best placements.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good, I mean nice bus, not as good as it could be because of obvious reasons, the physical location of IIT Mandi is in the mountains and there it is not possible to construct such big buildings, but we are provided with common room, pantry room, vending machines shared between hostels nearby, study room, washing machines, and fridge all.

reviews.review_heading: It's the most beautiful college with such a beautiful environment, It's lovely.
reviews.review_text: The course curriculum is good, and all the required facilities are in the hostel as well. We have laundry, a pantry, sports rooms, a fan, a table, a chair, and an almira (cupboard), everything in our rooms. Wi-Fi facilities, well-established labs, and nice classrooms with a projector, board and AC.

reviews.review_heading: Collection is awesome, such a beautiful location.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteens, medical, classroom with AC, sports, mess, and all are available on campus. We have common room, study room, Wi-Fi, vending machine, pantry room, and laundry room. We also have table, chair, and almirah in hostel. Its a good experience to live on such a beautiful campus.

reviews.review_heading: Heaven in mountains - IIT Mandi.
reviews.review_text: Classes are in very good condition, and the cleanliness is top-tier. For summer, there is air conditioning, and for winter, there are heaters. The Wi-Fi is also good. The mess food is good, and sports facilities are very good. All the grounds are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Mandi has excellent placement, infrastructure, faculty and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of courses in IIT Mandi is excellent. Free Wi-Fi is available for students in every hostel, classroom, and library. All buildings of IIT Mandi are new. Classrooms have AC facility, charging points at every bench, a study environment, and are in excellent condition. A central library is present there which contains over 50,000 books. Hostel facility is also excellent in IIT Mandi. There are available indoor games (table tennis, etc.), washing machines, Wi-Fi, theater, geysers, ...

reviews.review_heading: It has pretty good infrastructure, good research Is going on and has good placements in 2023.
reviews.review_text: Since it's a 2009 built IIT, it has pretty good infrastructure. It has all the required labs with all the necessary equipment. Every hostel, mess, and academic block has a Wi-Fi connection. In rooms, they provide a bed, study table, chair, and a locker. Mess and canteen food is okay; South Indians may face issues with the food.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely below average as compared to other IITs. Too much restrictions here.
reviews.review_text: Overall the infra is good. Wi-Fi and Internet connectivity are very good throughout the campus. We have a good library fully air-conditioned and warm and neat and clean also. The classroom is also good. Labs are also good like others.

paragraphs: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Jodhpur course admissions are open for all courses over 11 departments.IIT Jodhpur admissionis entrance and merit-based. The institute offers UG, PG, PhD, and PG diploma programmes in various disciplines. The selection is based on performance in national-level entrance exams likeJEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, etc. Candidates applying for courses, including BTech, MSc, and MTech, must also appear for the counselling rounds conducted by the respective bodies. To seek admission toIIT Jodhpur, aspirants can visit the official website of the entrance exam, and fill out and submit the applications. Read on to know more aboutIIT Jodhpur admissions 2025:
IIT Jodhpur Admission 2025: Highlights

IIT Jodhpur admission process consists of multiple steps. The admission procedure involves registration, entrance exam, shortlisting, release of merit list, counselling, and admission confirmation. The complete IIT Jodhpur admission process is explained below:
Step 1: IIT Jodhpur Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Jodhpur are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed. However, for MBA admission, candidates have to fill an online application form on the official website of IIT Jodhpur.
Step 2: IIT Jodhpur Selection Criteria 2025

After filling the application form, students are required to take the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After which, counselling rounds are carried out for some of the programmess for the seat allotment process.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Candidates selected after all the selection rounds can confirm their admission/seat by paying the required amount of fee.

courses_data.description: IIT Jodhpur offers a full-timeBTechprogramme that lasts four years. To get into this programme, students need to have good scores in the JEE Main exam. Check out the following video for a comparison between IIT Jodhpur and IIT Delhi:

faqs.question: Is IIT Jodhpur good for BTech?
faqs.answer: The institute is ranked 30 among the top colleges of India under the “Engineering” category by NIRF in 2022 rankings. DuringIIT Jodhpur placementsin 2022, the median and average package offered to BTech CSE students was INR 28.7 LPA and INR 28 LPA, respectively. The top recruiters of IIT Jodhpur in 2022 included Accenture, Amazon, IBM, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Adobe, etc.

faqs.question: How to apply for BTech at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Admission to the course is entrance-based. Aspirants are required to take JEE Main and JEE Advanced. The selected students based on merit in JEE Advanced further have to participate in JoSAA rounds of counselling. The seat allotment process is then carried out as per performance in counselling and other selection rounds.

faqs.question: How can I get into IIT Jodhpur for BTech?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech programme at IIT Jodhpur is based on performance in the all-India level Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Main), followed by JEE Advanced. Based on JEE Advanced score, candidates need to take part in JoSAA counselling. Candidates can apply on the JEE official website (nta.ac.in). Candidates who secure a rank more than or equal to the IITJ BTech cutoff become eligible for admission.

courses_data.name: IIT Jodhpur MTech Admission 2025
courses_data.description: At the PG level, candidates are selected for MTech at IIT Jodhpur via a valid GATE score. Aspirants must apply and appear for the entrance exam along with fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria to apply for the course.

faqs.question: Is it worth doing MTech from IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: IITJ is ranked 30 among top Engineering institutes as per the NIRF 2022 rankings. The institute has a good placements record. The median package offered to MTech CSE and M.Tech AI students were INR 14 LPA and INR 14.5 LPA, respectively. Some of the top companies that participated in the IIT Jodhpur placements drive were Accenture, Adobe, Amazon, IBM, TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, etc.

faqs.question: Is any financial assistance given to M.Tech programme students at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a BE, BTech, BS, or BDes degree and a GATE or GPAT qualification are eligible for financial aid worth INR 12,400 per month. Even if they do not pass the GATE exam, IIT BTech graduates with a CGPA of 8 or higher are eligible for assistantships. Sponsored category students cannot get an IITJ assistantship, nevertheless. This data is as per past years' records and hence may vary.

faqs.question: How to get admission in a M.Tech course at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: The selection is based on GATE scores followed by COAP Counselling. Candidates shortlisted are invited for written exam or interview round for final selections. Aspirants shall complete theGATE application process(gate.iitk.ac.in) within the due date to be eligible for admission as there is no other provision for admission. With a valid COAP score, students may have to apply on IITJ website as well.

faqs.question: Is it necessary to participate in COAP counselling for M.Tech at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: The Common Offer Acceptance Portal (COAP) is a registration portal. Candidates who pass GATE exam are required to apply on COAP portal for counselling. Only the students who register successfully on the portal become eligible for admission in an M.Tech course of IIT Jodhpur.

courses_data.description: Admission to IIT Jodhpur MBA course is entirely entrance-based. Candidates must qualify for either CAT or GATE as per the course requirements. Furthermore, a PI round is also conducted to finalise the shortlisted candidates.

faqs.question: Can I do MBA in IIT Jodhpur without CAT?
faqs.answer: Admission to MBA course at IIT Jodhpur is entirely entrance-based. To get admission to MBA and MBA Technology at IIT Jodhpur, candidates must apply with a valid CAT percentile. However, the institute also provides admission to Non-CAT qualifiers. For admission to MBA in FinTech and Cyber Security, aspirants are selected based on a valid GATE score.The online application form can be filled out by visiting the institute's official website. faqs.question: What is the eligibility requirement for IIT Jodhpur MBA course?
faqs.answer: To be eligible to apply for MBA admission at IIT Jodhpur, candidates must pass Class 12 and graduation in the respective subjects. Candidates who secured minimum 60% aggregate or 6.00 CGPA in their graduation are eligible to apply for MBA. However, there is a five percent relaxation is given to SC/ST/PwD candidates. individual_reviews.user_name: DANDAMUDI U V R SUDHEER CHOWDHARY
individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: According to education it is good, but poor infrastructure.

content.Placements: Above 80 percent are placed in this college. The highest package is 88 LPA, the lowest around 8 LPA, and the average around 20 LPA. Top companies like Siemens, Microsoft, and Amazon visit the campus. 70 percent of the members got internships, and the remaining are also trying very hard to get internships. Role offers include electronic, control, and automation engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi good, labs okay, classrooms need improvement, and library excellent. Hostel contains better facilities, especially about food. NIT Warangal serves very quality and hygiene food, and also good in taste. Wi-Fi also gets everywhere in the campus and also good hostels.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.

content.Placements: Placements here are well organized. Nearly 85% of students are eligible for placements, and 90% of them are already placed. The highest package this year is 1.25 crore, which is the highest package our college has ever seen. Most students from our branch get internships in consultancy and management.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms in our branch department are very good and spacious. Wi-Fi is available in each classroom. Labs are well-maintained. The college library consists of more than 10 lakh books, which are open to everyone, and more than 10,000 e-books are also available. The hostels are good. The mess food is satisfactory. There is a food street as a canteen where we can get a variety of foods.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placement.

content.Placements: NIT Warangal is the top 1 NIT college in our ECE course, which has demand with other courses. 86% of students were placed in our course. The highest package is 77 LPA, the average package is 22 LPA, and the lowest package is 9 LPA. Amazon, Microsoft, and PhonePe are the top recruiting companies that visited, and 80% of students got internships from our course.
content.Infrastructure: The NIT Warangal infrastructure is excellent, clean, and neat. The facilities are available 24/7 with a high-speed network. Classrooms are clean and neat, with one lab for each subject. The quality of food is good and hygienic, and they keep a variety of food daily. Sports and games are available.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements.

content.Placements: NIT Warangal is one of the best NITs in India. It offers many courses in engineering. 75 percent of students got placed. The highest package offered is 70 LPA. The lowest package is 20 LPA. The average package is 30 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Flipkart, Amazon, Google, etc. 50 percent of students got internships in start-ups.
content.Infrastructure: Some hostels are good, but we are not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room, not even the iron. The weather is too hot, and we are not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. The library is good with all types of books. Technology-based books are also available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: NIT Warangal is a good college.

content.Placements: After completing the 4th semester, students are eligible for internships, and mainly companies as I know are Oracle, ITC, TCS, Amazon, and Google, with the highest till I know being 88 LPA, a good percentage of people get placement here, and companies visit for internship, as I know ITC is said by our seniors, and I am not completely aware of what others would be there, as I am still searching on it, in the 7th–8th semester, there should be a project made by all students.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are not that good as washrooms are not cleaned every day, which makes it difficult, and the mess is average, though the food kept on special dinner is best, there is a big library through which we can access our books of any kind, many clubs are there which makes it better, Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security, classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and there are gym facilities in each hostel which can be accessed by all students with hostel timings.

admission_overview.college_name: NIT Warangal Course Admission 2025: Cutoff, Fees, Eligibility & Application

paragraphs: NIT Warangal admission 2025is entrance-based. National Institute of Technology (NIT) Warangal offers a list of courses at the UG, PG and PG Diploma levels. BTech is the flagship programme of the institute. Admission to undergraduate engineering, i.e., BTech atNIT Warangalis depnds on JEE Main. Applicable students can apply by going to the verified website of the National Testing Agency (NTA). Different national-level examinations allowed by the institute areCAT, MAT, GATE, IIT JAM, and NIMCET.

Prior to applying forNIT Warangal course admissions, it is suggested that the students should check the eligibility criteria specified particular to the course. However, for the MBA course, group discussions and personal interviews are conducted.
NITWarangal Admission 2025: Eligibility & Selection

TheNIT Warangal admission processfor most of the courses is entrance-based. Hence, applicants must have a valid score on the respective accepted entrance exam. NIT Warangal accepts the GATE score for MTech admission. Admission to the flagship course of NIT Warangal i.e. BTech is offered based on JEE Main score of the aspirants. Check below theNIT Warangal coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
HSC, and having a minimum of 75% aggregate and studiedPhysics, Chemistry, andMathematicsas core subjects
JEE Main+JoSAAcounselling
Bachelor’s degree with a minimum aggregate of 60%
CAT/MAT+ GD & PI
BTech in relevant subject with a minimum 60% aggregate
GATE+CCMTcounselling
BSc with a minimum aggregate of 60%
IIT JAM+CCMNcounselling
Bachelor's degree with at least 60% aggregate or equivalent CGPA
NIMCET+ Counselling

NIT Warangal fee structurefor all UG and PG courses includes components such as tuition fees, hostel fees, security deposit, and one-time fee payments. The components like tuition fees are charged annually or semesterly. In addition, it is within the rights of the institute to revise the fee structure. students are offered seats in the BTech programme through JoSAA Counselling. students need to participate in counselling for all other courses to get a seat in the institute. The seats in the flagship programme of NIT Warangal i.e. BTech is offered based on the JEE Main score of the aspirants. Below is the course-wise NIT Warangal seat intake:

NIT Warangal UG and PG admissioninvolves an application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list and counselling. Aspirants have to go through each admission stage for seat allotment. The application form can be filled out online on the official website of the respective national-level exams. Find below the completeNIT Warangal admission process:
1: NIT Warangal Application Process

students seekingadmission at NIT Warangalare required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, students have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, students seeking admission to PhD courses are through the official website (https://nitw.ac.in/).
2: Selection Rounds

The institute admits students with a valid JEE Main score for BTech courses. students are further allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However,NIT Warangal MBA admissionsare done through the CAT/ MAT scores. Aspirants further need to come for the personal interview round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Warangal cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted students need to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

However, a few National Institutes of Technology (NITs) also offers MCA course for a duration of three years. NIT Warangal admission to this course is based on candidates' performance in the National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET).

faqs.question: How to get MCA Seat in NIT Warangal?
faqs.answer: To apply for the National Institute of Technology Warangal MCA course, candidates need to apply for the National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET). Eligible students are then required to appear for the NIMCET entrance exam. Besides, aspirants must also pass a three-year bachelor's degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate to apply for MCA programme.

faqs.question: Does NIT Warangal accept NIMCET score for MCA admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Warangal offers MCA specialisation based on NIMCET scores. NIMCET is a Common Entrance National Level Test, conducted by any of the NITs, for admission in to their MCA programme. The MCA programme is offered by NITs atAgartala, Allahabad, Bhopal, Jamshedpur, Kurukshetra, Patna, Raipur, Surathkal, Tiruchirappalli, Warangal and IIIT at Bhopal. The admission into the MCA programme for the year 2024-25 in above 10 NITs and 01 IIIT is based on the Rank obtained in NIMCET-2024 only.

faqs.question: How can I get MBA at NIT Warangal?
faqs.answer: Students are given admission in the MBA courses at NIT Warangal through Common Admission Test (CAT). Aspirants can apply for MBA with a valid MAT scores. A merit list is prepared based on the CAT Percentile of the candidates. NIT Warangal MBA admission is done through a merit list of entrance tests. Based on CAT scores, candidates are then called for the Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GD & PI) round for final admission.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: How many marks required in JEE Main for NIT Warangal?
faqs.answer: The cutoff changes depending on rounds, specialisations, and categories. If you qualify under the General AI quota, the maximum required JEE Main cutoff rank for B.Tech admission was60255in 2025.Those who have a lower cutoff than the one specified can get a seat in NIT Warangal BTech. For CSE, ECE, etc., the cutoff ranks tend to be lower showing high competition for admission in the engineering aspirants.

placement_data.title: NIT Warangal Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: According to the placement report 2025 released by the Institute, NIT Warangal recorded placement rate of 79.3% in 2025 . The highest package offered during NIT Warangal placements 2025 was I NR 64.3 LPA . The average and median package received by students in 2025 was INR 14.35 LPA and INR 12 LPA , respectively. Further, 290 companies visited the campus ad 1225 offers were made as well.

Earlier, NIT Warangal highest package offered in 2024 stood at INR 88 LPA . The average package received by students during NIT Warangal placements 2024 was INR 15.6 LPA . The overall placement rate was 76%. More than 305 companies visited and 1,128 offers were made in 2024. A total of 1120 students were placed as well. NITK witnessed the return of the majority of past recruiters during placement drive 2023-24. There was also an increase in the number of new recruiters during this placement drive. IT sector emerged as the top recruiting sector that made 54% of the total full-time offers during the placement drive 2023-24. Top profiles in the areas such as Data Analysis, Software Engineering, Product Analysis , Consultancy , Management and Data Science were offered to students.

NIT Warangal has a dedicated Centre for Career Planning and Development (CCPD) that looks after all placement-related activities. Meanwhile, NIT Warangal placement process includes 6 steps. In the first step, invitations are sent to companies . In step 2 and 3, SPOCs are assigned to companies and placement drives are scheduled , respectively. The fourth and fifth steps includes Pre-Placement talks followed by tests and interviews . In the final step, shortlisted candidates get the offer letter from the respective companies.

reviews.review_text: The classrooms in our branch department are very good and spacious. Wi-Fi is available in each classroom. Labs are well-maintained. The college library consists of more than 10 lakh books, which are open to everyone, and more than 10,000 e-books are also available. The hostels are good. The mess food is satisfactory. There is a food street as a canteen where we can get a variety of foods.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placement.
reviews.review_text: The NIT Warangal infrastructure is excellent, clean, and neat. The facilities are available 24/7 with a high-speed network. Classrooms are clean and neat, with one lab for each subject. The quality of food is good and hygienic, and they keep a variety of food daily. Sports and games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: Some hostels are good, but we are not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room, not even the iron. The weather is too hot, and we are not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. The library is good with all types of books. Technology-based books are also available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Warangal is a good college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not that good as washrooms are not cleaned every day, which makes it difficult, and the mess is average, though the food kept on special dinner is best, there is a big library through which we can access our books of any kind, many clubs are there which makes it better, Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security, classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and there are gym facilities in each hostel which can be accessed by all students with hostel timings...

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good vibes in the college.
reviews.review_text: There is a huge central library in the college which consists of almost every book possible. There are whiteboards and projectors in mostly every classroom. There are various societies and clubs. In the first year, there is a hostel named 1.8 K Ultra Mega Hostel, and the hostel room is not that big but fine for 2 persons. Quality of food is good; there is breakfast, lunch, and dinner there.

reviews.review_heading: Choose better college than this.
reviews.review_text: We have an auditorium where a movie is screened every week with a good sounding atmosphere. Infrastructure of hostel must be improved. The only problem is about washrooms. They don't even clean them properly. In hostel, two persons are adjusted in one room. Two beds and two study tables are provided. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for Mechanical Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Hostel costs are affordable. There is an ethernet connection, electricity, fan, and cool mineral water in every hostel. The campus is very good. A big library is available for students for free. Good sports facilities and grounds are there. Gym is available for everyone. Many events and festivals are celebrated well. There are lots of clubs students can join to explore and learn. Gym is available. There are also coffee shops in campus, a food street where you can have food or buy necessary items...

reviews.review_heading: Good college and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Some hostels were good but we were not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room not even the iron also the weather was too hot and we were not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Library was good all types of books and technology based books are available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: Definitely you can join this college.
reviews.review_text: NITW is known for its 1.8k hostel. It’s Asia’s largest hostel. The hostel facilities are very wonderful. They provide beds, fans, and lights. The mess quality is also good, but it can be improved. The mess menu should be diversified and should satisfy both North Indian and South Indian students. The vast library possesses excellent books which give students immense knowledge. There are also excellent sports facilities. There is a huge stadium. Students can also enjoy playing different games like...

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure covers all the basic needs: clean water, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for events, a playground for sports, and a well-stocked library. The classrooms are tidy, and there is transportation and on-campus housing for students who need it. The mess is clean and the food is decent, though a few more options would be nice.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Warangal College.
reviews.review_text: On the downside, there are not really enough instructors, and the classrooms are well, they are pretty basic. The canteen menu is kind of limited too mostly just samosas and tea. The campus feels more like a place for cramming for exams rather than a real learning environment. There's no medical facility around. The hostel accommodation is not the best, but they offer some comfort. The mess serves hygienic food, and the water supply is pretty well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: NIT, Warangal is the best NIT in India.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are big enough. Classrooms are chilled with AC and fans. Library is also big enough. Hostel food contains variety of food daily. Canteen is also available. Medical service is for 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: College is a paved path, if you want a good placement, you have to run fast.
reviews.review_text: All over, the college is good, having a lush green campus and a nature-friendly environment,  Wi-Fi is available in the college, and in the hostel, we have LAN ports. Hostel rooms are good, with single and double occupancy. Mess food is good, it might vary from person to person, but for me, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Warangal College review.
reviews.review_text: The college has solid infrastructure with helpful amenities which is especially great for Science students. We have well-equipped labs and a decent library. For those traveling from afar, the hostel provides enough room. The mess is clean and while the food menu is alright. It would not hurt to add a few more options that students actually enjoy.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good college but uncertain future.

review_content.Placements: I believe the percentage of the coe batch this year is low. It is around 50 to 60 percent. I believe the highest package went around 50 to 60 LPA. The lowest package is 4 to 5 LPA. The average package this year for coe is approximately 12. Do not worry about companies all the top companies like De Shaw, JPMorgan, Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, Deloitte and many more come here for recruitment. The percentage of internships is not disclosed. Top roles offered are SDE, Data Scientist and cloud computing.
review_content.Infrastructure: Its a private college, infrastructure is absolutely top notch. Hostels are air conditioned and your classes are air conditioned. Right now my college is undergoing an overhaul. New infrastructure is being built so in the next 1 year this college will look nothing less than a 5 star property. The library is Indias the biggest and Asias 7th biggest so yeah. Hostels are top notch quality of food which is also decent unlike government hostels. All types of sports facilities are available on the campus and many are under construction.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty and decent placements.

review_content.Placements: Around 60 to 70 percent of students from my course got placed by the end of the placement season. Placement opportunities are decent, especially for students who are consistent with coding, projects and internships. The highest package is around 12 to 14 LPA, the lowest package is 3LPA and the average package is 5 to 6LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities on campus are decent and sufficient for a student. The campus has Wi-Fi, well maintained computer labs, smart classrooms and a good well maintained library. Hostel facilities are average with basic amenities and cleanliness is maintained. The mess food is average and repetitive but the canteens provide additional options. Basic medical facilities for both indoor and outdoor activities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It is the drastic mistake of my life.

review_content.Placements: There are around 75 students, out of which 6 to 7 are placed and 93% are unplaced. Later, some students are able to get placed on their own or through referrals. Students study biotech for 4 years, and the college does not provide even a single core company. We are eligible for very few companies (10 out of 100), mostly in sales or pure technical coding roles. Finance and consulting companies are there, but hardly 1 or 2.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college is excellent in terms of hostels and classrooms. But average in terms of labs. As many core experiments are done in groups of 10 people, giving little hands-on experience. Hostel facilities are high class with good food. Classrooms are also good and air-conditioned.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Extremely good infrastructure, nice faculty, but the fees are a bit high.

review_content.Placements: About 70 per cent of the students in my college were placed. Top recruiters are Nvidia and BAINS. About 40 per cent of the students got an internship in the 5th semester in companies like BAINS, BCG, etc. Top roles offered in my course are A. E. [Assistant Engineer] in PSPSCL.
review_content.Infrastructure: Superb hostels, nice bathrooms, Wi-Fi speed is mid but manageable. Labs have top-quality, up-to-date machines and instruments. Lecture halls are very good and in nice condition. Roads and stadiums are very good. Overall, nice infrastructure as well as 24th NIRF rank.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure with AC campus but the mess food is average.

review_content.Placements: About 85% of students definitely get placed in the main courses of computer engineering and computer science. Some students even get very high starting packages as well. Top roles offered are usually SDE, product managers, data analysts, and web developers.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs and classroom are good. The library has a vast collection of books and reference material with large sitting areas. But the baggage area outside is quite small in comparison. The sports centre is great, and has good quality equipment. The food in hostels is not that great though.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: This college is something great that everyone should experience. The infrastructure is top-notch.

review_content.Placements: I have chosen Computer Science engineering, the top branch. Highest package was 55 LPA, and top companies come to recruit. As heard from seniors, competition is quite tough, we need to be perfectionists in our fields, with overall development.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi in the whole building. Library is great, very beautifully made, and the labs are well maintained with all equipments. We have all medical facilities, and mess food is all delicious with hygiene maintained. We have all the games from table tennis to swimming. Infrastructure is good, very clean and maintained,

review_summary.college_name: TIET Patiala Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good college but uncertain future.

content.Placements: I believe the percentage of the coe batch this year is low. It is around 50 to 60 percent. I believe the highest package went around 50 to 60 LPA. The lowest package is 4 to 5 LPA. The average package this year for coe is approximately 12. Do not worry about companies all the top companies like De Shaw, JPMorgan, Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, Deloitte and many more come here for recruitment. The percentage of internships is not disclosed. Top roles offered are SDE, Data Scientist and cloud computing.
content.Infrastructure: Its a private college, infrastructure is absolutely top notch. Hostels are air conditioned and your classes are air conditioned. Right now my college is undergoing an overhaul. New infrastructure is being built so in the next 1 year this college will look nothing less than a 5 star property. The library is Indias the biggest and Asias 7th biggest so yeah. Hostels are top notch quality of food which is also decent unlike government hostels. All types of sports facilities are available on the campus and many are under construction.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty and decent placements.

content.Placements: Around 60 to 70 percent of students from my course got placed by the end of the placement season. Placement opportunities are decent, especially for students who are consistent with coding, projects and internships. The highest package is around 12 to 14 LPA, the lowest package is 3LPA and the average package is 5 to 6LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities on campus are decent and sufficient for a student. The campus has Wi-Fi, well maintained computer labs, smart classrooms and a good well maintained library. Hostel facilities are average with basic amenities and cleanliness is maintained. The mess food is average and repetitive but the canteens provide additional options. Basic medical facilities for both indoor and outdoor activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is the drastic mistake of my life.

content.Placements: There are around 75 students, out of which 6 to 7 are placed and 93% are unplaced. Later, some students are able to get placed on their own or through referrals. Students study biotech for 4 years, and the college does not provide even a single core company. We are eligible for very few companies (10 out of 100), mostly in sales or pure technical coding roles. Finance and consulting companies are there, but hardly 1 or 2.
content.Infrastructure: The college is excellent in terms of hostels and classrooms. But average in terms of labs. As many core experiments are done in groups of 10 people, giving little hands-on experience. Hostel facilities are high class with good food. Classrooms are also good and air-conditioned.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Extremely good infrastructure, nice faculty, but the fees are a bit high.

content.Placements: About 70 per cent of the students in my college were placed. Top recruiters are Nvidia and BAINS. About 40 per cent of the students got an internship in the 5th semester in companies like BAINS, BCG, etc. Top roles offered in my course are A. E. [Assistant Engineer] in PSPSCL.
content.Infrastructure: Superb hostels, nice bathrooms, Wi-Fi speed is mid but manageable. Labs have top-quality, up-to-date machines and instruments. Lecture halls are very good and in nice condition. Roads and stadiums are very good. Overall, nice infrastructure as well as 24th NIRF rank.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure with AC campus but the mess food is average.

content.Placements: About 85% of students definitely get placed in the main courses of computer engineering and computer science. Some students even get very high starting packages as well. Top roles offered are usually SDE, product managers, data analysts, and web developers.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and classroom are good. The library has a vast collection of books and reference material with large sitting areas. But the baggage area outside is quite small in comparison. The sports centre is great, and has good quality equipment. The food in hostels is not that great though.
