reviews.review_heading: Good college but uncertain future.
reviews.review_text: Its a private college, infrastructure is absolutely top notch. Hostels are air conditioned and your classes are air conditioned. Right now my college is undergoing an overhaul. New infrastructure is being built so in the next 1 year this college will look nothing less than a 5 star property. The library is Indias the biggest and Asias 7th biggest so yeah. Hostels are top notch quality of food which is also decent unlike government hostels. All types of sports facilities are available on the camp...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty and decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities on campus are decent and sufficient for a student. The campus has Wi-Fi, well maintained computer labs, smart classrooms and a good well maintained library. Hostel facilities are average with basic amenities and cleanliness is maintained. The mess food is average and repetitive but the canteens provide additional options. Basic medical facilities for both indoor and outdoor activities.

reviews.review_heading: It is the drastic mistake of my life.
reviews.review_text: The college is excellent in terms of hostels and classrooms. But average in terms of labs. As many core experiments are done in groups of 10 people, giving little hands-on experience. Hostel facilities are high class with good food. Classrooms are also good and air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Extremely good infrastructure, nice faculty, but the fees are a bit high.
reviews.review_text: Superb hostels, nice bathrooms, Wi-Fi speed is mid but manageable. Labs have top-quality, up-to-date machines and instruments. Lecture halls are very good and in nice condition. Roads and stadiums are very good. Overall, nice infrastructure as well as 24th NIRF rank.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with AC campus but the mess food is average.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classroom are good. The library has a vast collection of books and reference material with large sitting areas. But the baggage area outside is quite small in comparison. The sports centre is great, and has good quality equipment. The food in hostels is not that great though.

reviews.review_heading: This college is something great that everyone should experience. The infrastructure is top-notch.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi in the whole building. Library is great, very beautifully made, and the labs are well maintained with all equipments. We have all medical facilities, and mess food is all delicious with hygiene maintained. We have all the games from table tennis to swimming. Infrastructure is good, very clean and maintained,

reviews.review_heading: Decent faculty, placements, great infrastructure, and enjoyable campus life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are great here, in fact, one of the best compared to other colleges. Fully air conditioned classrooms, the biggest library in India, and Wi-Fi connectivity are available in every block. Hostels are no less, they provide the best facilities here. The mess food is reasonable, medical is a call away, you can use the gym, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great. The library is very beautiful and big. Wi-Fi is great. It's available everywhere. Labs have very good infrastructure. Hostels are also great. But the food in the mess is not that great. Medical facilities are also great. You can get an emergency ambulance whenever needed.

reviews.review_heading: It is great, but not good value for money.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure here. Wi-Fi, very cool buildings. Classrooms are almost the latest, and now the remaining blocks are also getting renovated. It would be a great course to join, a great college, and teachers. I haven't been to a hostel, but they are dope.

reviews.review_heading: High fees but nice faculty, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities, and scholarships.
reviews.review_text: World-class research facilities, antenna research lab, done and intelligent sensors lab, MEMS research lab, optical fibre communication research lab, smart autonomous electric vehicle lab, Thapsat research lab, wireless communication lab. Good classrooms with mostly air-conditioned, free wi-fi around the academic area and in hostels. Very big and spacious five-storied air-conditioned Nalanda Central Library with modern technology. There are 16 hostels, most of which are conditioned. Mess, laundr...

reviews.review_heading: Thapar provides many opportunities, a great infrastructure, and good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Thapar has very good Wi-Fi connectivity throughout the campus, even within hostels. Labs are great with modern infrastructure. Hostels are nice with AC, joint washrooms, and great mess food. Thapar has the most beautiful and large library with all types of books for any field (B.Tech, law, civil services, etc. Thapar has a free health care centre with good doctors for any issue. Ambulance services are also available 24x7. It has a very nice sports culture with many sports and coaches for every s...

reviews.review_heading: One of the better choices around 90-96%.
reviews.review_text: Apart from small, a few ifs and but's here and there, the facilities on campus are nice. There are many places to hangout, and AC is installed in 90% of the classes and hostels to assist in scorching heat of Patiala. The library being the main attraction, provides more than enough books for every category.

reviews.review_heading: Expensive but provides facilities for it. Amazing infrastructure, average placements and teachers.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are top notch, massive sitting space, well air conditioned, working Wi-Fi throughout campus, and well-maintained massive library with all types of books with discussion areas. Strict rules for the library not allowing eating stuff with a library card for entry. Infrastructure of library is fabulous allowing a very calm and peaceful space for working. Hostel facilities depend on hostel with mess for each hostel providing quality food. Rooms with and without non-AC. A canteen for evenin...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure like foreign universities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely attractive to us. Sports facilities were also available. Medical facility was present.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure with a guaranteed fun college life.
reviews.review_text: Mess services are great as they are catered by Sodexo, and hostels are fairly maintained. The rooms are neither too tight nor too big but the right size. They are cleaned regularly by the staff, and the food in the mess is hygienic with no compromises in taste.

overview_faqs.question: What are the fee refund rules of DTU?
overview_faqs.answer: Candidates who cancel the enrolment after paying the tuition fee before the semester has started. In that case, DTU will refund the tuition fee. Further, if candidate withdrawl their enrolment after paying the tuition fee, and the semester has started. In that case, DTU will not refund the tuition fee except in cases of exceptional unforeseen circumstances mentioned below:failure to meet the admission requirementslack of residence permit, e.g., if SIRI rejects your application for a residence permitpregnancyEach case will be treated individually. The candidate who belongs to these case are required to submit written documentation before reimbursement can take place. When applying for a refund, candidates are required to enter full name, CPR (if relevant), reasons, and documentation for cancelling your studies. Candidates must also provide their relevant bank details (account number, SWIFT/IBAN codes) for this purpose.

However, for SC/ST and PwD candidates, the registration fee is INR 750 (for MBA in BA, FBE and Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Venture Development) which needs to be paid online. The registration process will remain incomplete till the submission of the registration fee. For all courses, the application fee can be paid while filling out the application form on the official website.

paragraphs: Candidates willing to take admission at Delhi Technological University must complete the admission process according to university's admission guidelines. DTU admission process is a multi-step process which is different for every other course. Candidates must make sure to read carefully the admission process for their desired course.
1: Application Process 2026

Register to begin the application process. BTech programme's admission is done via the Joint Admission Counseling (JAC). Therefore candidates must visit the official website of JAC and register there by providing all the required details. For, BBA/ MBA candidates must apply through CMAC's official website. Further, for the rest PG and PhD programme candidates must apply via the DTU's official website.
2: Selection Process

Candidate's applications are scrutinised for the selection process. For, BTech JEE Main's score is considered for selection and BBA/BArch programme's selection is done based on the last qualifying exam.GATE, MATexams are considered for the BTech, MBA and Executive MBA programme selection. hostel.description: DTU provides hostel accommodations for both boys and girls. All the hostels have basic amenities like water purifiers, common room, recreation room, mess, TV, laundry services, security and surveillance system etc

sports.description: Available Facilities: Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Cricket Ground, Football Ground, Tennis Court, Hockey Ground, Volleyball Court, Table-Tennis

labs.description: Available Facilities: Chemistry Lab, Computer Lab, Physics Lab, Polymer Processing Lab, Instrumentation Lab, CAD Lab, Molecular Biology & RDT Lab, Nano-Bioelectronics Laboratory, Software Engineering Lab, Analog Electronics Lab, Power Systems Lab

reviews.review_heading: Excellent infrastructure, qualified faculty, and great placements .
reviews.review_text: The whole campus has Wi-Fi. There are multiple labs for each subject. There is also a 3-floor library with a huge collection of books. Hostels are good with above-average mess. There are many eateries on campus, like Domino's, AMUL, and Mother Dairy. A health center is also there, and you can avail medicine from there. The sports ground has options for most of the games, and there is usually a sports event taking place.

reviews.review_heading: No placement, bad teacher, good environment.
reviews.review_text: Nothing is available, not even cricket bats, for the students. We pay a 2.5 Lacs fee and get almost no facility at all. Everything is used, I don't know why they don't have any facilities, and the sports complex is crooked, like it seems like sometimes it's a 3-tier college.

reviews.review_heading: DTU is one of the best engineering colleges in the nation.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and the labs are first class, it has all the instruments for experiments here. The quality of mess food is decent, and all the hostel buildings are decent, while some are very huge and beautiful. Not all the boys' hostels are actually air-conditioned, but APJ Abdul Kalam one is air-conditioned. The sports complex is huge, 17 acres, and the facilities are awesome.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available are really great. We have centralised ACs and centralised heaters in every classroom. We have access to Wi-Fi, and there is a library too. There is no hostel, but various PGs and flats are available near the college. There is Nescafé, and we all crave for their Maggie.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and all are well air-conditioned. Proper sunlight is there. The cleanliness is well-maintained. The library of the college is very clean. It has all books related to the curriculum. The seating arrangement is also very good for someone to study without any difficulty.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The campus should be big. It should have hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned with a projector. Wi-Fi is available, though not accessible to students. We have a small library and a study space called a reading room. We also have a seminar room, an auditorium, and a computer center. Our campus is small, but it is well-maintained with medical and canteen facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: There is a difficult course curriculum for Economics Honours.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch. Projectors and Wi-Fi are good for computers in labs. There are the latest computer models in labs. Classrooms are clean and well-equipped. The library has a huge number of copies of every book that is prescribed. It has a well-managed and friendly space for work. Hostels are not available. There is no mess or canteen. The canteen reopens often when someone buys a tender, and only to face loss. Only one badminton court and a volleyball court are available. Medical facili...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college has a great crowd and good exposure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is great. Classrooms are well-maintained and equipped with projectors and good Wi-Fi. The library provides good academic resources. Computer labs are functional. Medical room and sports facilities for volleyball, basketball, and table tennis are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It has a good crowd with great exposure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are good. There is good Wi-Fi connectivity. Classrooms are spacious and maintained. Labs and the library are also nice and have good resources. Indoor and outdoor sports facilities and areas are also available. A medical room is also there.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Honest college review: My college life and how I view my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-notch, really amazing. It's small but worth it. I really enjoy being around the campus. The cafeteria, the volleyball court, the badminton court, the basketball court, and the cricket pitch are all well organised and maintained. The campus is very clean.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Delhi Technological University, East Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, library, and classrooms are really good. All classes have smartboards or projectors and are completely air-conditioned. They even work as heaters in the winter. The library mostly has educational books, with very little fiction. The library's stock is really good. There are many knowledgeable books.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Decent academics, good crowd, and active societies.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel. Good Wi-Fi and great classrooms. A good library with a good selection of books related to the course that the students are studying or pursuing. There is no canteen at the college, but there is a Nescafe which is enough to fulfill our needs.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and satisfied with the course.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel in our college, and it is difficult to find PG also, but infrastructure-wise, it is good, and cleanliness is good. Overall, the infrastructure is very nice. No complaints regarding it; no damaged washrooms, gates, or windows in the classroom. Going by infrastructure, it is good, but it lacks hostel facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: I'm pretty happy with my course, faculty, and crowd.
reviews.review_text: In Delhi Technological University East Campus, there is a good supply of Wi-Fi. Classes and labs are maintained pretty nicely, but when we talk about hostel facilities, DTU East Campus doesn’t really have hostel facilities. Maybe this is something they can work on.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Delhi Technological University, East DelhiReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Review of DTU - East campus.
reviews.review_text: USM provides a decent facility with air conditioning, classrooms, and a very good library, even having a seminar hall and a medical room. Despite the small area of the campus, it contains an indoor badminton court and an outdoor volleyball court, and has even introduced a small but usable cricket practice net.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the curriculum and placements, but lacks in infrastructure and teaching skills.

review_content.Placements: The percent of students who get placed in my course is quite decent. The highest package offered is 1.2 crores per annum. The average package offered ranges from 7-8 LPA, which is good. Top companies like EY, Adobe, and Flipkart visit the college every year. The internship ratio is not so good. Companies offer different roles and mainly focus on software engineers.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course department and hostel is not up to date as there is much rush in the building every time. In hostels, there is no lift. There is a big line whenever we go to the mess. The quality of food is not up to the mark. It also provides us with Wi-Fi and medical facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: No good return on investment in this university for all the students.

review_content.Placements: Almost 20% of students will get placed in 2025. The highest package is 1.7 crore, the average is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The top recruitment companies are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. About internships, mostly good internships are available for students through off-campus placements, while very few students get on-campus internships. I have no idea about the top roles.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wifi speed is not very good, but can be said to be okay. Labs are decent, classrooms are not good; benches in the last rows are broken in many classrooms. The library is decent and provides an environment for studies. If someone's faculty is good, then he or she will get good marks in practicals, and if someone's is bad, then better luck next time.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Campus life & career-ready.

review_content.Placements: Around 60% of the students get placed per year. The placements kick start right from the 6th semester. My placements will start in Feb 2026. It depends on your skills, your personality, and your communication skills. The average package offered to CSE students is 8 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are not that good personally. The rooms are small, and all of them are either 4 or 5-seater rooms with only coolers provided. The AC's are provided to only international students. The mess food is very bland. We have a dispensary with all facilities available. The classrooms are fully equipped, and libraries are well-built with proper infrastructure and Wi-Fi provided.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good placement and perfect study place.

review_content.Placements: In my course, approximately 85 percent of students get placed in various companies. The highest salary in previous years is 57LPA with a average package of 7LPA for general placements. Top recruiting companies are Adobe, ServiceNow, Microsoft etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Top class infrastructure, clean and clear buildings with labs for each case/condition. Perfect space for letting our energy out. Wi-Fi facility, libraries in each building block. Canteens, food services, water supply at every end possible, Medical services available 24 hours and emergency services as well.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Chandigarh University has strong placements, global exposure and industry ready learning.

review_content.Placements: Batch 2021 to 2025 has the highest placement record of around 90 to 95 percent. The highest package was around 1.7 crore per annum and the average package is around 8 to 10 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Cognizant, IBM etc. Top roles offered are Data Analyst and AI and ML.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure has developed a lot from previous times to the current time like including multipurpose rooms, Apple Labs, and IoT Labs. The facilities in the hostels are quite impressive with washing machines on each floor and the mess is clean too. The games and sports are organized every year. People from other universities even come to participate in these sports.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Com. (Hons.) in Advanced Cost & Management Accounting (ITP) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: There are many cafe areas on the campus. Scholarship structure is also very good.

review_content.Placements: Mostly students from the previous batch have been placed in good companies. They get a package above 3.5 LPA. Many opportunities are available because they organize many competitions you can be part of the event committee too. Overall good opportunity .
review_content.Infrastructure: A fully Wi-Fi campus is provided. Hostels are good, and my department classes also have air conditioning. You have options for both attached and common washrooms. Great opportunity and all the hostels also have stocked shops from where you can buy daily use things.

review_summary.college_name: Chandigarh University (CU) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the curriculum and placements, but lacks in infrastructure and teaching skills.

content.Placements: The percent of students who get placed in my course is quite decent. The highest package offered is 1.2 crores per annum. The average package offered ranges from 7-8 LPA, which is good. Top companies like EY, Adobe, and Flipkart visit the college every year. The internship ratio is not so good. Companies offer different roles and mainly focus on software engineers.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course department and hostel is not up to date as there is much rush in the building every time. In hostels, there is no lift. There is a big line whenever we go to the mess. The quality of food is not up to the mark. It also provides us with Wi-Fi and medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: No good return on investment in this university for all the students.

content.Placements: Almost 20% of students will get placed in 2025. The highest package is 1.7 crore, the average is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The top recruitment companies are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. About internships, mostly good internships are available for students through off-campus placements, while very few students get on-campus internships. I have no idea about the top roles.
content.Infrastructure: Wifi speed is not very good, but can be said to be okay. Labs are decent, classrooms are not good; benches in the last rows are broken in many classrooms. The library is decent and provides an environment for studies. If someone's faculty is good, then he or she will get good marks in practicals, and if someone's is bad, then better luck next time.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Campus life & career-ready.

content.Placements: Around 60% of the students get placed per year. The placements kick start right from the 6th semester. My placements will start in Feb 2026. It depends on your skills, your personality, and your communication skills. The average package offered to CSE students is 8 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are not that good personally. The rooms are small, and all of them are either 4 or 5-seater rooms with only coolers provided. The AC's are provided to only international students. The mess food is very bland. We have a dispensary with all facilities available. The classrooms are fully equipped, and libraries are well-built with proper infrastructure and Wi-Fi provided.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good placement and perfect study place.

content.Placements: In my course, approximately 85 percent of students get placed in various companies. The highest salary in previous years is 57LPA with a average package of 7LPA for general placements. Top recruiting companies are Adobe, ServiceNow, Microsoft etc.
content.Infrastructure: Top class infrastructure, clean and clear buildings with labs for each case/condition. Perfect space for letting our energy out. Wi-Fi facility, libraries in each building block. Canteens, food services, water supply at every end possible, Medical services available 24 hours and emergency services as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Chandigarh University has strong placements, global exposure and industry ready learning.

content.Placements: Batch 2021 to 2025 has the highest placement record of around 90 to 95 percent. The highest package was around 1.7 crore per annum and the average package is around 8 to 10 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Cognizant, IBM etc. Top roles offered are Data Analyst and AI and ML.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure has developed a lot from previous times to the current time like including multipurpose rooms, Apple Labs, and IoT Labs. The facilities in the hostels are quite impressive with washing machines on each floor and the mess is clean too. The games and sports are organized every year. People from other universities even come to participate in these sports.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission is not valid for any of the UG & PG courses at Chandigarh University. The university conducts CUCET exam to offer admission to eligible candidates. All the aspirants must qualify for this exam with a valid score. The admission process starts with CUCET registrations. Candidates can check out the exam pattern and CUCET syllabus to prepare for the exam, which will help them score well.

faqs.question: Is CUCET compulsory for Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh University conducts Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test (CUCET) for admission to all of its UG and PG courses. This is a common entrance exam that is applicable for admission of candidates in every stream such as Management, Humanities, Science, Commerce, Engineering, etc. To get admission to any of the courses offered at Chandigarh University, students have to apply for this exam on the official website of CUCET and appear for the exam. This exam is conducted in an online mode in two phases. For admission to any of the courses, there are two decisive factors that are considered by the university for admission. These are eligibility criteria and CUCET scores.

faqs.question: What are the steps for Chandigarh University admissions?
faqs.answer: Students can refer the steps given below to complete the Chandigarh University admissions:Apply and register for CUCET at the official CU website.Choose an examination date for the Chandigarh University Eligibility and Scholarship Test as per your convenience.After the CUCET results are out, students can submit their applications for admission and availing the merit-based scholarship.

Free Wi-Fi Internet Services: Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi services with good speed. The internet services are easily accessible with login credentials provided to students staying in the hostel rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the curriculum and placements, but lacks in infrastructure and teaching skills.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course department and hostel is not up to date as there is much rush in the building every time. In hostels, there is no lift. There is a big line whenever we go to the mess. The quality of food is not up to the mark. It also provides us with Wi-Fi and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: No good return on investment in this university for all the students.
reviews.review_text: Wifi speed is not very good, but can be said to be okay. Labs are decent, classrooms are not good; benches in the last rows are broken in many classrooms. The library is decent and provides an environment for studies. If someone's faculty is good, then he or she will get good marks in practicals, and if someone's is bad, then better luck next time.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life & career-ready.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are not that good personally. The rooms are small, and all of them are either 4 or 5-seater rooms with only coolers provided. The AC's are provided to only international students. The mess food is very bland. We have a dispensary with all facilities available. The classrooms are fully equipped, and libraries are well-built with proper infrastructure and Wi-Fi provided.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and perfect study place.
reviews.review_text: Top class infrastructure, clean and clear buildings with labs for each case/condition. Perfect space for letting our energy out. Wi-Fi facility, libraries in each building block. Canteens, food services, water supply at every end possible, Medical services available 24 hours and emergency services as well.

reviews.review_heading: Chandigarh University has strong placements, global exposure and industry ready learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure has developed a lot from previous times to the current time like including multipurpose rooms, Apple Labs, and IoT Labs. The facilities in the hostels are quite impressive with washing machines on each floor and the mess is clean too. The games and sports are organized every year. People from other universities even come to participate in these sports.

reviews.review_heading: There are many cafe areas on the campus. Scholarship structure is also very good.
reviews.review_text: A fully Wi-Fi campus is provided. Hostels are good, and my department classes also have air conditioning. You have options for both attached and common washrooms. Great opportunity and all the hostels also have stocked shops from where you can buy daily use things.

reviews.review_heading: Indias No. 1 private university in 2023.
reviews.review_text: Good and well structured campus Wi-Fi is available. Good and decent classrooms well resource library with Wi-Fi. Good but not like it is okay, not that bad. We have a separate sports complex. Good and healthy mess food with tasty canteen food.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life, decent placements, and nice infrastructure are available for CSE at CU.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Chandigarh University is actually very good. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are smart, and labs have proper systems. CSE labs are good and mostly updated. The central library is big and well-maintained with enough books and online resources. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms are clean, and security is good. Mess food is average, sometimes good, and sometimes not so good. Many food courts are there, so students manage them. Medical facilities are available o...

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus, great experience.
reviews.review_text: The hostel service is not good personally, as there are only 4 seater rooms with no AC option. The mess food I do not like at all. The campus is good no doubt and hostels are located inside the campus only. The course structure is also good. It includes appropriate time management.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and excellent academics, highly recommend for engineering students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is quite well-maintained and modern. The computer labs where I study have decent systems with the latest software and programming tools. We use them regularly for coding assignments. The classrooms have projectors and audio systems. The library is spacious with good books and computers. Wi-Fi is available throughout campus. Hostel facilities are good with proper rooms and maintenance. The mess food quality is average but the quantity is sufficient. Medical facilities with...

reviews.review_heading: Please do not take admission in this college. This college is full of enjoyment.
reviews.review_text: Classroom, Wi-Fi labs and library of the Chandigarh University are very bad. All bad types of words are used, and also hostel quality of food available in the mess and canteen is just like poison. Medicine and medical facilities from these names gave only paracetamol to the student and did not have any sport chance and games.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is well maintained good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The institute maintain well define hostel facilities. Wi-Fi facilities and good food for the students and even though the course and hostel are well maintained and eco friendly and greenery is everywhere in the campus and student enjoy the fun fountain area par.

reviews.review_heading: College is below average, so do not expect much more from this college.
reviews.review_text: If you are going for CSE, then do not expect much from the infrastructure and college life. There is a huge crowd in CSE, so the infrastructure gets compromised. Hostel facilities are 4/5. The mess food is a little above average. If you come from a middle-class family, you should go for a 5-seater non-AC.

reviews.review_heading: The place of setting future.
reviews.review_text: The food and hostel and its infrastructure are great. A new hostel work is going on and the rooms here are amazing as they have facilities like a bed, almirah, desk, chair and etc. The message food is amazing. Its enough for surviving the 4 years of BE here.

reviews.review_heading: I do not regret taking admission here, and it is very good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and the library are all top-notch. It is very clean and very good. All facilities, hostels, and food availability are good. It is clean, and the medical facilities are also very well-maintained and good. Sports can be played every day. Every part of the campus is cleaned, including the washrooms. There is a canteen everywhere.

reviews_list.review_title: IIT Ropar College Review.

review_content.Placements: The placements had been decent. A lot of students were really keen on applying to certain companies. The reason the pay was not that great was that there seems to be a lack of growth opportunities in the industry. Its frustrating, for sure. On the bright side, our placement cell was pretty proactive. They had a bunch of options for us to consider when applying to different companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel and the mess were decent. We had Wi-Fi in the classrooms, and you can easily access the LAN from your room in the hostel. Everything you need was right on campus. The classrooms were spacious and had projectors, which was nice. A big stadium for cricket and football, not to mention an indoor stadium for badminton.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: IIT Ropar College Review.

review_content.Placements: Every student heads straight for placements. Some actually land foreign Ph.D. positions, which is pretty impressive. Others might choose to stick around in academia. Most students placements were on campus or off. There were some academic internships out there from companies like Doubtnut and Toppr, which could be a great opportunity. The coaching industry was always on the lookout for students from the M.Sc. Chemistry branch, especially for NEET JEE, and JAM prep. There were plenty of paths to explore.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was practical, with solid facilities for both sports and academics. You can always plug into a LAN port for unlimited public Ethernet. The campus was buzzing with organized events, and the various clubs really enhance diversity and opportunities for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Here, it's a good campus life with strong academics.

content.Placements: In B.Tech CSE, around 85% are placed, with the highest package of approximately Rs 66 LPA, average of Rs 22 LPA and the lowest Rs. 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters are Google and DE. Shaw, Pattern, Arista, Accenture, Oracle, Sprinklr, Texas Instruments, Microsoft, etc. Top roles are SDE roles and Data Analyst.
content.Infrastructure: All departments have labs, classes, and seminar halls, with high-speed Wi-Fi. Along with this, there is a well-equipped central library and Auditorium. The hostel offers clean rooms, 24/7 water, electricity, and Wi-Fi. There are 3 messes in the institute, which offer decent food. Along with this, there is medical support and sports facilities like a gym, cricket, football, basketball, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Campus life and internships at IIT Ropar

content.Placements: Since I am in the 3rd year of my degree, I am sharing about the internships at IIT Ropar, in my batch of 70 students, about 5 are selected for software development roles in companies like Microsoft, Arista Networks, and Razorpay. Almost 35 students got internships in mechanical core companies like TATA Steel, Trident, DRDO, etc. Two students got internships in product management roles at OLA, and one got an internship at JPMCt.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides Wi-Fi facilities throughout the 500 acres of campus area and also LAN facilities in the hostel rooms. The common rooms in all the hostels provide facilities like gym, television, and sports equipment. Some hostels also have a snooker table in the common area. The library is big and contains books on almost every subject, from novels to course books and research papers. Food available in the canteen is better than what is available at the mess; however, after visiting 3 other IITs, I can assure that our mess food is much better.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: IIT Ropar College Review.

content.Placements: The placements had been decent. A lot of students were really keen on applying to certain companies. The reason the pay was not that great was that there seems to be a lack of growth opportunities in the industry. Its frustrating, for sure. On the bright side, our placement cell was pretty proactive. They had a bunch of options for us to consider when applying to different companies.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and the mess were decent. We had Wi-Fi in the classrooms, and you can easily access the LAN from your room in the hostel. Everything you need was right on campus. The classrooms were spacious and had projectors, which was nice. A big stadium for cricket and football, not to mention an indoor stadium for badminton.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: IIT Ropar College Review.

content.Placements: Every student heads straight for placements. Some actually land foreign Ph.D. positions, which is pretty impressive. Others might choose to stick around in academia. Most students placements were on campus or off. There were some academic internships out there from companies like Doubtnut and Toppr, which could be a great opportunity. The coaching industry was always on the lookout for students from the M.Sc. Chemistry branch, especially for NEET JEE, and JAM prep. There were plenty of paths to explore.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was practical, with solid facilities for both sports and academics. You can always plug into a LAN port for unlimited public Ethernet. The campus was buzzing with organized events, and the various clubs really enhance diversity and opportunities for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great college, should definitely consider it.

content.Placements: 80% happen to get placed. Top recruiting companies for electrical core are Nvidia and Texas. The highest salary is 65 LPA. The lowest salary is 7 LPA, and the average salary is 20 LPA. There are many companies like Nvidia and Texas for core electrical and some people go to non-core like Goldman Sachs. Some go into software development at Google, Flipkart, etc. Top role offered is software engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is great up to date equipments. Hostels are great as the building was made in 2019 itself so its very new. Food quality is average. Sometimes food is bad so we just go to cafeteria to eat. There is no problem in Wi-Fi. Library is open 24X7. Medical facilities and games are good.

admission_overview.college_name: IIT Ropar Admission 2025: Cutoff, Fees, Eligibility & Selection

paragraphs: IIT Ropar course admissions 2025are open for various programmes offered at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels. IIT Ropar admission is completely entrance-based for BTech, MTech, and MSc courses to students across Engineering, Science, and various other streams. IIT Ropar admission to most of the courses is done through national-level entrance exams including JEE Main/JEE Advanced,IIT JAM, and GATE, among others. Candidates seeking admission to IIT Ropar courses must visit the official website of these entrance exams to apply online.
Candidates seeking admission to IIT Ropar can check out the most updated information related to the IIT Ropar course admissions in the following highlights section:

IIT Ropar's admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counseling. The step-wise admission process is given below:
Step 1: IIT Ropar Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Ropar are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

IIT Ropar admits students to BTech courses based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced scores. Candidates are allotted seats in JoSAA Counselling for BTech, BTech-MTech (Dual Degree), and BS courses. Admission to MTech is through GATE followed by COAP Counselling. The institute considers IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling for MSc courses. Candidates can check with the admission office for the selection rounds of the rest of the courses.
Step 3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech, and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. IIT Ropar will release the course-wise merit list for merit-based courses on its official website. As per the merit list, candidates are called for counselling for seat allotment. Shortlisted candidates must then pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

nirf.description:
IIT Ropar has been ranked well by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for IIT Ropar indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. It has been seen that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, IIT Ropar fell 8 ranks to #56 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Ropar fell 10 ranks to #32 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: Here, it's a good campus life with strong academics.
reviews.review_text: All departments have labs, classes, and seminar halls, with high-speed Wi-Fi. Along with this, there is a well-equipped central library and Auditorium. The hostel offers clean rooms, 24/7 water, electricity, and Wi-Fi. There are 3 messes in the institute, which offer decent food. Along with this, there is medical support and sports facilities like a gym, cricket, football, basketball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life and internships at IIT Ropar
reviews.review_text: The college provides Wi-Fi facilities throughout the 500 acres of campus area and also LAN facilities in the hostel rooms. The common rooms in all the hostels provide facilities like gym, television, and sports equipment. Some hostels also have a snooker table in the common area. The library is big and contains books on almost every subject, from novels to course books and research papers. Food available in the canteen is better than what is available at the mess; however, after visiting 3 other...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Ropar College Review.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and the mess were decent. We had Wi-Fi in the classrooms, and you can easily access the LAN from your room in the hostel. Everything you need was right on campus. The classrooms were spacious and had projectors, which was nice. A big stadium for cricket and football, not to mention an indoor stadium for badminton.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Ropar College Review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was practical, with solid facilities for both sports and academics. You can always plug into a LAN port for unlimited public Ethernet. The campus was buzzing with organized events, and the various clubs really enhance diversity and opportunities for students.

reviews.review_heading: Great college, should definitely consider it.
reviews.review_text: Everything is great up to date equipments. Hostels are great as the building was made in 2019 itself so its very new. Food quality is average. Sometimes food is bad so we just go to cafeteria to eat. There is no problem in Wi-Fi. Library is open 24X7. Medical facilities and games are good.

reviews.review_heading: Best infrastructure among the IITs with quite good placement ratio and also a good campus life.
reviews.review_text: The metallurgical and materials engineering department is in Hargobind Khurana block (SAB). We have hi-tech labs with equipment like SEM, TEM, XRD, other microscopes, and other devices. We have full air conditioning and Wi-Fi network classrooms. We have 4 hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls. We have a sports complex which has cricket, football, hockey, volleyball, tennis, basketball grounds, and gym also.

reviews.review_heading: A deep dive into IIT Ropar.
reviews.review_text: IIT Ropar provides good Wi-Fi, good labs, big classrooms, and a small library. Facilities at my hostel are good, but we don't have a balcony, and the room is too small for two students. The mess food is good sometimes and very bad at other times. The sports facilities are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Experience in IIT Ropar (the most progressing IIT).
reviews.review_text: There are seven hostels in IIT Ropar, all having the best Wi-Fi facilities and good infrastructure. We have electrical, mechanical, chemical, CS workshop, and civil labs. We have a full-fledged LHC with six large classrooms. We have a large library containing all sorts of books. Hostels provide good facilities like proper lighting and proper sports facilities. The mess provides tasty food three times a day. Medical facilities are on the top level. We have a large sports complex which includes a ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Ropar - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel, fans, tables, chairs, and light bulbs are provided. You can buy or borrow a cooler and heater for summer and winter by paying extra fees regarding the electricity bill. Wi-Fi is also given in the hostel. Medical service is available but it is not 24X7.

reviews.review_heading: All the above facilities are average.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for my course/department are average. Hostel facilities are average. Mess food quality is not good. Medical facilities are also not good. Sports and games facilities are good but not proper management.

reviews.review_heading: Average placements, but overall life is good at IIT Ropar.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are really good. We have a whole new block for the Civil department, centrally air-conditioned, and have all kinds of equipment in all kinds of labs with all the modern technologies. Now, if we talk about the facilities in my hostel, we are given really beautiful hostels with good-quality furniture. There are issues with Wi-Fi, but everything else is good, whether you talk about the mess and canteen, sports and games, or medical facilities. Medical facilities ar...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Ropar : Journey to the future.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is fantastic. Our hostel and department building have wi-fi, classrooms are fully air conditioned, and we have the facility of a smart board and projectors. The library has AC and wi-fi. It has a variety of books. The campus is well maintained and has greenery all around. The mess food is average but not bad. The medical facility is available 24 hours a day, and there is a fantastic sports complex at IIT Ropar that has grounds for basketball, volleyball, cricket,...

reviews.review_heading: Campus life of IIT Ropar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is imposing, as we are one of the new-generation IITs. The infrastructure is maintained well by the authorities, and every year, lacs of rupees are spent to renovate the infrastructure. The hostel rooms are also well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Great hostel rooms, amazing crowd to hang out with makes my experience worth it.
reviews.review_text: I live in Chenab Hostel, and I think it's quite good. The rooms are spacious enough for two people, and the Wi-Fi is decent. If we need more bandwidth, we can use the LAN. The lecture halls are also pretty good with six of them; the largest holding 180 people. The mess food is decent and much better than what I've heard about other colleges. There is a main canteen with several outlets and a medical office that's always open in case of an emergency.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, good placements, and above-average infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms here are good, with air conditioning and comfortable seating. The labs are well-equipped with modern equipment, and the institute has a strong ranking in research. There is Wi-Fi available in classrooms, labs, the library, and all hostels, except for the newly built ones. The library is spacious and has many amazing books to explore and read.

reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with good faculty.

review_content.Placements: I am studying B. Tech in KL University, CSE, passing out in 2027. The highest is 48 LPA and the lowest is 4 LPA. Some big companies are visiting shortly. review_content.Infrastructure: Good facilities with Wi-Fi and excellent infrastructure in classrooms, labs, and library. All books are available in the library. We have excellent labs and lab faculty, who will teach you clearly with practical experience. We also have digital boards in every class.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Information Technology - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: It is good for those who don’t want to waste money and time. This college is excellent.

review_content.Infrastructure: It has good infrastructure and games. It is a 100-acre college, also known as the Greenary College. The college is full of green trees and gardens. This college has great nature and trees, and all games are available in the college, so don’t worry about games.
review_content.Faculty: Faculty are excellent. My course has 3 semesters per year. It is an experiential learning course for four years, which is a very good course. In this college, faculty have good skills; they are from IITs, NITs, and some have PhDs. They help always, not only during college time, but all the time.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Internet of Things (IoT) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure and facilities.

review_content.Placements: 50 percent of students get placed. The lowest package offered is 3.6 LPA. The top role offered is a software developer. Some of the students got internship offer letters from ECE. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Cognizant, LTI, and Mindtree.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, library, and auditorium are available. Hostels are good. The library is too good, and helpful books are available. The quality of food available in the canteen is worthless. The cost is high. The quality, quantity, and taste of the bad is too bad.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Really good campus and with good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: 75-85% were placed in our course. I think the highest package is around 75 LPA, and the lowest is around 4 LPA. Tech Mahindra and Infosys recruit. 80-90 percent of students got internships from our course and in companies like Tech Mahindra, Infosys, and Amazon. The top roles are data analyst and developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have all the top-notch facilities like Wi-Fi, furniture, food tables, classrooms with smart boards and highly qualified professionals. The hostels have very good infrastructure, a good environment and very good food. Also have both AC and non-AC facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Internet of Things (IoT) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Great infrastructure, supportive faculty and strong placement opportunities at KL University.

review_content.Placements: I am from the B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering batch 2021 to 2025. 85 to 90 percent of students are placed, with packages ranging from 3 LPA to 25+ LPA, and average of around 6 to 7 LPA. Top recruiters included Amazon, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys, Accenture, and many students secured internships in leading IT companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The CSE department has well equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, high speed Wi-Fi, and access to a central digital library with extensive learning resources. Hostels are well maintained with good security, medical facilities, sports infrastructure, and the mess and canteen provide hygienic and decent quality food.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Good placement support and decent campus life, but it needs better faculty.

review_content.Placements: Around 80% of the students were placed with an average package of 6 LPA, and the highest is around 18 LPA. There is an honors programme that can really boost your chances as it provides project-based learning, makes you industry-ready, and helps you to get placed.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel is great, every room has Wi-Fi, and there are many rooms, such as a game room, clubhouse, and study room. It even has a swimming pool, a library is great and really cool, it boosts the study morale, and also there are so many games you can play.

alumni network
of

, etc., in leading companies.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with good faculty.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities with Wi-Fi and excellent infrastructure in classrooms, labs, and library. All books are available in the library. We have excellent labs and lab faculty, who will teach you clearly with practical experience. We also have digital boards in every class.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for those who don’t want to waste money and time. This college is excellent.
reviews.review_text: It has good infrastructure and games. It is a 100-acre college, also known as the Greenary College. The college is full of green trees and gardens. This college has great nature and trees, and all games are available in the college, so don’t worry about games.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, library, and auditorium are available. Hostels are good. The library is too good, and helpful books are available. The quality of food available in the canteen is worthless. The cost is high. The quality, quantity, and taste of the bad is too bad.

reviews.review_heading: Really good campus and with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: We have all the top-notch facilities like Wi-Fi, furniture, food tables, classrooms with smart boards and highly qualified professionals. The hostels have very good infrastructure, a good environment and very good food. Also have both AC and non-AC facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, supportive faculty and strong placement opportunities at KL University.
reviews.review_text: The CSE department has well equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, high speed Wi-Fi, and access to a central digital library with extensive learning resources. Hostels are well maintained with good security, medical facilities, sports infrastructure, and the mess and canteen provide hygienic and decent quality food.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement support and decent campus life, but it needs better faculty.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is great, every room has Wi-Fi, and there are many rooms, such as a game room, clubhouse, and study room. It even has a swimming pool, a library is great and really cool, it boosts the study morale, and also there are so many games you can play.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is good and large, but there are strict rules and almost no exposure.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are very good, and the infrastructure is also very good when compared to any other college, but the fuller utilisation of the infrastructure is still needed. There are clubs for exposure, but the clubs do not have a lot of infrastructure. There is Wi-Fi nearly everywhere, but do note that only an Airtel SIM works here, so get your sim card changed.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely dissatisfied with the hostel life.
reviews.review_text: The college hostel and the environment are too good. The hostel life is not that good because it is too strict. The food in the hostel is also not that good, and they will give us good food for 1or 2 days after the admission. Sports facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and the infrastructure are good. Placements are satisfying.
reviews.review_text: The college has good labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostel rooms are clean and basic, with decent mess food and medical help. Sports and indoor games facilities are available on campus. The hostel facilities are decent, and rooms are clean. Drinking water and electricity backup are available. The mess food is average but hygienic. The canteen offers better options.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with best placement record.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-ventilated and spacious. It has well-structured laboratories with a campus-wide range of Wi-Fi, ensuring connectivity throughout the college grounds. The food is good enough in the mess, and so are the canteens. That is all for this.

reviews.review_heading: Good university with best placements.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled with high-speed internet access, allowing students to work on projects, access online resources, and collaborative efficiently. Multiple well-equipped computer labs with the latest configurations and licensed software for programming, data analytics, cloud computing, networking, AI/ML, and cybersecurity. Specialized labs include AI & Machines learning lab, cloud and big data lab, red hat certified lab, IoT, & embedded systems lab.

reviews.review_heading: It’s too good college with all the facilities for students.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides all facilities such as washrooms, a library, modern labs, and a dedicated research center. There is also a startup hub that helps students work on new ideas. There are labs for computer science, biotech, and space-related clubs like cinematic, research, space, and startup clubs.

reviews.review_heading: Good college placements and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is excellent at KL University in Guntur. It had Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, modern labs, a digital library, and smart-learning facilities. Hostels are well-maintained and provided clean rooms, 24/7 Wi-Fi, and good security. The mess food is decent and had multiple menu options. The canteen is clean and affordable. The campus also offered good medical services and sports facilities for both indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: KL University is a  great place for learning and growth.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was excellent at KL University in Guntur. It had Wi-Fi enabled classrooms, modern labs, a digital library, and smart-learning facilities. Hostels were well-maintained. Provided clean rooms. 24/7 Wi-Fi, and good security. The mess food was decent. It had multiple menu options. Canteen was clean and affordable. Campus also offered good medical services. Sports facilities for both indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: The best place to learn, grow, and build your career in tech.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled with high-speed internet access, allowing students to work on projects, access online resources, and collaborate efficiently. Multiple well-equipped computer labs with the latest configurations and licensed software for programming, data analytics, cloud computing, networking, AI/ML, and cybersecurity. Specialized labs include AI & Machine learning lab, cloud and big data lab, red hat certified lab, IoT, & embedded systems lab.

college_info.intro:
KIIT's popular courses include MBA, BTech, and MCA. The institute offers 200 courses via its 28 schools that operate on the same campus. Known as one of the top B-schools, KIIT offers UG and PG degrees in business administration, covering multiple specialisations, such as business analytics, operations, and supply chain management. Offered at KIIT for a duration of two years, the minimum eligibility criteria for MBA admission requires candidates to graduate with a minimum aggregate of 50% or equivalent. Along with this, a valid score is also required in any one of the entrance exams, such as KIITEE MGT/CMAT/CAT/MAT/XAT/GMAT/ATMA. KIIT MBA fees are around INR 3.5 Lakh – INR 10.3 Lakh.
KIIT offers 18 specialisations in BTech and MTech through the Schools of Computer Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology. Aspirants must have at least 60% marks with the scores of eligible entrance results of JEE, KIITEE, Odisha CHSE and CBSE 12. The tuition fee of BTech is around INR 3.8 Lakh – 19 Lakh.
For more details, check out the listings given below:

placements.overview:
Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) started offering undergraduate and postgraduate courses in 1997. Initially, Engineering, Management and Computer Applications courses were introduced. KIIT introduced many schools, including the School of Law, Biotechnology, Medical Sciences, Dental Sciences, Nursing, Mass Communication in 2007. Now, the institute is recognised as a private institution, that offers courses at the UG, PG and PhD levels. Locates in Bhubaneshwar, KIIT campus is speread across8,900 acres, with 3K+ faculty and researchers and 15K staff members. It owns accreditations and affiliations from various national and international rewarding bodies. The institute is ranked 1001-1200 by theQS World University Rankings 2026. In the 'Overall' category, KIIT is ranked 28 by NIRF. KIIT is also accredited with A++ Grade by NAAC. As per the Times Higher Education, ‘World University Ranking 2024’ recognises KIIT among the rank-band of 601-800.

KIIT admission is depends on the entrance test criteria. The admission process is based on the students' performance in the KIITEE entrance exam. Students should appear for the KIITEE exam and obtain valid merit to obtain admissions. reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure and faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Placements are decent or very poor for boys, as big companies like nVidia, Google, etc., visit the college only for girls and not for boys. Here, boys get selected in companies like TCS, Wipro, etc. Recruiters who come here are very rude to students who come for the interview.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good. The library is good. Wi-Fi in hostels is very bad and has very poor coverage. I cannot even video call properly. The mess food is absolute trash, and the food even causes various diseases. The rest of the things are good, like medical facilities, sports, and games.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBA in Rural Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the college, hostel, faculty member etc.

review_content.Placements: The main good thing about KSRM is it ensures 100 percent internship and 100 percent placement for every batch of students. It helps students gain hands-on experience for their upcoming professional career, and it also helps students understand the real challenges in the field and how to overcome them.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms at KSRM are really very good, and the environment is really appreciable. Especially, what I feel is the library of KSRM and the KIIT central library, they are equipped with many options for students to learn on their own, which helps students gain extra knowledge.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBA in Rural Management - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Excellent rural exposure, faculty, and strong placement with decent hostel facilities with the best

review_content.Placements: I am a student of the MBA Rural Management 2024-2026 batch. The programme combines classroom learning with internships and case studies to give practical learning through rural exposure which not only provides a platform to implement our theoretical knowledge but also provides us with life lessons. Around 90-95 percent of students were placed through campus placement and off-campus opportunities. Average package goes upto 6 LPA. Most graduates are offered a role of programme associate, management trainee, and relationship manager.
review_content.Infrastructure: Departments are well-maintained with projectors. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. The library is well-maintained with a full range of books and is well-managed. Hostel rooms are good, decent, and comfortable. Mess food is average but hygiene is maintained which is essential. The canteen is spacious and kept clean and hygienic.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty, and decent placement opportunities.

review_content.Placements: Placements for my batch are decent but depend a lot on students’ skills and preparation. Around 65-70% of students from our course get placed through campus drives. The highest package offered is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA, while the lowest package is about 3 LPA to 3.5 LPA. The average package ranges between 4.5 LPA to 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Accenture, Cognizant, Wipro, Deloitte, EY, Capgemini, and Infosys. About 60% of students also receive internship opportunities in companies like Deloitte, EY, Accenture, and startups, mostly in software engineering roles.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, it's a good college.

review_content.Placements: Mostly, students get placed, as I have heard from my seniors. The average package is okay, with a median of 7 LPA, and the highest goes around 21 LPA. Mostly, students get internships here. Some of the recruiting companies that visit include Accenture, Infosys, JP Morgan, etc. Mostly, the roles offered are SDE, business analyst, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are nice, and we get Wi-Fi in the classrooms too. I personally love the library, it's just perfect. Hostels are great, to be honest, infrastructure-wise, they can be very strict for girls, though. Few have study rooms even. Food is great, there's so much variety, and it keeps changing every once in a while. A few hostels have a badminton and basketball court very close to them, if you are lucky enough.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBA in Rural Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure, faculty, and a good track record for placement.

review_content.Placements: The college has good placements. 80 for the MBA RM and 80 for the ABM course. The subjects are designed as per the current market demands. We are having a large, diverse group of students from different parts of the country, as well as international students from Africa. We share good communication with the facilities.
review_content.Infrastructure: This college has good infrastructure and is well-furnished. They serve satisfactory food, and the hostel is in a short distance from the college with student-friendly staff. They also have AC premium hostel, which is much expensive than the regular non-AC hostels. The laundry system of the university can be improved as it lacks the quality of washing and its services.

review_summary.college_name: KIIT Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: Placements are decent or very poor for boys, as big companies like nVidia, Google, etc., visit the college only for girls and not for boys. Here, boys get selected in companies like TCS, Wipro, etc. Recruiters who come here are very rude to students who come for the interview.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good. The library is good. Wi-Fi in hostels is very bad and has very poor coverage. I cannot even video call properly. The mess food is absolute trash, and the food even causes various diseases. The rest of the things are good, like medical facilities, sports, and games.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Rural Management - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the college, hostel, faculty member etc.

content.Placements: The main good thing about KSRM is it ensures 100 percent internship and 100 percent placement for every batch of students. It helps students gain hands-on experience for their upcoming professional career, and it also helps students understand the real challenges in the field and how to overcome them.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms at KSRM are really very good, and the environment is really appreciable. Especially, what I feel is the library of KSRM and the KIIT central library, they are equipped with many options for students to learn on their own, which helps students gain extra knowledge.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Rural Management - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Excellent rural exposure, faculty, and strong placement with decent hostel facilities with the best

content.Placements: I am a student of the MBA Rural Management 2024-2026 batch. The programme combines classroom learning with internships and case studies to give practical learning through rural exposure which not only provides a platform to implement our theoretical knowledge but also provides us with life lessons. Around 90-95 percent of students were placed through campus placement and off-campus opportunities. Average package goes upto 6 LPA. Most graduates are offered a role of programme associate, management trainee, and relationship manager.
content.Infrastructure: Departments are well-maintained with projectors. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. The library is well-maintained with a full range of books and is well-managed. Hostel rooms are good, decent, and comfortable. Mess food is average but hygiene is maintained which is essential. The canteen is spacious and kept clean and hygienic.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty, and decent placement opportunities.

content.Placements: Placements for my batch are decent but depend a lot on students’ skills and preparation. Around 65-70% of students from our course get placed through campus drives. The highest package offered is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA, while the lowest package is about 3 LPA to 3.5 LPA. The average package ranges between 4.5 LPA to 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Accenture, Cognizant, Wipro, Deloitte, EY, Capgemini, and Infosys. About 60% of students also receive internship opportunities in companies like Deloitte, EY, Accenture, and startups, mostly in software engineering roles.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it's a good college.

content.Placements: Mostly, students get placed, as I have heard from my seniors. The average package is okay, with a median of 7 LPA, and the highest goes around 21 LPA. Mostly, students get internships here. Some of the recruiting companies that visit include Accenture, Infosys, JP Morgan, etc. Mostly, the roles offered are SDE, business analyst, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are nice, and we get Wi-Fi in the classrooms too. I personally love the library, it's just perfect. Hostels are great, to be honest, infrastructure-wise, they can be very strict for girls, though. Few have study rooms even. Food is great, there's so much variety, and it keeps changing every once in a while. A few hostels have a badminton and basketball court very close to them, if you are lucky enough.

paragraphs: KIIT admission is both merit and entrance-based. Students can appear for the selection rounds as per the admission process to secure their seat at KIIT. KIIT admission is conducted in several rounds. More detailed steps aroundKIIT admission processare as follows:
1 - Entrance Exam
Accepted exams include CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, or GMAT.
2 - Online Application
Students can visit the official website and submit the application form after the exam is concluded.
3 - GD & WAT
Shortlisted candidates are invited for GD or WAT. Communication skills and critical thinking are evaluated in this stage.
4 - Personal Interview
Those who clear the GD/WAT round are further called for a personal interview. PI stage assesses the student's communication and personality skills.
5 - Final Selection
Final admission is conducted on the basis of factors like entrance exam scores, academic performance, GD/WAT, PI, work experience, etc.
