reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied because of the campus life, faculty, and services given by this university.

review_content.Placements: Placements are usually good at Amity University. Good recruiting companies come to our college for placements, and high packages are provided. In some cases, when the placements are not provided, the students can also find job opportunities outside also.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is too good. For my course, the building is a little underdeveloped, but it is soon going to be developed as promised by the faculty. Food, medicine, and sports facilities are really good in this university. The hostel is also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Engineering at Amity University, Noida, is effective and it only has the fame.

review_content.Placements: I would like to say that approximately 75 percent of students got the placements. If they are well prepared with the skills required in current technology. There are lots of companies visiting the campus for placement. If you have good skills, you can get a placement easily. There are many roles, such as GET, Software Engineer, and sales, also.
review_content.Infrastructure: If I talk about Amity, the best thing that they are providing is the infrastructure, the campus is fully AC and fully Wi-Fi-enabled. They have a good number of labs for practicals in the Computer Science subject. They have a special AI lab which has been built in collaboration with NVIDIA. In my college, there are a number of canteens and cafeterias. From then on, the best one is the Mega Bite named canteen.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.

review_content.Placements: Around 35% of students from our course get placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 8 LPA, reflecting strong technical roles. The lowest package is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell and Coforge, which hire students for technical support roles. Approximately 70 percent of students secure internships. The most common role offered is IT technician.
review_content.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Average opinion about the college.

review_content.Placements: Out of 11 students interested in placements, 3 have been successfully placed through campus placements. The highest package till now is 7.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course include BSES, Vanderlande, Schlumberger, Kirloskar Oil Engines, and LiuGong. 50 percent of students got internships through college support in companies like Dixon Technologies Ltd. and Nuremberg Ltd. Top roles offered include graduate engineer trainee and associate sales engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Pharm. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.

review_content.Placements: The average package of 3 LPA can be expected. Only one company comes here that offers 8 LPA, but it takes 2 to 3 students only rest all are placed at the above mentioned package. The company comes, and you will give interview and sometimes they are online as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.

reviews_list.batch_info: LL.B (Hons.) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: My college's placement section must be improved.

review_content.Placements: As a student of the University of Lucknow, I would like to share that my college is better than private institutes. The percentage of students who get placed every year in my course is very high compared to private colleges. The highest package offered is 12 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, grounds, washrooms, etc. Facilities are very good according to the fees taken from students.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers of my course are very cooperative towards their students. Semester examinations are not that difficult for regular students of my college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Clinical Psychology (Honours / Research) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because of the campus life, faculty, and services given by this university.

content.Placements: Placements are usually good at Amity University. Good recruiting companies come to our college for placements, and high packages are provided. In some cases, when the placements are not provided, the students can also find job opportunities outside also.
content.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is too good. For my course, the building is a little underdeveloped, but it is soon going to be developed as promised by the faculty. Food, medicine, and sports facilities are really good in this university. The hostel is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Engineering at Amity University, Noida, is effective and it only has the fame.

content.Placements: I would like to say that approximately 75 percent of students got the placements. If they are well prepared with the skills required in current technology. There are lots of companies visiting the campus for placement. If you have good skills, you can get a placement easily. There are many roles, such as GET, Software Engineer, and sales, also.
content.Infrastructure: If I talk about Amity, the best thing that they are providing is the infrastructure, the campus is fully AC and fully Wi-Fi-enabled. They have a good number of labs for practicals in the Computer Science subject. They have a special AI lab which has been built in collaboration with NVIDIA. In my college, there are a number of canteens and cafeterias. From then on, the best one is the Mega Bite named canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.

content.Placements: Around 35% of students from our course get placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 8 LPA, reflecting strong technical roles. The lowest package is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell and Coforge, which hire students for technical support roles. Approximately 70 percent of students secure internships. The most common role offered is IT technician.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Average opinion about the college.

content.Placements: Out of 11 students interested in placements, 3 have been successfully placed through campus placements. The highest package till now is 7.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course include BSES, Vanderlande, Schlumberger, Kirloskar Oil Engines, and LiuGong. 50 percent of students got internships through college support in companies like Dixon Technologies Ltd. and Nuremberg Ltd. Top roles offered include graduate engineer trainee and associate sales engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.

individual_reviews.course: M.Pharm. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.

content.Placements: The average package of 3 LPA can be expected. Only one company comes here that offers 8 LPA, but it takes 2 to 3 students only rest all are placed at the above mentioned package. The company comes, and you will give interview and sometimes they are online as well.
content.Infrastructure: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.

Amity Noida Application Process

The Amity University admission process begins by filling an application form on the official website of Amity University Noida. If candidates wish to apply for more than one programme, they need to fill out a separate form for each course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,500each. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity Noida.
Amity Noida Selection Process

Note: The personal interview can be either video-based or in person as per the university's directions.
Amity Noida Final Offer Letter

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. faqs.question: What is the course duration of LLM in Amity Noida? What is the fee structure of the same?

M. programme at Amity Noida is as follows: * *General:* INR 1,64,000 * *Taxation:* INR 1,74,000 * *Intellectual Property Law:* INR 1,84,000 The fees for the LL. M. programme are inclusive of tuition fees, library fees, and examination fees. However, they do not include hostel fees, mess fees, or other incidental expenses. The fees for the LL. M. programme can be paid in two installments. The first installment is due at the time of admission and the second installment is due at the end of the first semester. The LL. M. programme at Amity Noida is a full-time programme and students are required to attend classes for a minimum of 12 hours per week. The programme also includes a research component and students are required to submit a dissertation at the end of the programme. The LL. M. programme at Amity Noida is a highly competitive programme and admission is based on merit. Students are required to have a minimum of 50% marks in their LL.B. Degree and they are also required to take an entrance exam. The LL. M. programme at Amity Noida offers students the opportunity to specialize in a particular area of law and to gain advanced knowledge and skills in that area. The programme also prepares students for a career in law and for further studies in law. Here are some additional details about the fees structure for the LL. M. programme at Amity Noida: * The fees for the LL. M. programme are subject to change. * The fees for the LL. M. programme may be waived or reduced for students who qualify for financial assistance. * Students who are unable to pay the fees for the LL. M. programme may be eligible for a payment plan. If you are interested in applying for the LL. M. programme at Amity Noida, you can find more information on the college's website. The application process usually opens in the month of February.

content.Infrastructure: We have CCNSB labs dedicated to CND research. Most of the classrooms have AC, but hostels do not. Wi-Fi is all over the classes and labs. Hostels are provided with LAN support. Food quality is good in all four of the messes available. Recently, 2 of the messes, North mess and South mess, were combined and are called Palash mess. Sports are mandatory for the first 4 semesters for all branches.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science + M.S. (by Research) in Computational Natural Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: One of the best decisions you can take.

content.Placements: At least 70% of students got placed. Nearly 40 LPA is the package offered. Many students go abroad to pursue higher studies. Many students got an internship. Some individuals got to CERN too. You can work as a TA to earn money in your third year or above, too. For the CND course, recruiters sometimes have a science background too.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available for first-year students, but it is not available or is poor. The bathrooms are clean, but we have to triple share a single room. Mess food is as expected. Nothing out of the ordinary is manageable, but since there are four messes in IIITH. There are options for everyone. Jains included.

individual_reviews.course: M.S. by Research in IT in Building Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It provided good placements in 2024 as well as 2025.

content.Placements: Our college offers courses like B.Tech in Computer Science, Master's in Data Science, and MS in Research. Many students from the UG background will get internships in top companies, and it is somewhat difficult in some areas like a master of science in data science. The course structure is not aligned properly, which causes students to face trouble during placements. Furthermore, courses in B.Tech and M.Tech are good. It can be recommended if anyone is interested in technical skills and would like to do hard work to get a good job.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is good. The food facilities are also divided widely with 4 mess partitions. Hygiene is something that is not fully satisfactory, but compared to other institutions, this place is very clean and serves moderately tasty food.

faqs.question: Can I get a single room at IIIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: The International Institute of Information Technology - Hyderabad (IIIT-H) residential institute, meaning all admitted students must reside on campus. The institute has separate hostels for boys and girls. There are a total offiveon-campus hostel facilities, of whichthreeare dedicated to boys andtwoare allocated to girls. The hostels generally offer single, double, and triple occupancy rooms on a sharing basis. However, the institute also offers single rooms to the final-year and research students on a need basis. So, it is always the best option to reach out to the institute for better clarity.

paragraphs: The IIIT Hyderabad placements for 2025 have been out on the official website. As per the report, the overall highest package offered stands at INR 128 LPA . The overall average package offered stands at INR 33.96 LPA . Additionally, the highest packages offered to MTech and MS by Research program stands at INR 74 LPA each. The overall placement rate recorded during the IIIT Hyderabad placements is 96.14% . The season witnessed 389 students getting placed from the BTech, MTech and MS by Research programs. Moreover, the highest and average package offered to BTech CSE students in 2025 stands at INR 128 LPA and INR 31.98 LPA . The BTech CSE placement rate in 2025 is 99%.

Earlier, the overall placement rate recorded during IIIT Hyderabad placements 2024 was 99.27%. This placement season, the placement percentage increased by nearly 2% as compared with previous year. IIIT Hyderabad highest package also increased from INR 102 LPA to INR 105 LPA in 2024. The average package offered during placements 2024 stood at INR 26.34 LPA . Importantly, the average package offered in 2024 increased by over 12% as compared with 2023.

The students celebrate hostel day, Diwali, Holi, and other events in the hostel organised by the Students Hall Council. paragraphs: IIT Bhubaneswar has released the placement details for its BTech, MTech and Dual Degree Class of 2025. The institute has achived 90.07% for BTech program. The highest package secured by the BTech batch 2025 was INR 67.6 LPA. The average and median package received by BTech students was INR 14.98 LPA and INR 12 LPA .

The students of the Dual Degree batch 2025 secured the highest salary of INR 67.6 LPA and the average salary of INR 16.98 LPA. 86 students of the Dual Degree batch 2025 participated during IIT Bhubaneswar placements 2025, of which 73 secured job offers from the recruiters. reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure were good and well-equipped with a library, smart classrooms, and Wi-Fi. The library had a huge collection of books for study and research. Hostel facilities were also good, like they had a TV room, Wi-Fi, a water cooler, and clean washrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Bhubaneswar - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and the infrastructure are top-notch. Classrooms are air-conditioned with complete internet. The quality of our hostel is good because we are getting single rooms. We also get breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Bhubaneswar is our 2nd home.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. All classrooms have AC. Classes are in separate buildings with good seating, a projector, and a TV. The library is on 2 big floors with a lot of books. The hostel is great with 7 floors and individual rooms. The mess food is decent enough.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with infrastructure, facilities. Dissatisfied with placement, tech culture, and fests.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the hostel is excellent. Boys get single rooms from the first year, and girls have triple sharing rooms in the first year. The condition of mess food is not so good, and from the perspective of vegetarian students, it is not good. Medical facilities are excellent and quick. Sports facilities are average and currently developing.

reviews.review_heading: Very unique course and worthy in IIT Bhubaneswar.
reviews.review_text: There is a good library maintaining most of the books that are required throughout the course, and a lot of general books. The library keeps updating itself frequently. The classrooms are very good and equipped with modern technology like smart boards, projectors, and the laboratories are equipped with fully functional equipment. All the students must reside within the IIT campus. The room is a single accommodation, and for students opting for post-graduation, there are Sangam hostels where they...

reviews.review_heading: A dream college to explore.
reviews.review_text: My campus life at IIT Bhubaneswar is going very well. We have a very good infrastructure. Classrooms have centralized AC, and we get single-occupancy rooms in the hostel. Apart from all the things, the hostel facility is little bit not good on our campus. The mess caterers are good enough. They provide us different kinds of foods everyday but few times we encounter insects and caterpillars in our mess food. Library is good, and it is always open.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college where dreams start.
reviews.review_text: Everyone gets single room accommodation with 24X7 Wi-Fi and ethernet facilities. Hostel condition is good, better than most IITs. Caterer is changed every 2 years to ensure quality food. Menu includes a variety of dishes both South and North Indian. Lab and college facilities are good with advanced equipment and software required for learning. The library is good, and all types of books are available. We also have access to the library. There are different grounds for different sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Bhubaneswar - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is available at an affordable price, with students required to do registration first for the hostel and PG. There is a 24-hour water supply. Rooms are available for sharing as well as separate.

reviews.review_heading: Everything about IIT Bhubaneswar.
reviews.review_text: There is 24X7 medical facility inside the college. Food items in the mess are not too bad but some of them are really good. Library is open till 12 midnight. The classrooms are too good with the AC and Wi-Fi inside the classes. Labs contain more types of equipment with more diverse projects.

reviews.review_heading: Life and culture at IIT Bhubaneswar.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is so nice, and the college look greenery. Hostel rooms are so clean, and one student per room. Every floor or room will have a Wi-Fi or LAN network. There is a night canteen as well for every hostel which will work from evening till 2:00 AM.

reviews.review_heading: I like my college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our college hostel is very good at this price. Our college food quality is very good and hygienic. Our classrooms are very advanced and well-furnished. Our college authority provided 24-hour high-speed Wi-Fi to the college and hostel. In the college, various types of labs are provided by the college authority.

reviews.review_heading: Best material engineering college in India.
reviews.review_text: One standout feature of the university is its modern infrastructure paired with some extra resources. The library has a wide range of books and academic journals. The canteen is spacious and offers lots of dishes and drinks in a friendly atmosphere. Students really appreciate living in the well managed hostel where the food is not just okay but meets basic quality standards.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review, best college in India.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available in the college and the hostel. The infrastructure is good. A night canteen is available. Sanjeevani Hospital is available. There are different courts for sports like basketball, badminton, etc. Gym facilities are also available. Food items are not so spicy but a variety of items are present. Wi-Fi facility is available 24 hours on the premises.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Bhubaneswar - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Our course had a fee structure of Rs. 80,000 per year. It could vary by Rs. 10,000 based on the selection of the course. For accommodation, three hostels for boys and two hostels for girls. Within the college, mini shopping halls for purchasing all kinds of emergency things.

reviews.review_heading: About the Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar.
reviews.review_text: There are three boys’ hostels and three girls’ hostels. In new hostels, Wi-Fi is provided, but in all hostels, LAN network is available. There is a hostel for couple Ph.D. students as well. There is a night canteen facility also. Mess food items are not too bad, but not too good also.

review_summary.college_name: SASTRA University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Mathematics with Computer Applications - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I like my college much because everything goes well on campus and in my department.

content.Placements: 80% of students were placed in my course. IT, banking exam and government exam packages were offered in my course. Zoho, TCS, and Infosys were the top recruiting companies for my course. 90% of students got internships from my course in companies like TCS and Zoho. Data analyst, finance, and researcher roles were offered in my course.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi labs to practice coding, a peaceful library, neat classrooms, and many more facilities were available in my department. Canteen foods were purely vegetarian and tasty, with enough food. Sports coaching was good, and indoor games were also available for a stress-free environment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is a college that gives life.

content.Placements: Placements are good. The highest package reached 27 LPA, and the average packages are around 4 to 8 LPA. This indicates strong industry connections for engineering and technology students.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is limited, as the signal is often low. The campus offers robust infrastructure, including a green campus, modern labs, a library, sports facilities, a gym, a hospital, banks, and good transport. Hostel rooms are available in 2-sharing and some 4-sharing.
content.Faculty: There are three midterms, which are hectic. Professors are very experienced. Exams are rigorous, involving internal assessments and end-of-semester tests. Selection is typically based on merit in the JEE and intermediate examinations.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechatronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Best for students' careers.

content.Placements: 100 percent placement for students without backlog. The package is 6 to 24 LPA. Accenture, Comcast, PayPal, Amazon, Caterpillar, and many more companies recruit. Max of the role is a software engineer and technical support based only, and also in a product role, they are hiring.
content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure with the best classrooms and labs. Free Wi-Fi for only pc and laptops with some restrictions. In our hostel, there are 2 in 1, 3 in 1 and single rooms for both girls and boys, and also AC and non-AC rooms are available. 24/7, there is medical support on campus. Sports and games are there, but mainly focusing on academics only.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It’s overhyped, but still better than other colleges in our state.

content.Placements: In the past, a good percentage of students got placed. But now, due to the IT slowdown and the rise of AI, placements are not as high as before. Those who have enough knowledge of the subjects still have good opportunities. I am not blaming the college for this, but students are also lacking the basic required grip on the subjects.
content.Infrastructure: It is not up to the mark as they claim, like being a world class university. It is just average for the fees they collect from us. They can upgrade and provide a better environment for us. There is no need to change much. Just replace basic required things like benches for sitting and some basic infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: SASTRA University life is amazing where we can meet people from various parts.

content.Placements: More than 90 percent of the students get placed each year. The salary is Rs 50,000 per month or more. Recruiting companies are Tata and many reputed companies. Roles offered are TL, project manager, and back-end research. The internship opportunities are available even at the college, and long-term internships are also given based on your performance. Companies easily recruit people from this university.
content.Infrastructure: It has good Wi-Fi system with supportive faculty members. All lab facilities are available. Food in hostel is planned according to healthy habits. Classrooms are so sophisticated. Quality of food and water is also available at any time. Clubs help in enhancing your skills even during these times but the timing is little tiering.
